padma-purāṇaḥ
sṛṣṭi-khaṇḍaḥ
auṃ śrī-viṣṇave namaḥ ||
auṃ svacchaṃ candrāvadātaṃ kari-kara-makara-kṣobha-saṃjātaphenaṃ
auṃ kārālaṅkṛtena tribhuvana-guruṇā brahmaṇā dṛṣṭi-pūtaṃ
sambhogābhoga-ramyaṃ jalam aśubha-haraṃ pauṣkaraṃ vaḥ punātu ||1||

lomaharṣaṇa-nāmā vā ugraśravasam āha tat ||2|

prayāge muni-varyaiś ca yathā pṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
pṛṣṭena cānuśiṣṭās te munayo dharma-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||5||
deśaṃ puṇyam abhīpsanto vibhunā ca hitaiṣiṇā |
pṛṣṭato yāta-niyamāt padaṃ prāpsyatha yad dhitam ||7||
uktvā caivam ṛṣīn sarvān adṛśyatvam agāt punaḥ |
gaṅgāvarta-samāhāro nemir yatra vyaśīryata ||9||
ījire dīrgha-satreṇa ṛṣayo naimiṣe tadā |

kāraṇaṃ cāgame brūhi vṛndāraka-sama-dyute |

śuśrūṣasva munīn gatvā yat te pṛcchanti tad vada |
vadantu bhagavanto māṃ kathayāmi kathāṃ tu yāṃ ||15||
purāṇaṃ cetihāsaṃ vā dharmān atha pṛthag-vidhān |
tāṃ giraṃ madhurāṃ tasya śuśruvur ṛṣi-sattamāḥ ||16||
atha teṣāṃ purāṇasya śuśrūṣā samapadyata |

śaunako nāma medhāvī vijṣānāraṇyake guruḥ ||18||

 tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānenasuvrate |

duṣprekṣobhāskarobālastathāhaṃ durjayaḥśiśuḥ ||194||
kumārastaṃ nirāsograṃ cakreṇāmoghavarcasā |
kareṇataṃ cajagrāhakārtikeyomarārihā |
menecadurjayaṃ daityastadābālaṃ suduḥsahaṃ ||198||
ciṃ tayāmāsabuddhyāvaiprāptaḥkālona saṃśayaḥ |
kaṃ pitaṃ casamālokyakālanemipurogamāḥ ||199||
sarvedetyaiśvarājaghnuḥkumāraṃ raṇadāruṇaṃ |
sataiḥprahārair aspṛṣṭastathāklaiśair mahā-dyutiḥ ||200||
raṇaśauṇḍāś ca daityendrāḥpunarjaghnuḥśilīmukhaiḥ ||201||
kumāraṃ samaredaityābalinodevakaṃ ṭakāḥ |
prāṇāṃ takaraṇaṃ jātaṃ devānāṃ dānavāhavaṃ |
devānnipīḍitāndṛṣṭvā kumāraḥkopamāviśat ||203||
tatostrair dārayāmāsadānāvānām anīkinīm |
tair astrair niṣpratīkāraistāḍitāḥ surakaṃ ṭakāḥ ||204||
kālanemimukhāḥsarveraṇehyāsanparāṅmukhāḥ |
jaghnekumāraṅgadayāni ṣṭaptakanakatviṣā ||206||
śarair mayūraṃ citraiś ca cakāravimukhaṃ raṇe |
dṛṣṭvā parāḍmukhodevomuktaraktaṃ svavāhanam ||207||
jagrāhaśaktiṃ vimalāṃ raṇekanakabhūṣaṇām |
bāhunāhemakeyūrarucireṇaṣaḍānanaḥ ||208||
tatobravīnmahā-senastārakaṃ dānavādhipam |
sākumārabhujotsṛṣṭātatkeyūraravānugā |
gatāsuḥsapapātorvyāṃ pralayebhūdharoyathā |
vikīrṇamakuṭoṣṇīṣovisrastākhilabhūṣaṇaḥ ||212||
nābhūtkaścit tadāduḥkhīnarakeṣv apipāpakṛt ||213||
stuvaṃ taḥṣaṇmukhaṃ devāḥprākrīḍannāgatasmitāḥ |
jagmuḥsvānevabhuvanānnirasyāsaṃ stathotsukāḥ ||214||
daduścāpivaraṃ sarvedevāś ca ṣaṇmukhaṃ prati |
tuṣṭāḥ samprāptasarvārthāḥ sahasiddhaistapodhanaiḥ ||215||
yaḥpaṭhetskaṃ da sambandhāṅkathāmetāṃ mahā-matiḥ |
śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpisabhavetkīrtimānnaraḥ ||216||
bahvāyuḥsubhagaḥśrī-mānkīrtimānśubhadarśanaḥ |
saṃ dhyāmupāsyayaḥpūrvāṃ skaṃ dasyacaritaṃ paṭhet |
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmihiraṇyakaśiporvadham |
narasiṃ hasyamāhātmyaṃ tathāpāpavināśanam ||1||
purākṛtayugerājanhiraṇyakaśipuḥ prabhuḥ |
daityānām ādipuruṣaś ca kārasumahattapaḥ ||2||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇidaśavarṣaśatāni ca |
vṛtaḥśamadamābhyāṃ cabrahmacaryeṇa caiva hi |
vimānenārkavarṇenahaṃsayuktenabhāsvatā ||5||
rudrair viśvasahāyaiś ca yakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ ||6||
nakṣatraiś ca muhūrtaiś ca khacaraiś ca mahā-grahaiḥ ||7||
rājarṣibhiḥ puṇyakṛdbhir gandharvāpsarasāṅgaṇaiḥ ||8||
carācaraguruḥśrī-mānvṛtaḥsarvair divaukasaiḥ |
brahmābrahmavidāṃ śreṣṭhodaityaṃ vacanamabravīt ||9||
varaṃ varayabhadraṃ teyatheṣṭaṅkāmamāpnuhi ||10||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
nadevāsuragandharvānayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ |
namānuṣāḥ piśācāś ca hanyurmāṃ devasattama ||11||
ṛṣayomānavāḥśāpair naśapeyuḥpitāmaha |
naśastreṇanacāstreṇagiriṇāpādapenavā |
naśuṣkeṇanacārdreṇanasyāccānyenamevadhaḥ ||13||
bhaveyamahamevārkaḥsomovāyurhutāśanaḥ |
salilaṃ cāṃ tarikṣaṃ canakṣatrāṇidiśodaśa ||14||
ahaṅkrodhaś ca kāmaś ca varuṇovāsavoyamaḥ |
dhanadaś ca dhanādhyakṣoyakṣaḥkiṃ puruṣādhipaḥ ||15||
evamuktvāsabhagavānjagāmākāśamevahi |
tatodevāś ca gandharvāṛṣibhiḥsahacāraṇāḥ |
varapradānaṃ śrutvaivaṃ pitāmahamupasthitāḥ ||18||
bhagavānsarva-bhūtānām ādikarttāsvayaṃ prabhuḥ |
sraṣṭācahavyakavyānām avyaktaprakṛtiḥparaḥ ||20||
 sarva-lokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥprajāpatiḥ |
āśvāsayāmāsatadāsuśītair vacanāṃ bubhiḥ ||21||
avaśyaṃ tridaśānenaprāptavyaṃ tapasaḥphalaṃ |
tacchrutvāvibudhāvākyaṃ sarvepaṅkajajānanāt |
svāni sthānāni divyāni viprajagmurmudānvitāḥ ||23||
āśrameṣu mahā-bhāgānmunīnvaiśaṃ sitavratān |
satyadharmaparāndāntāndharṣayāmāsadānavaḥ ||25||
devāṃ stribhuvanasthāṃ ś ca parājityamahā-suraḥ |
trailokyaṃ vaśamānīyasvargevasatidānavaḥ ||26||
yadāvaramadotsiktaścoditaḥkāladharmiṇā |
yajṣiyānakaroddaityānayajṣīyāṃ ś ca daivatān ||27||
tathādaityāś ca sādhyāś ca viśvecavasavastathā |
rudrādevagaṇāyakṣādevadvijamaharṣayaḥ ||28||
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumupatasthurmahā-balam |
devadevaṃ yajṣamayaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam ||29||
nārāyaṇamahā-bhāgadevāstvāṃ śaraṇaṅgatāḥ |
tvaṃ hinaḥparamodātātvaṃ hinaḥparamoguruḥ |
tvaṃ hinaḥparamodevobrahmādīnāṃ surottamaḥ ||31||
evamuktvātubhagavānviśvapoviṣṇuravyayaḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipusthānaṃ jagāmaharirīśvaraḥ ||34||
tejasābhāskārākāraḥśaśīkāṃ tyevacāparaḥ |
narasyakṛtvārdhatanuṃ siṃ hasyārddhatanuṃ tathā ||35||
nārasiṃ henavapuṣāpāṇiṃ saṅgṛhyapāṇinā |
tatodadarśavistīrṇāṃ divyāṃ ramyāṃ manoramām ||36||
sarvakāmayutāṃ śubhrāṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥsabhām |
vistīrṇāṃ yojanaśataṃ śatamadhyarddhamāyatām ||37||
vaihāyasīṅkāmagamāṃ paṣcayojanamucchritām |
jarāśokakṣamāpetāṃ niṣprakamapyāṃ śivāṃ sukhām ||38||
veśmāsanavatīṃ ramyāṃ jvalaṃ tīmivatejasā |
aṃ taḥsalilasaṃ yuktāṃ vihitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā ||39||
nīlapītāsitaśyāmaiḥśvetair lohitakair api ||40||
sitābhraghanasaṅkāśāṃ plavaṃ tīṃ cadadarśasaḥ ||41||
susukhānacaduḥkhāsānaśītānacagharmadā ||42||
nakṣutpipāseglāniṃ vāprāpyatāṃ prāpnuvanti te |
nānarūpair upakṛtāsucitraiś ca subhāsvaraiḥ ||43||
aticandrātisūryātiśikhikāntisvayaṃ prabhā |
dīpyatenākapṛṣṭhasthābhāsayaṃ tīvibhāsurā ||44||
sarvecakāśiretasyāṃ muditāś caiva mānuṣāḥ |
puṇyagandhāsrajaścāpinityakālaphalādrumāḥ |
uṣṇeśītāni toyāni śītecoṣṇāni santi vai ||46||
puṣpitāgrānmahā-śākhānpravālāṅkuradhāriṇaḥ |
latāvitānasaṃ channānkalpānaikṣiṣṭhasaprabhuḥ ||47||
tāni śītāni coṣṇāni tatra tatra sarāṃ sica ||48||
apaśyadbhūpatīrthāni sabhāyāṃ tasyasaprabhuḥ |
nalinaiḥpuṇḍarīkaiś ca śatapatraiḥsugandhibhiḥ ||49||
nānāś ca ryasamopetaiḥpuṣpair anyaiś ca supriyaiḥ ||50||
kāraṇḍavaiś ca kravākaiḥsārasaiḥkurarair api |
vimalasphaṭikābhāni pāṇḍuracchadanair dvijaiḥ ||51||
bahuhaṃsopagītāni sārasānāṃ rutāni ca |
gandhayuktālatās tatra puṣpamaṃ jaridhāriṇīḥ ||52||
dṛṣṭavānbhagavānhṛṣṭaḥkhadirānvetasārjunān |
cūtāni mbānāgavṛkṣāḥkadaṃ bāvakulādhavāḥ ||53||
priyaṅgavaḥpāṭalākhyāḥśālmalyaḥ saharidravāḥ |
śālāstālāstamālāś ca caṃ pakāś ca manoramāḥ ||54||
tathaivānyevyarājaṃ tasabhāyāṃ puṣpitādrumāḥ |
elākakubhakaṅkolalavalīkarṇapūrakāḥ ||55||
madhukāḥkovidārāś ca bahutālasamucchrayāḥ |
aṃ janāśokaparṇāsābahavaścitrakādrumāḥ ||56||
varuṇāś ca palāśāścāpanasāḥ sahacaṃ danaiḥ |
nīlāḥ sumanasaś caiva nīpāścāśvatthatiṃ dukāḥ ||57||
pārijātāś ca taravomallikābhadradāravaḥ |
aṭarūṣāḥpīlūkāś ca tathā caiva ilavālukāḥ ||58||
maṃ dārakāḥkuravakāpunnāgāḥkuṭajāstathā |
raktāḥkuravakāś caiva nīlāścāgarubhiḥsaha ||59||
kiṃ śukāś caiva bhavyāś ca dāḍimābījapūrakāḥ |
kāleyakādukūlāś ca hiṅgavastailavarttikāḥ ||60||
kharjūrānālikerāś ca harītakamadhūkakāḥ |
saptaparṇāś ca bilvāś ca sayāvāś ca śarāvatāḥ ||61||
asanāś ca tamālāś ca nānāgulmasamāvṛtāḥ |
latāś ca vividhākārāḥpuṣpapatraphalopagāḥ ||62||
nānāpuṣpaphalopetāvyarājaṃ tasamaṃ tataḥ ||63||
cakorāḥśatapatrāś ca mattakokilaśārikāḥ |
puṣpitānpuṣpitāgrāṃ ś ca sampatanti mahā-drumān ||64||
raktapītāruṇās tatra pādapāgragatāḥkhagāḥ |
parasparamavaikṣaṃ taprahṛṣṭājīvajīvikāḥ ||65||
tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ daityendrohiraṇyakaśipustadā |
āsīna āsanecitredaśanalbepramāṇataḥ ||66||
hiraṇyakaśipurdaitya āstejvalitakuṇḍalaḥ ||67||
upacerurmahā-daityāhiraṇyakaśipuṃ tadā |
divyatālāni gītāni jagurgandharvasattamāḥ ||68||
viśvācīsahajanyācapramloceticapūjitā |
divyāthasaurabheyīcasamīcīpuṃ jikasthalā ||69||
miśrakeśīcaraṃ bhācacitrabhāśrutivibhramā |
cārunetrāghṛtācīcamenakācorvaśītathā ||70||
etāḥ sahasraśaścānyānṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ |
surahantāduḥkhakartāsamanāḥ sumatistathā ||73||
ghaṭodaromahā-pārśvaḥkrathanaḥpiṭharastathā |
viśvarūpasvarūpaś ca viśvakāyomahā-balaḥ ||74||
daśagrīvaś ca vālīcameghavāsāmahā-suraḥ |
ghaṭābhoviṭarūpaś ca jvalanaścendratāpanaḥ ||75||
daityadānavasaṅghāstesarvejvalitakuṇḍalāḥ |
sarvelabdhavarāḥśūrāḥ sarvevihitamṛtyavaḥ |
upāsatemahātmānaṃ sarvedivyaparicchadāḥ |
vimānair vividhākārair bhrājamānair ivāgnibhiḥ ||78||
sadadarśamṛgādhipaḥsabhāyāṃ surucirajālagavākṣaśobhitāyām ||81||
kanakavalayahārabhūṣitāṅgaṃ dititanayaṃ samṛgādhipodadarśa |
vismitādānavāḥsarvehiraṇyakaśipuś ca saḥ ||85||
prahlāda uvāca—
mahā-rājamahā-bāhodaityānām ādi sambhava |
naśrutaṃ naivamedṛṣṭaṃ nārasiṃ ham idaṃ vapuḥ ||86||
avyaktaṃ paramaṃ divyaṅkim idaṃ rūpamāgatam |
daityāṃ takaraṇaṅghoraṃ śaṃ satīvamanomama ||87||
asyadevāḥśarīrasthāḥsāgarāḥsaritastathā |
himavānpāriyātraś ca yecānyekulaparvatāḥ ||88||
candramāḥ sahanakṣatrair ādityāraśmibhiḥsaha |
dhanadovaruṇaś caiva yamaḥśakraḥśacīpatiḥ ||89||
marutodevagandharvāṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ |
nāgāyakṣāḥpiśācāś ca rākṣasābhīmavikramāḥ ||90||
brahmādevāḥpaśupatirlalāṭasthābhramanti hi |
sthāvarāṇicasarvāṇijaṅgamāni tathaiva ca ||91||
bhavāṃ ś ca sahitosmābhiḥsarvair daityagaṇair vṛtaḥ |
vimānaśatasaṅkīrṇāsarvāyābhavataḥsabhā ||92||
sarvaṃ tribhuvanaṃ rājanlokadharmaś ca śāśvataḥ |
prajāpatiścātramanurmahātmāgrahāś ca yogāś ca mahīnabhaś ca |
utpātakālaś ca dhṛtirmatiś ca ratiś ca satyaṃ catapodamaś ca ||94||
sanatkumāraś ca mahā-nubhāvoviśvecadevāṝṣayaś ca sarve |
prahlādasyavacaḥśrutvā hiraṇyakaśipuḥprabhuḥ |
 uvācadānavānsarvāngaṇāṃ ś ca sagaṇādhipaḥ ||96||
mṛgendrogṛhyatāmeṣaapūrvāṃ tanumāsthitaḥ |
yadivāsaṃśayaḥkaścid vadhyatāṃ vanagocaraḥ ||97||
tedānavagaṇāḥ sarvemṛgendraṃ bhīmavikram |
parikṣipanto muditāstrāsayāmāsurojasā ||98||
siṃ hanādaṃ vimucyāthanarasiṃ homahā-balaḥ |
babhaṃ jatāṃ sabhāṃ sarvāṃ vyāditāsyaivāṃ takaḥ ||99||
sabhāyāṃ bhajyamānāyāṃ hiraṇyakaśipuḥsvayam |
cikṣepāstrāṇisiṃ hasyaroṣavyākulalocanaḥ ||100||
sarvāstrāṇām athaśreṣṭhaṃ daṇḍamastraṃ sudāruṇam |
kālacakraṃ tathāghoraṃ viṣṇucakraṃ tathāparaṃ ||101||
vicitrāmaśaniṃ caiva śuṣkārdraṃ cāśanidvayam ||102||
raudraṃ tathograśūlaṃ cakaṅkālaṃ musalaṃ tathā |
nārāyaṇāstramaindraṃ ca āgneyaṃ śaiśiraṃ tathā ##|
mohanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ caiva saṃ tāpanavilāpane ||105||
kaṃ panaṃ śātanaṃ caiva mahā-straṃ caiva rodhanam |
kālamudgaramakṣobhyaṃ tāpanaṃ camahā-balam ||106||
saṃ vartanaṃ mohanaṃ catathāmāyādharaṃ varam |
prasvāpanaṃ pramathanaṃ vāruṇaṃ cāstramuttamam |
astraṃ pāśupataṃ caiva yasyāpratihatāgatiḥ ||108||
etānyastrāṇidivyāni hiraṇyakaśipustadā |
astraiḥprajvalitaiḥsiṃ hamāvṛṇodasurottamaḥ |
vivasvāngharmasamayehimavaṃ tamivāṃ śubhiḥ ||110||
sahyamarṣāni lodbhūtodaityānāṃ sainyasāgaraḥ |
kṣaṇenāplāvayatsarvaṃ mainākamivasāgaraḥ ||111||
prāsaiḥpāśaiś ca khaḍgaiś ca gadābhir musalaistathā |
mudgaraiḥkūṭapāśaiś ca śilolūkhalaparvataiḥ |
śataghnībhiś ca dīptābhir daṇḍair apisudāruṇaiḥ ||113||
tedānavāḥpāśagṛhītahastāmahendratulyāśanitulyavegāḥ |
samaṃ tatobhyudyatabāhukāyāḥsthitāḥsaśīrṣā ivanāgapotāḥ ||114||
suvarṇamālākulabhūṣitāṅgāḥsutīkṣṇadaṃ ṣṭrākulavaktragartāḥ |
sphuratprabhāstecasaśṛṅgadehāścīnāṃ śukābhāṃ tiyathaivahaṃsāḥ ||115||
sosṛjaddānavomāyāmagniṃ vāyuṃ samīritam |
tamindrastoyadaiḥsārdhaṃsahasrākṣomahā-dyutiḥ ||116||
mahatātoyavarṣeṇaśamayamāsapāvakam |
tasyāṃ pratihatāyāṃ tumāyāyāṃ yudhidānavaḥ ||117||
asṛjadghorasaṅkāśaṃ tamastīvraṃ samaṃ tataḥ |
tamasāsaṃ vṛtelokedaityeṣvāttāyudheṣu ca ||118||
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīmasyadadṛśurdānavāraṇe ||119||
lalāṭasthāṃ trikūṭasthāṅgaṅgāṃ tripathagāmiva ||
tataḥsarvāsumāyāsuhatāsuditinaṃ danāḥ ||120||
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ daityāviṣaṇṇāśśaraṇaṃ yayuḥ |
āvahaḥpravahaś caiva vivahothasamīraṇaḥ ||122||
parāvahaḥ saṃ vahaś ca udvahaś ca mahā-balaḥ |
tathāparivahaḥśrī-mānutpātabhayaśaṃ sinaḥ ||123||
ityevaṅkṣubhitāḥsaptamarutogaganecarāḥ |
tesarvegaganehṛṣṭāvyacaraṃ ś ca yathāsukham |
ayogataścāpyacaradyogaṃ niśiniśācaraḥ ||125||
vivarṇatāṃ cabhagavāngatodividivākaraḥ ||126||
kṛṣṇaḥkabandhaś ca tadālakṣyatesumahā-ndivi |
asṛjac cāsitāṃ sūryo dhūmavat tāṃ vibhāvasuḥ ||127||
gaganasthaś ca bhagavānabhīkṣṇaṃ pariviṣyate |
saptadhūmanibhāghorāḥsūryādivisamutthitāḥ ||128||
somasyagaganasthasyagrahāstiṣṭhanti śṛṃ ṅgagāḥ |
vāmecadakṣiṇe caiva sthitauśukrabṛhaspatī ||129||
śanaiś ca rolohitāṅgolohitāṅgasamadyutiḥ |
śṛṅgāṇiśanakair ghorāyugāṃ tāvarttanagrahāḥ |
carācaravināśāyarohiṇīṃ nābhyanaṃ data |
gṛhītorāhuṇācandraulkābhir abhihanyate ||132||
devānām adhipodevaḥsopyavarṣataśoṇitam ||133||
apatadgaganādulkāvidyudrūpāmahā-svanā |
latāś ca saphalāḥsarvāyā āhurdaityanāśikāḥ |
vikrośanti cagaṃ bhīraṃ dhūmāyaṃ tejvalanti ca ||136||
āraṇyaiḥsahasaṃ sṛṣṭāgrāmyāś ca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ||137||
nadyaś ca pratikūlāni vahanti kaluṣodakāḥ ||138||
naprākāśaṃ tacadiśoraktareṇusamākulāḥ |
vānaspatyānapūjyaṃ tepūjanārhāḥ kathaṃ cana ||139||
tathācasarva-bhūtānāṃ chāyānaparivarttate ||140||
apareṇagatesūryesalokānāṃ yugakṣaye |
bhāṇḍāgārāyudhāgāreniviṣṭamabhavanmadhu |
asurāṇāṃ vināśāyasurāṇāṃ vijayāya ca ||142||
dṛśyaṃ tevividhotpātāghorāghoranidarśanāḥ |
etecānyecabahavoghorarūpāḥsamutthitāḥ ||143||
daityendrasyavināśāyadṛśyaṃ teraṇaśaṃ sinaḥ |
medinyāṅkaṃ pamānāyāṃ daityendreṇamahātmanaḥ ||144||
mahīdharānāgagaṇāni peturamitaujasaḥ |
catuḥśīrṣāḥpaṣcaśīrṣāḥsaptaśīrṣāś ca pannagāḥ |
elāmukhaḥkāliyaś ca mahā-padmaś ca vīryavān |
sahasraśīrṣaśśuddhāṅgohematāladhvajaḥprabhuḥ ||147||
śeṣonanto mahā-nāgohyaprakaṃ pyaś ca kaṃ pitāḥ |
dīpyaṃ teṃ tarjalasthāni pṛthivīvivarāṇivai ||148||
nānātejodharāścāpipātālatalacāriṇaḥ ||149||

striyoyaiś ca narakṣyaṃ tetepretānātrasaṃśayaḥ |

vikrīṇanti cavaigāś ca mleccheṣu cagavāśiṣu ||90||
aśaucābhyaṃ tareyecajātāś ca paśavomṛtāḥ ||91||
ciraṃ pretāḥpiśācāś ca mṛtājātāḥpunaḥpunaḥ |
snānasaṃ dhyāsurārcābhir vedayajṣavratākṣaraiḥ ||93||
ājanmavarjitāḥpāpāstepretāścāpunarbhavāḥ |

nipātayanti yetīrthetepretānātrasaṃśayaḥ |

abhakṣyabhakṣakāścānyetepretāścāpunarbhavāḥ |

sayātiviṣṇusāyujyamitipaurāṇikāviduḥ ||103||
skaṃ da uvāca—
mahīruhaphalaṃ jṣātaṃ prapūtaṃ dvividhaṃ prabho |
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmipatraṃ puṣpaṃ sumokṣadam ||104||

śrāddheṣu yajṣakāryeṣu parṇam ekaṃ ṣaḍānana ||130||

arcitaḥkeśavoyenaśākhāmṛdulapallavaiḥ |
bhāvayetpuruṣānmartyaḥśataśothasahasraśaḥ ||136||

tulasī-māhātmyaṃ nāma

tasyāstotraṅkṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ śrotumicchāmahevayam ||1||
purāskaṃ dapurāṇecayanmayākīrtitaṃ dvijāḥ |

śatānaṃ da uvāca—
nāmoccārekṛtetasyāḥprīṇātyasuradarpahā |
pāpāni vilayaṃ yānti puṇyaṃ bhavaticākṣayam ||5||
sā kathaṃ tulasīlokaiḥpūjyatevaṃ dyatena hi |

sālagrāmaśilārthaṃ tutulasīpratyahaṅkṣitau ||7||

pūjanaṃ vāsudevasyalakṣakoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
prabhāvaṃ tava deveśi gāyanti sura-sattamāḥ ||14||
munayaḥ siddha-gandharvāḥ pātāle nāgarāṭ svayam |
na te prabhāvaṃ jānanti devatāḥ keśavādṛte ||15||
guṇānāṃ parimāṇaṃ tu kalpa-koṭi-śatair api |

uttamāṅge purā yena tulasī viṣṇunā dhṛtā |
prāpyaitāni tvayā devi viṣṇor aṅgāni sarvaśaḥ ||17||
pavitratā tvayā prāptā tulasīṃ tvāṃ namāmy aham |

ropitā gomatī-tīre svayaṃ kṛṣṇena pālitā ||19||

vasiṣṭha-vacanāt pūrvaṃ rāmeṇa sarayū-taṭe ||21||

ropitā tapaso vṛddhyai tulasīṃ tvāṃ namāmy aham ||22||
viyoge vāsudevasya dhyātvā tvāṃ janakātmajā |
śaṅkarārthaṃ purā devi pārvatyā tvaṃ himālaye |
ropitā tapaso vṛddhyai tulasīṃ tvāṃ namāmy aham ||24||
duḥsvapna-nāśanārthāya sevitā tvaṃ namo’stu te ||25||

tulasī vāli-nāśāya tārā-saṅgama-hetave ||29||

kuruteśatrunāśaṃ casukhaṃ vidyāṃ prayacchati ||36||

tulasīstavasaṃ tuṣṭāsukhaṃ vṛddhiṃ dadātica |

pāpātpūto'kṣayaṃ nākamaśnutediviśakravat |

gaṅgetismaraṇādevakṣayaṃ yāticapātakam |

 samprāpnotyakṣayaṃ svargaṅgaṅgāsnānenakeśavam |

gaṅgā kasmāt kimākārākutaḥsāhyatipāvanī |

 tatra puṇyājanapadāḥ pūjyate tatra śaṅkaraḥ |
 tatra gacchanti siddhāś ca cāraṇādaivatāni ca ||27||
dhārmikāś ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ catvārogatamatsarāḥ |
varṇāḥ svakarmaniratānacasteno'tradṛśyate ||28||
dīrghāyuṣomahā-prājṣājarāmṛtyuvivarjitāḥ |
nadyaḥ puṇyajalās tatra gaṅgācabahudhāgatā |
sukumārīkumārīcaśītāśītodakā tathā ||30||
mahā-nadīcabhoviprās tathā maṇijalānadī |
ikṣuvarddhanikā caiva nadīmunivarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||31||
tataḥ pravṛttāḥ puṇyodānadyaḥ paramaśobhanāḥ |
sahasrāṇāṃ śatānyevayatovarṣativāsavaḥ ||32||
natāsāṃ nāmadheyāniparismartuṃ tathaiva ca |
śakyaṃ teparisaṅkhyātuṃ puṇyāstāhisaridvarāḥ ||33||
tataḥ puṇyājanapadāś ca tvārolokaviśrutāḥ |
mṛgāś ca maśakāś caiva mānasāmallakās tathā ||34||
mṛgāś ca brahmabhūyiṣṭhāḥ svakarmaniratādvijāḥ |
maśakeṣu turājanyādhārmikāḥ sarva-kāmadāḥ ||35||
mānasāś ca mahā-bhāgāvaiśyadharmopajīvinaḥ |
 sarva-kāmasamāyuktāḥ śūrādharmārthaniścitāḥ ||36||
śūdrāstumallakānityaṃ puruṣādharmaśīlinaḥ |
na tatra rājāviprendrānadaṇḍonacadaṇḍikāḥ ||37||
etāvadevaśakyaṃ tu tatra dvīpeprabhāṣitum ||38||
uttareṣu cabhoviprādvīpeṣu śrūyatekathā |
paraspareṇadviguṇāḥ sarvedvīpādvijarṣabhāḥ |
parvatāś ca mahā-prājṣāḥ samudraiḥ parivāritāḥ ||3||
parvataḥ paścimekṛṣṇonārāyaṇasakhodvijāḥ ||4||
 tatra ratnānidivyānisvayaṃ rakṣatikeśavaḥ |
sampūjyateśālmaliś ca dvīpeśālmalikedvijāḥ ||6||
krauṃ cadvīpemahā-krauṃ cogirīratnacayākaraḥ |
mokṣibhiḥ saṅgatonityaṃ prabhurnārāyaṇohariḥ |
dyutimānnāmaviprendrāstṛtīyaḥ kumudogiriḥ ||10||
caturthaḥ puṣpavānnāmapaṣcamastukuśeśayaḥ |
ṣaṣṭoharigirirnāmaṣaḍeteparvatottamāḥ ||11||
teṣāmantar- aviṣkaṃ bhodviguṇaḥ pravibhāgaśaḥ |
audbhidaṃ prathamaṃ varṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ reṇumaṇḍalam ||12||
tṛtīyaṃ surathaṃ nāmacaturthaṃ laṃ banaṃ smṛtam |
dhṛtimatpaṣcamaṃ varṣaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ varṣaṃ prabhākaram ||13||
saptamaṃ kāpilaṃ varṣaṃ saptaitevarṣalaṃ bakāḥ |
eteṣu devagandharvāḥ prajāś ca muditādvijāḥ ||
gauraprāyojanaḥ sarva-ḥ sukumāraś ca sattamāḥ ||15||
avaśiṣṭeṣu sarveṣu vakṣyāmidvijapuṅgavāḥ |
 yathā śrutaṃ mahā-prājṣāvarṇyateśṛṇutadvijāḥ ||16||
krauṃ cadvīpemahā-bhāgāḥ krauṃ conāmamahā-giriḥ |
krauṃ cātparovāmanakovāmanādaṃ dhakārakaḥ ||17||
aṃ dhakārātparoviprāmainākaḥ parvatottamaḥ |
govindātparataś caiva puṇḍarīkomahā-giriḥ |
puṇḍarīkātparaś cāpi procyateduṃ dubhisvanaḥ ||19||
purastāddviguṇasteṣāṃ viṣkaṃ bhomunipuṅgavāḥ |
deśāṃs tatra pravakṣyāmitanmenigadataḥ śṛṇu ||20||
manonugātparodeśauṣṇonāmatapodhanāḥ ||21||
uṣṇātparaḥ prāvarakaḥ prāvarādaṃ dhakārakaḥ |
aṃ dhakārakadeśāttumunideśaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ||22||
siddhacāraṇasaṃ kīrṇogauraḥ prāyojanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||23||
etedeśāḥ samākhyātādevagandharvasevitāḥ |
paryupāsanti taṃ nityaṃ devāḥ sarvemaharṣayaḥ ||25||
vāgbhirmanonukūlābhiḥ pūjayanti dvijottamāḥ |
dvīpeṣu teṣu sarveṣu prajānāṃ munisattamāḥ |
ārogyāyuṣpramāṇābhyāṃ dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ tataḥ |
etejanapadāviprādvīpeṣu teṣu sattamāḥ ||28||
īśvaro daṇḍam udyamya svayam eva prajāpatiḥ ||29||
dvīpānetānmunivarārakṣaṃ stiṣṭhati sarvadā |
sarājāsaśivoviprāḥ sapitāsapitāmahaḥ ||30||
gopāyatidvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prajāḥ sadvijapaṇḍitāḥ |
tataḥ paraṃ mahā-śailodṛśyatelokasaṃ sthitiḥ ||32||
caturasromahā-prājṣaḥ sarva-taḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ |
 tatra tiṣṭhanti viprendrāś ca tvārolokasaṃ matāḥ ||33||
diggajāhimuniśreṣṭhāvāmanairāvatāṃ janāḥ |
supratīkas tathā viprāḥ prabhinnakaraṭāmukhāḥ ||34||
tasyāhaṃ parimāṇaṃ nasaṅkhyātumihamutsahe |
asambandhāmuniśreṣṭhāstānnigṛhṇanti tedvijāḥ ||36||
puṣkaraiḥ padmasaṃ kāśairvikarṣanti mahā-prabhaiḥ |
śatadhāpunarevāśutetānmuṃ canti nityaśaḥ ||37||
śvasadbhirmukhanāsābhyāṃ diggajair ivamārutāḥ |
āgacchanti dvijaśreṣṭhās tatra tiṣṭhanti vaiprajāḥ ||38||
yathoddiṣṭaṃ mayāproktaṃ sanirmāṇamidaṃ jagat |
śrutvedaṃ pṛthivīmānaṃ puṇyadaṃ camanonugam ||39||
śrīmāṃ starativiprendrāḥ siddhārthaḥ sādhusaṃ mataḥ |
yaḥ śṛṇotisamākhyātuṃ parvaṇīdaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ |
pṛthivyāhiparīmāṇaṃ saṃ sthānaṃ saritas tathā |
tvattaḥ śrutvāmahā-bhāgaamṛtaṃ pītam evaca ||1||
 tatra bhūmaucatīrthānipāvanānītinaḥ śrutam |
ācakṣvatānisarvāṇi yathā phalakarāṇi ca |
saviśeṣaṃ mahā-prājṣaśrotum icchāmahetava ||2||
dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ mahā-khyānaṃ pṛṣṭamevatapodhanāḥ |
 yathā matipravakṣyāmi yathā yogaṃ yathā śrutam ||3||
purātanaṃ pravakṣyāmidevarṣernāradasyahi |
athāpaśyanmahātmānaṃ devarṣiṃ tatra nāradam |
dīpyamānaṃ śriyābrāhmyādīptāgnisamatejasam ||6||
sataiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmānbhrātṛbhiḥ kurunandanaḥ |
 yathā cadevānsāvitrīyājṣasenī tathā patīn |
brūhidharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhakiṃ prārthyaṃ hidadāmite ||10||
athadharmasutorājāpraṇamyabhrātṛbhiḥ saha |
 uvāca—prāṃ jalirvākyaṃ nāradaṃ devasaṃ mitam ||11||
tvayituṣṭemahā-bhāga sarva-lokābhipūjite |
samdehaṃ memuniśreṣṭhahṛtsthaṃ tvaṣchettumarhasi ||13||
pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ kurutepṛthivīṃ tīrthatatparaḥ |
śṛṇurājannavahitodilīpena yathā purā |
vasiṣṭhasyasakāśādvai sarvam etadupaśrutam ||15||
purābhāgīrathītīredilīporājasattamaḥ |
śubhedeśemahā-rājapuṇyedevarṣipūjite |
sapitṝṃ starpayāmāsadevāṃ ś ca paramadyutiḥ |
ṛṣīṃ ś ca tarpayāmāsavidhidṛṣṭenakarmaṇā ||18||
dadarśabhūtasaṃ kāśaṃ vasiṣṭhamṛṣimuttamam ||19||
purohitaṃ sataṃ dṛṣṭvā dīpyamānamivaśriyā |
upasthitaṃ mahā-rājapūjayāmāsabhārata |
sahidharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhovidhidṛṣṭenakarmaṇā ||21||
śirasācārghyamādāyaśuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ |
evamuktvāmahā-rājadilīpodvipadāṃ varaḥ |
vāgyataḥ prāṃ jalirbhūtvā tūṣṇīmāsīdyudhiṣṭhira ||24||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā niyamenāthasvādhyāyenacakarṣitam |
dilīpaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭhaṃ muniḥprītamanābhavat ||25||
satyenacamahā-bhāgatuṣṭosmitava sarva-śaḥ ||1||
kṛtamityevamanyehiyadahaṃ dṛṣṭavānprabhum ||4||
tadahaṃ śrotum icchāmipṛthaksaṅkīrtanaṃ tvayā ||6||
pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ pṛthivīṃ karoti dvija-sattaa |
kathayiṣyāmitadahamṛṣīṇāṃ matparāyaṇam |
tadekāgramanāstātaśṛṇutīrtheṣu yatphalam ||8||
vidyātapaś ca kīrtiś ca satīrtha-phalamaśnute ||9||
pratigrahādupāvṛttaḥ santuṣṭoniyataḥ śuciḥ |
ahaṃ kāranivṛttaś ca satīrtha-phalamaśnute ||10||
akrodhanaś ca rājendrasatyaśīlodṛḍhavrataḥ |
ātmopamaś ca bhūteṣu satīrtha-phalamaśnute ||12||
ṛṣibhiḥ kratavaḥ proktādeveṣvapi yathā kramam |
nateśakyādaridreṇayajṣāḥ prāptuṃ mahīpate |
bahūpakaraṇāyajṣānānāsambhāravistarāḥ ||14||
ṛṣīṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyamidaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ vara |
tīrthābhigamanaṃ puṇyaṃ yajṣairapiviśiṣyate ||17||
anupoṣyatrirātrāṇitīrthābhigamanenaca |
adattvākāṣcanaṃ gāś ca daridronāma jāyate ||18||
agniṣṭomādibhiryajṣairiṣṭvāvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ |
daśakoṭisahasrāṇitīrthānāṃ vaimahīpate |
sānnidhyaṃ puṣkareyeṣāṃ trisamdhyaṃ sūryavaṃ śaja ||21||
ādityāvasavorudrāḥ sādhyāś ca samarudgaṇāḥ |
divyayogāmahā-rājapuṇyenamahatādvijāḥ ||23||
manasā pyabhikāmasyapuṣkarāṇimanīṣiṇaḥ |
pūyaṃ te sarva-pāpāni nākapṛṣṭhecapūjyate ||24||
asiṃ mastīrthe mahā-bhāganityamevapitāmahaḥ |
puṣkareṣu mahā-bhāgadevāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ |
siddhiṃ paramikāṃ ṃ pāptāḥ puṇyenamahatānvitāḥ ||26||
tatrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryātpitṛdevārcanerataḥ |
aśvamedhāddaśaguṇaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||27||
apyekaṃ bhojayedvipraṃ puṣkarāraṇyamāśritaḥ |
tenaitipūjitāṃ ṃ llokānbrahmaṇaḥ sadanesthitān ||28||
sāyaṃ prātaḥ smaredyas tupuṣkarāṇikṛtāṃ jaliḥ |
upaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavettena sarva-tīrtheṣu pārthiva ||29||
janmaprabhṛtiyat pāpaṃ striyovāpuruṣasyavā |
 yathā surāṇāṃ sarveṣāmādistumadhusūdanaḥ |
 tathaiva puṣkarorājantīrthānāmādirucyate ||31||
uṣṭvā dvādaśarṣāṇi puṣkare niyataḥ śuciḥ |
yas tuvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇamagnihotramupāśnute |
kārtikīṃ vāvasedekāṃ puṣkaresamamevatat ||33||
duṣkaraṃ puṣkaregaṃ tuṃ duṣkaraṃ puṣkaretapaḥ |
duṣkaraṃ puṣkaredānaṃ vastuṃ caiva suduṣkaram ||34||
trīṇiśṛṃ gāṇiśubhrāṇitrīṇiprasravaṇāni ca |
puṣkarāṇyāditīrthāninavidmas tatra kāraṇam ||35||
uṣṭvādvādaśavarṣāṇiniyatoniyatāśanaḥ |
puṣkara-tīrtha-māhātmya-varṇanaṃ nāma
pradakṣiṇamupāvṛttojaṃ būmārgesamāviśet |
jaṃ būmārgaṃ samāviśyapitṛdevarṣipūjitam ||1||
tatroṣyarajanīḥ paṣcaṣaṣṭhakāleśnuvannaraḥ ||2||
jambumārgādupāvṛttogacchettudulikāśramam ||3||
agastyāśramamāsādyapitṛdevārcanerataḥ ||4||
śākavṛttiḥ phalairvāpikaumāraṃ vindate param ||5||
kanyāśramaṃ samāsādyaśrīpuṣṭaṃ lokapūjitam |
dharmāraṇyaṃ hitatpuṇyamādyaṃ capārthivarṣabha ||6||
arcayitvāpitṝndevānprayatoniyatāśanaḥ ||7||
prādakṣiṇyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvāyayātipatanaṃ vrajet ||8||
vasiṣṭhenadilīpāyakathitaṃ tīrtham uttamam |
narmadāyāś ca māhātmyaṃ vasiṣṭhoktaṃ dvijottama ||2||
kathameṣāmahā-puṇyānadī sarva-traviśrutā |
narmadānāmavikhyātātanmamabrūhinārada ||3||
narmadāsaritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarva-pāpapraṇāśinī |
tārayet sarva-bhūtānisthāvarāṇicarāṇi ca ||4||
narmadāyāstumāhātmyaṃ vasiṣṭhoktaṃ mayāśrutam |
puṇyākanakhalegaṅgākurukṣetresarasvatī |
grāmevāyadivāraṇyepuṇyā sarva-tranarmmadā ||6||
sadyaḥ punātigāṃ geyaṃ darśanādevanārmadam ||7||
kaliṅgadeśepaścārddheparvate'marakaṃ ṭake |
puṇyācatriṣu lokeṣu ramaṇīyāmanoramā ||8||
sadevāsuragandharvāṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ |
tapastaptvāmahā-rājasiddhiṃ caparamāṃ gatāḥ ||9||
upoṣyarajanīmekāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam ||10||
janeśvarenaraḥ snātvā piṇḍaṃ dattvā yathā vidhi |
parva tasya samaṃ tātturudrakoṭiḥ pratiṣṭhitā |
prītā tasya bhavet sarvā rudra-koṭir na saṃśayaḥ |
tatra snātvā śucir bhūtvā brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ |
pitṛ-kāryaṃ tu kurvīta vidhi-dṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||14||
āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ tasya svargetiṣṭhatipāṇḍava ||15||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇisvargaloke mahīyate |
apsarogaṇasaṃ kīrṇodivyastrīparivāritaḥ ||16||
divyagandhānuliptaś ca divyālaṃ kārabhūṣitaḥ |
dhanavāndānaśīlaś ca dhārmikaś caiva jāyate |
yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ śrūyatesariduttamā ||19||
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇiṣaṣṭikoṭyas tathaiva ca ||20||
 sarva-hiṃ sānivṛttaś ca sarva-bhūtahiterataḥ |
evaṃ sarva-samācāraḥ kṣetrapālānparivrajet ||22||
 tasya puṇya-phalaṃ rājanśṛṇuṣvāvahitohime |
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ svargemodetapāṇḍava ||23||
apsarogaṇasaṃ kīrṇedivyastrīparicārite |
divyagandhānuliptaś ca divyālaṃ kārabhūṣitaḥ ||24||
tataḥ svargātparibhraṣṭorājābhavativīryavān ||25||
gṛhaṃ salabhate caiva nānāratnavibhūṣitam |
ālekhyasahitaṃ divyaṃ dāsīdāsa-samanvitam |
mattamātaṃ gaśabdaiś ca hayānāṃ hreṣitenaca ||27||
rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmān sarva-strījanavallabhaḥ ||28||
 tasmin gṛheuṣitvātukrīḍābhoga-samanvitaḥ |
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarva-rogavivarjitaḥ ||29||
kanyāstrīṇisahasrāṇiekaikasyāpicāpare |
pṛthivyāmāsamudrāyāmīdṛśonaiva jāyate ||33||
yādṛśoyaṃ naraśreṣṭhaparvate'marakaṃ ṭake |
koṭitīrthaṃ tuvijṣeyaṃ parva tasya tupaścime ||34||
rudrojāleśvaronāmatriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ |
 tasya piṇḍapradānenasamdhyopāsanakarmaṇā ||35||
dakṣiṇenarmadāyāstukapilākhyāmahā-nadī ||36||
saralārjunasaṃ cchannānātidūrevyavasthitā |
astipuṇyāmahā-bhāgātriṣu lokeṣu viśrutā ||37||
 tatra koṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tīrthānāṃ tuyudhiṣṭhira |
purāṇeśrūyaterājan sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||38||
tasyāstīretuyevṛkṣāḥ patitāḥ kālaparyayāt |
narmadātoyasaṃyuktāstepiyānti parāṃ gatim ||39||
dvitīyātumahā-bhāgaviśalyakaraṇāśubhā |
 tatra tīrenaraḥ snātvā viśalyobhavatikṣaṇāt ||40||
yakṣarākṣasagandharvāṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ ||41||
narmadāsaṃ śritāpuṇyāviśalyānāmanāmataḥ |
utpāditāmahā-bhāgā sarva-pāpapraṇāśinī ||43||
upoṣyarajanīmekāṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam ||44||
kapilācaviśalyācaśrūyaterājasattama |
īśvareṇapurāṇoktālokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ||45||
anaśanaṃ tuyaḥ kuryāt tasmin tīrthenarādhipa ||46||
narmadāyāṃ tu rājendrapurāṇeyacchrutaṃ mayā ||47||
sarasvatyāṃ cagaṅgāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
samaṃ dānaṃ ca snānaṃ ca yathā me śaṅkaro'bravīt ||49||
parityajatiyaḥ prāṇānparvate'marakaṃ ṭake |
varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgramindraloke mahīyate ||50||
narmadāyājalaṃ puṇyaṃ phenormisamalaṃ kṛtam |
pavitraṃ śirasāvaṃ dyaṃ sarva-pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||51||
narmadā sarva-puṇyācabrahmahatyāpahāriṇī |
evaṃ puṇyācaramyācanarmadāpāṇḍu-nandana |
trayāṇāmapilokānāṃ punātyeṣāmahā-nadī ||53||
vaṭeśvaremahā-puṇyegaṅgādvāretapovane |
eteṣu sarva-sthāneṣu yerditāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ||
śrūyatedaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadodvāsasaṅgame ||54||
narmadātu na dīśreṣṭhāpuṇyāpuṇyatamātriṣu |
munibhistumahā-bhāgairvibhaktādharmakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||1||
yajṣopavītamātrāṇipravibhaktānipāṇḍava |
jaleśvaraṃ cayattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam |
tasyotpattiṃ kathayataḥ śṛṇupāṇḍavanandana ||3||
purāmunigaṇāḥ sarvesendrāś caiva marudgaṇāḥ |
stuvamānāstusamprāptā yatra devomaheśvaraḥ |
vijṣāpayanti deveśaṃ sendrāś caiva marudgaṇāḥ |
svāgataṃ tumuniśreṣṭhāḥ kimarthamihacāgatāḥ |
kiṃ duḥkhaṃ ko'nusaṃ tāpaḥ kutovābhayamāgatam ||6||
tasmādbhītāvirūpākṣatvāmevaśaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||9||
trāyasvamahatoduḥkhāddevatvaṃ hiparāgatiḥ |
evaṃ prasādaṃ deveśasarveṣāṃ kartumarhasi ||10||
yenadevāḥ suprasannāḥ sukhamedhanti śaṅkara |
etat sarvaṃ kariṣyāmimāviṣādaṃ kariṣyatha |

yeprayānti narājendravaṣcitāstenasaṃśayaḥ ||80||
tataḥ samīpataḥ sthitvānāgeśvaraṃ tapovanam ||82||
 tatra snātvā tu rājendraśucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
bahubhirnāgakanyābhiḥ krīḍatekālamakṣayam ||83||
kāleśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ kubero yatra toṣitaḥ ||84||
 tatra snātvā tu rājendraśucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
kāṣcanaṃ tu tatodadyādannaśaktyātubuddhimān ||86||
kṛṣṇapakṣecaturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret |
caitramāsetusamprāpteśukla-pakṣetrayodaśī ||90||
ayodhyāṃ tu samāsādya tīrthaṃ śakrasya viśrutam ||92||
yas tu cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa ||95||
asurāyodhitās tatra vāsudevenakoṭiśaḥ ||99||
tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ viṣṇuḥ prīto bhaved iha |
paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathā vidhi |
tatra snātvā naro rājan pitṛ-piṇḍaṃ tu dāpayet ||102||
gaja-rūpāḥ śilās tatra toya-madhye pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
tasmiṃs tu dāpayetiṃ paḍaṃ vaiśākhaituviśeṣataḥ ||103||
tṛpyanti pitaras tāvad yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī |
tatra snātvā tu rājendra viṣṇu-loke mahīyate |
narmadā-dakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ parama-śobhanam ||106||
divyaṃ varṣa-sahasraṃ tu śaṅkaraṃ paryupāsate ||107||
samādhi-parva-dagdhas tu śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |
śveta-parvopamaś caiva hutāśaḥ śukla-parvaṇi ||108||
divya-varṣa-sahasreṇa tuṣṭas teṣāṃ maheśvaraḥ ||109||
umayā sahito rudras teṣāṃ tuṣṭo vara-pradaḥ |
vimokṣayitvā tān sarvān narmadā-taṭam āsthitān ||110||
ardha-yojana-vistīrṇaṃ tīrthaṃ dikṣu samantataḥ |
tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā upavāsa-parāyaṇaḥ ||112||
snānaṃ dānaṃ ca tatraiva bhojanaṃ piṇḍa-pātanam |
agni-veśe jale vāpi athavāpi anāśane ||115||
andhona-mūle dattvā tu piṇḍaṃ caiva yathā vidhi |
puruṣo vāpi strī vāpi vased āyatane śuciḥ ||118||
satāṃ gatim avāpnoti natāṃ sarvair mahā-makhaiḥ ||119||
kṣetra-pālaṃ na paśyec ca daṇḍa-pālaṃ mahā-balam |
vṛthā tasya bhaved yātrā a dṛṣṭvā karṇa-kuṇḍalam ||121||
etat tīrtha-phalaṃ jṣātvā sarve devāḥ samāgatāḥ |
muṣcanti puṣpa-vṛṣṭiṃ tu stuvanti kusumeśvaram ||122||
bhārga veśaṃ tato gacched bhaktyā yatra ca viṣṇunā |
huṃkāritās tu devena dānavāḥ pralayaṃ gatāḥ ||1||
śukla-tīrthasya cotpattiṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ pāṇḍu-nandana ||2||
taruṇāditya-saṅkāśe tapta-kāṣcana-saṃnibhe ||3||
vajra-sphaṭika-sopāne citra-paṭṭa-śilātale |
tatrāsīnaṃ mahā-devaṃ sarva-jṣaṃ prabhum avyayam |
lokānugrāhakaṃ śāntaṃ gaṇa-vṛndaiḥ samāvṛtam ||5||
umayā sahitaṃ devaṃ mārkanḍaḥ paripṛcchati ||6||
saṃsāra-bhava-bhīto’haṃ sukhopāyaṃ bravīhi me ||7||
bhagavan bhūta-bhavyeśa sarva-pāpa-praṇāśanam |
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tad vadasva maheśvara ||8||
śṛṇu vipra mahā-bhāga sarva-śāstra-viśārada |

yamāpastamba-saṃvartāḥ kātyāyana-bṛhaspatī ||10||

darśanāt sparśanāc caiva snānād dhyānāt tapo’rjanāt |
śukla-tīrthaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ nadyāṃ tu saṃvyavasthitam |
cāṇikyo nāma rājarṣiḥ siddhiṃ tatra samāgataḥ ||14||
śukla-tīrthaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ sarva-pāpa-praṇāśanam ||15||
pādapāgreṇa dṛṣṭena brahma-hatyāṃ vyapohati |
aham atra ṛṣi-śreṣṭha tiṣṭhāmi hy umayā saha ||16||
vaiśākhe vimale māsi kṛṣṇa-pakṣe caturdaśī |
gaṇāś cāpsaraso nāgāḥ sarve devāḥ samāgatāḥ ||18||
gagana-sthās tu tiṣṭhanti vimānaiḥ sarva-kāmakaiḥ |
śukla-tīrthe tu rājendra āgatā dharma-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||19||
rajakena yathā vastraṃ śuklaṃ bhavati vāriṇā |
ājanma-saṣcitaṃ pāpaṃ śukla-tīrthe vyapohati ||20||
snānaṃ dānaṃ mahā-puṇyaṃ mārkaṇḍa ṛṣi-sattama |
śukla-tīrthāt paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||21||
pūrve vayasi karmāṇi kṛtvā pāpāni mānavaḥ |
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajṣair dānena vā punaḥ |
deva-dānena yā puṣṭir na sākratu-śatair api ||23||
kārtikasya ca māsasya kṛṣṇa-pakṣe caturdaśī |
śukla-tīrtha-paraṃ tīrtham ṛṣi-siddha-niṣevitam ||25||
jāgaraṃ kārayet tatra nṛtya-gītādi-maṅgalaiḥ |
ācāryaṃ bhojayet paścāc chiva-vrata-paraḥ śuciḥ |
bhojanaṃ ca yathā śaktyā vitta-śāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ||28||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śanair devāntikaṃ vrajet |
evaṃ vai kurute yas tu tasya puṇya-phalaṃ śṛṇu ||29||
divya-yāna-samārūḍhaḥ stūyamāno'psaro-gaṇaiḥ |
śukla-tīrthe tu yā nārī dadāti kanakaṃ śubham |
ghṛtena snāpayed devaṃ kumāraṃ cābhipūjayet ||31||
evaṃ yā kurute bhaktyā tasyāḥ puṇya-phalaṃ śṛṇu |
ayane vā caturdaśyāṃ saṅkrāntau viṣuve tathā |
snātvā tu sopavāsaḥ sa nirjitātmā samāhitaḥ ||33||
dānaṃ dadyād yathā śaktyā prīyetāṃ hari-śaṅkarau |
śukla-tīrtha-prabhāveṇa sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||34||
anāthaṃ durgataṃ vipraṃ nāthavantam athāpi vā |

tāvad varṣa-sahasrāṇi śiva-loke mahīyate ||36||
asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ pāṇḍu-nandana |
vilayaṃ yānti sarvāṇi rūpavān jāyate naraḥ |
go-tīrthaṃ tu tato gacched dṛṣṭvā pāpāt pramucyate ||3||
jyeṣṭha-māse tu samprāpte caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sa-ghṛtaṃ śrī-phalaṃ dattvā kṛtvācānte pradakṣiṇam ||6||
ghaṇṭābharaṇa-saṃyuktāṃ kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati |
aṅgāraka-dine prāpte caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
snāpayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā brāhmaṇebhyas tu bhojanam ||8||
aṅgāraka-navamyāṃ tu amāvasyāṃ tathaiva ca |
puṣpakeṇa vimānena sahasraiḥ parivāritaḥ ||10||
śaivaṃ padam avāpnoti nātra cābhigataṃ bhavet |
rājā bhavati dharmiṣṭho rūpavān jāyate balī ||12||
tṛṇa-bindu ṛṣir nāma śāpa-dagdho vyavasthitaḥ ||13||
śrāvaṇe māsi samprāpte kṛṣṇa-pakṣe caturdaśīm |
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate ca ṛṇa-trayāt |
akāmo vā sa-kāmo vā tatra snātvā tu mānavaḥ |
ājanma-janitaiḥ pāpair mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||17||
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate ca ṛṇa-trayāt ||18||
prayāge yat phalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śaṅkareṇa mahātmanā |

daśāśvamedhikaṃ nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ||20||
upoṣya rajanīm ekāṃ māsi bhādrapade tathā |
amāvasyāṃ naraḥ snātvā vrajed vai yatra śaṅkaraḥ ||21||

daśāśvamedhāt paścimato bhṛgur brāhmaṇa-sattamaḥ |
divyaṃ varṣa-sahasraṃ tu īśvaraṃ paryupāsata ||23||
valmīkāvasthitaś cāsau dakṣiṇaṃ ca niketanam |
āś ca ryaṃ ca mahaj-jātam umāyāḥ śaṅkarasya ca ||24||
bhṛgur nāma dvija-śreṣṭha ṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro muniḥ |
tatra prahasitā devī īśvaraṃ pratyabhāṣata |

evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇas tu kutra gacchasi bho vṛṣa |
adya tvām atha pāpmānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ hanamy ahaṃ vṛṣa ||32||
dharṣitas tu tadā vipro hy antarīkṣaṃ gataṃ vṛṣam |
tṛtīyaṃ locanaṃ dṛṣṭvā vailakṣyātpatito bhuvi ||34||
praṇipatyabhūtanāthaṃ bhavodbhavaṃ tvāmahaṃ divyarūpam ||
tvadguṇanikarānvaktuṃ kaḥ śaktobhavatimānuṣonātha |
yamaniyamayajṣadānairvedābhyāsāvadhāraṇodyogāt |

alīkābhimānadagdhaṃ kṣaṇabhaṃ guravibhavavilasitaṃ deva |
krūraṃ kupathābhimukhaṃ patitaṃ māṃ trāhideveśa ||43||
dīnendriyagaṇasārthairbandhujanair evapūritāāśā |
tucchā tathā piśaṅkarakiṃ mūḍhaṃ māṃ viḍambayasi ||44||

chiṃ dhimadamohapāśānuttārayamāṃ mahā-deva ||45||
bhṛgur uvāca—
tadāprabhṛtibrahmādyāḥ sarvedevāḥ sakinnarāḥ |
upāsanto bhṛgostīrthaṃ tuṣṭo yatra maheśvaraḥ ||50||

guhyātiguh yasya gatisteṣāṃ niḥ saṃ śayābhavet |
etatkṣetraṃ suvipulaṃ sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam ||52||
 tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti yemṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ |
aupānahaṃ tadāchatraṃ deyamannaṃ cakāṣcanam ||53||

bhṛgutīrthasyamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotinaraḥ sakṛt |
 tatra snātvā naro rājannupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||58||
narmadāyāṃ sthitaṃ rājan sarva-pātaka-nāśanam |
 tasmin tīrthe mahā-rājaprāṇatyāgaṃ karotiyaḥ |
kālenamahatāprāptaḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet ||62||
prayāgeyatphalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mārkaṇḍeyenabhāṣitam ||63||
māsibhādrapade caiva śukla-pakṣasyacāṣṭamīm ||64||
upoṣyarajanīmekāṃ tatra snānaṃ samācaret |
hiraṇyadvīpavikhyātaṃ sarva-pāpapraṇāśanam ||66||
vikhyātaṃ sarva-lokeṣu yoginī tatra tiṣṭhati ||68||
krīḍateyogibhiḥ sārdhaṃ śivenasahanṛtyati |
īśas tatra vinirmuktogataūrdhvaṃ nasaṃśayaḥ ||70||
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāyaaciṃ tyaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||71||
varāha-tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
paurṇimāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa tatra snānaṃ samācaret ||73||
praṇipatyacaīśānaṃ balis tasya prasīdati |
 tasmin sthānenivāsaṃ caviṣṇuḥ śaṅkaramabravīt |

tatra vaidīyatedānaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||79||
aparapakṣeamāvāsyāṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret |

akāmovāsakāmovā tatra snāyītamānavaḥ ||81||

 kathaṃ revājalasparśādvipākācchāpasambhavāt |

śrutvānānāvidhāndharmāndharmavyatikarāṃ s tathā ||6||
śrīnārada uvāca—
 kathaṃ tasya vināśaḥ syāducyatāṃ bhagavatpriya ||7||
śrīsanatkumāra uvāca—
śṛṇunāradagoviṃ dapriyagoviṃ dadharmavit |
yatpṛṣṭaṃ lokanirmuktikāraṇaṃ tamasaḥ param ||8||
sarvācāravivarjitāḥ śaṭhadhiyovrātyājagadvaṣcakāḥ |
daṃ bhāhaṃ kṛtipānapaiśunaparāḥ pāpāścayeniṣṭhurāḥ ||9||

sarvāparādhakṛdapimucyateharisaṃ śrayaḥ |
harerapyaparādhānyaḥ kuryāddvipadapāṃ sanaḥ ||12||
nāmāśrayaḥ kadācitsyāttaratyevasanāmataḥ |
śrīnārada uvāca—
kete'parādhāvipreṃ dranāmnobhagavataḥ kṛtāḥ |
vinighnanti nṛṇāṃ kṛtyaṃ prākṛtaṃ hyānayanti ca ||14||
śrīsanatkumāra uvāca—
satāṃ niṃ dānāmnaḥ paramamaparādhaṃ vitanute |
śubhasyaśrīviṣṇoryaihaguṇanāmādisakalaṃ |
guroravajṣāśrutiśāstraniṃ danaṃ tathā rthavādoharināmnikalpanam |
aśraddadhānovimukho'pyaśṛṇvanyaścopadeśaḥ śivanāmāparādhaḥ ||17||
śrutvāpināmamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ prītirahito'dhamaḥ |
evaṃ nāradaśaṃ kareṇakṛpayāmahyaṃ munīnāṃ paraṃ |
yejṣātvāpinavarjayanti sahasānāmno'parādhāndaśa |
śrīnārada uvāca—
sanatkumārapriyasāhasānāṃ vivekavairāgyavivarjitānām |
dehapriyārthātmaparāyaṇānāṃ muktāparādhāḥ prabhavanti naḥ katham ||21||
śrīsanatkumāra uvāca—
jātenāmāparādhetupramādetu kathaṃ cana |
sadāsaṃ kīrtayannāmatadekaśaraṇobhavet ||22||

aviśrāṃ tiprayuktānitānyevārthakarāṇiyat ||23||

nikṣaptaṃ syānnaphalajanakaṃ śīghramevātravipra ||24||
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ purānāradaśaṃ karāt |
śrutaṃ sarvāśubhaharamaparādhanivārakam ||25||

teṣāmapibhavenmuktiḥ paṭhanādevanārada ||26||

 tasya sākṣātprasannaḥ syācchivoviṣṇuścasānugaḥ ||28||

purāṇavācakaṃ vipraṃ pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ |
kāṃ syairvinirmitaṃ pātraṃ jalapātraṃ mudānvitaḥ |
karṇakuṇḍalakaṃ caiva mudrikāṃ svarṇanirmitām ||34||
āsanaṃ tu tathā dadyātpuṣpamālyaṃ tapodhana |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ nakurvītadānaṃ hīnaphalaṃ yataḥ ||35||
purāṇaṃ vācayedvipra sarva-kāmārthasiddhaye |
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ puṣpamālyaṃ tucaṃ danam ||36||
teṣāṃ nāmāniliṃ petacitragupto'rcanāddvija ||37||
pratijṣāpālanepuṇyaṃ khaṇḍanekiṃ cakilbiṣam ||1||
dakṣiṇaṃ kiGkaraṃ datvākṛpāṃ kṛtvākṛpārṇava ||2||

vaiṣṇavānāṃ tvamagryo'si sarva-lokahiterataḥ ||3||

tāvaddahativaigātraṃ viṣṇorvaṃ śonalupyate ||7||

 tasya prāptirbhavetkṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||11||
tāvannakuryātpitaraḥ prāpnuvanti cayātanām ||12||

uddhāraṃ koṭipuruṣairmṛtoyātinasaṃ śayaḥ ||13||
kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ purākasyakarasyapratipālanāt |
dakṣiṇasya mune brūhi śrotum icchāmi sādarāt ||14||
purākiṃ citpureśūdronāmnāsīdvīravikramaḥ |
bahvāśīpṛthulāṃ gaś ca bahuvaktātisuṃ daraḥ ||15||
viprāṇāmatithīnāṃ capūjakaḥ sarva-daivatu ||16||
pitṛbhaktodvija-śreṣṭhapratijṣāpālakaḥ sadā |
vācāṃ gurujanānāṃ capālakoharisevakaḥ ||17||
prāptodhṛtvābrāhmaṇasyarūpaṃ vaitaruṇaḥ sudhīḥ ||18||
śṛṇumevacanaṃ dhīramamajāyāmṛtāśubhā |
vivāhaṃ yojanaḥ kuryādbrāhmaṇaṃ caviśeṣataḥ |
kiṃ cadānaiḥ kiṃ catīrthaiḥ kiṃ yajṣairvratakoṭibhiḥ ||20||
śṛṇumevacanaṃ brahmanbālāstimamakanyakā ||21||
nayamedakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ dāsyāmicān yathā nahi ||22||
 tasya itadvacanaṃ śrutvājagrāhadakṣiṇaṃ karam |
kṛtvāśubhakṣaṇaṃ mahyaṃ dehikanyāṃ śubhānvitām |
vilaṃ bebahuvighnaṃ syāditiśāstreṣu niścitam ||24||
tubhyaṃ śvaḥ kanyakāṃ brahmandāsyāmināsticān yathā |
dakṣiṇaṃ cakaraṃ datvānakuryātpuruṣādhamaḥ ||25||
brāhmaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaśarmāṇaṃ cāhūyākathayanmune |
 kathaṃ viprāyatekanyāṃ śūdrāyadātumicchasi |
ajṣātāyākulīnāyanadadasvaviśeṣataḥ ||27||
asmākaṃ vacanaṃ tātaśṛṇuṣvavīravikrama ||28||
najṣāyatekulaṃ yasya deśagotradhanaṃ tathā |
sa uvāca—dvija-śreṣṭhadattaṃ medakṣiṇaṃ karam |
ityuktvātānsaviprāyakanyāṃ dātuṃ pracakrame |
dṛṣṭvetijṣātayaḥ sarvevismayamadbhutaṃ yayuḥ ||31||
satyaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvāśaṃ khacakragadādharaḥ |
āvirbabhūvasahasācāruhyagaruḍaṃ mune ||32||
dhanyaṃ tevacanaṃ satyaṃ dhanyaṃ tedakṣiṇaṃ karam ||33||
evaṃ tekarmaṇāsādhocoddhāraṃ kuruṣekulam ||34||
evaṃ bruvatiśrīkṛṣṇevimānaṃ svarṇanirmitam |
rathecāropayāmāsaśaṃ khapadmadharaḥ svayaṃ ||36||
gṛhītvātānhariḥ sarvāngatovaikuṃ ṭhamandiram |
tasyānnaṃ tujalaṃ brahmannagrāhyaṃ pitṛdaivataiḥ |
datvāśāṃ yojanaḥ kuryānnairāśyaṃ caiva mūḍhadhīḥ |
sasvakānkoṭipuruṣāngṛhītvānarakaṃ vrajet ||40||
jīvanmuktastvihāmutrakṛṣṇākhyaṃ dhāmacottamam ||42||
||atha śrī-pādme mahā-purāṇe paṣcamaṃ pātālakhaṇḍaṃ ārabhyate||
|| śrī-gaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī-kuladevatāyai namaḥ ||
|| śrī-guru-caraṇāravindābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
rāmāśvamedha-prakaraṇaṃ
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam |
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayam udīrayet ||1||
śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahā-bhāga svarga-khaṇḍaṃ manoharam |
tvatto 'dhunāvadāyuṣmaṣchrīrāma-caritaṃ hinaḥ ||2||
athaikadā dharādhāraṃ pṛṣṭavān bhujageśvaram |
vātsyāyano munivaraḥ kathām etāṃ sunirmalām ||3||
śrī-vātsyāyana uvāca
śeṣāśeṣa-kathās tvatto jagat-sarga-layādikāḥ |
mahat-tattvādi-sṛṣṭīnāṃ pṛthak-tattva-vinirṇayaḥ |
yā śrutā saṃsmṛtā coktā mahā-pātaka-hāriṇī |
vadanti munayaḥ sarve sādhūnāṃ saṅgamaṃ varam |
yasmāt pāpa-kṣaya-karī raghunātha-kathā bhavet ||10||
tvayā me'nugrahaḥ sṛṣṭo yad rāmaḥ smāritaḥ punaḥ |
surāsura-kirīṭaugha-maṇi-nīrājitāṅghrikaḥ ||11||
rāvaṇāri-kathā-vārddhaumaśakomā dṛśaḥ kiyān |
tathāpi bho mayā tubhyaṃ vaktavyaṃ svīya-śaktitaḥ |
yeṣāṃ vai yādṛśī buddhis te vadanty eva tādṛśaṃ ||14||
jṣānenālokayāṃ cakre kathāṃ lokottarāṃ śubhāṃ ||16||
gadgada-svara-saṃyukto mahā-harṣāṅkitāṅgakaḥ |
kathayāmāsa viśadāṃ kathāṃ dāśaratheḥ punaḥ ||17||
sukhaṃ prāptāḥ stutiṃ cakrur dāsavat praṇatiṃ gatāḥ ||19||
laṅkāyāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya dharma-yuktaṃ vibhīṣaṇam |
sītayā sahito rāmaḥ puṣpakaṃ samupāśritaḥ ||20||
sugrīva-hanumat-sītā-lakṣmaṇaiḥ -saṃyutas tadā |
laṅkāṃ sa paśyan bahudhā bhagna-prākāra-toraṇām |
dṛṣṭvā 'śoka-vanaṃ tatra sītā-sthānaṃ mumūrccha ha ||22||
śiṃ śapāṃ s tatra vṛkṣāṃś ca puṣpitān korakair yutān |
rākṣasībhiḥ samākīrṇān mṛtābhir hanumad-bhayāt ||23||
itthaṃ sarvaṃ vilokyāśu rāmaḥ prāyāt purīṃ prati |

deva-dundubhi-nirghoṣāṣ chṛṇvaṣ chrotra-sukhāvahān |
tathaivāpsarasāṃ nṛtyaiḥ pūjyamāno raghūttamaḥ ||25||
tān sarvān darśayāmāsa lakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ ||27||
ity evandarśayaṃ s tasyai rāmo 'drākṣīt svakāṃ purīṃ |
tasyāḥ punaḥ samīpe tu nandi-grāmaṃ dadarśa ha ||28||
garta-śāyī brahmacārī jaṭā-valkala-saṃyutaḥ |
kṛśāṅga-yaṣṭir duḥkhārtaḥ kurvan rāma-kathāṃ muhuḥ ||30||
sītayā sukumārāṅgyā sevyamāno'ṭavīṃ gataḥ |
yā sītā puṣpa-paryaṅke vṛntam āsādya duḥkhitā ||33||
yā sītā ravi-santāpaṅkadāpi prāpa no satī |
yā sītā rāja-vṛndaiś ca na dṛṣṭā nayanaiḥ kadā |
sā sītā dṛśyate nūnaṃ kirātaiḥ kāla-rūpibhiḥ ||35||
yā sītā madhuraṃ tv annam bhojitā na bubhukṣati |
sā sītādya vanasthāni phalāni prārthayaty aho ||36||
prātaḥ prātar mahā-rājo bharato rāma-vallabhaḥ ||37||
nīti-jṣaiḥ śāstra-nipuṇair iti provāca tān nṛpaḥ ||38||
amātyā durbhagaṃ māṃ kiṃ prabrūta puruṣādhamam |
durbhagasya mama prasvāḥ pāpa-mārjanam ādarāt |
karomi rāmacandrāṅghriṃ smāraṃ smāraṃ sumantriṇaḥ ||40||
dhanyā sumitrā sutarāṃ vīrasūḥ svapati priyā |
atha tad-darśanotkaṇṭhā-vihvalī-kṛta-cetasā |
punaḥ punaḥ smṛto bhrātā bharato dhārmikāgraṇīḥ ||1||
śṛṇu vīra hanūmaṃs tvaṃ mad-giraṃ bhrātṛ-noditām |
gacchataṃ bhrātaraṃ vīra samīraṇa-tanūdbhava |
mad-viyoga-kṛśāṃ yaṣṭiṃ vapuṣo bibhrataṃ haṭhāt ||4||
phalānāṃ bhakṣaṇam api na kuryād virahāturaḥ ||5||
para-strī yasya māteva loṣṭavat kāṣcanaṃ punaḥ |
madā gamana-sandeśa-payo-vṛṣṭyāśu siṣcatam ||7||
sītayā sahitaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇena samanvitam |
sugrīvādi-kapīndraiś ca rakṣobhiḥ sa vibhīṣaṇaiḥ ||8||
ye na me so'nujaḥ śīghraṃ sukham eti mad-āgamāt ||9||
iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ raghu-vīrasya dhīmataḥ |
jagāma bharatāvāsaṃ nandi-grāmaṃ nideśa-kṛt ||10||
namaścakāra bharataṃ dharmaṃ mūrti-yutaṃ kila |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bharataḥ śīghraṃ pratyutthāya kṛtāṣjaliḥ |
svāgataṃ ceti hovāca rāmasya kuśalaṃ vada ||14||
hṛdayāc ca gataḥ śoko harṣāsraiḥ pūritānanaḥ ||15||
vilokya tādṛśaṃ bhūpaṃ praty uvāca kapīśvaraḥ |
nikaṭe hi puraḥ prāptaṃ viddhi rāmaṃ sa lakṣmaṇam ||16||
rāmāgamana-sandeśāmṛta-sikta-kalevaraḥ |
dāso’smi janma-paryantaṃ rāma-sandeśa-hārakaḥ ||18||
vasiṣṭho’pi gṛhītvārghyaṃ mantri-vṛddhāḥ suharṣitāḥ |

amātyān bhrātṛ-veṣeṇa samaveṣān jaṭā-dharān |

anasūyām ivātreḥ kiṃ lopāmudrāṃ ghaṭodbhuvaḥ |
mātaḥ kṣamasva yad aghaṃ mayā kṛtam abuddhinā |

jaharṣa matimān vīraś cira-darśana-lālasaḥ ||1||

dhautottarīya-valitā jagmuḥ śrī-raghu-nāyakam ||16||

saṅgrāme bahuśo vīrā jetāro yayur apy amum ||17||

svakaṃ vastu-samādāya yayuḥ śrī-rāma-bhūpatim ||20||

nānā-kautuka-saṃyuktā ājagmur manujeśvaram ||21||

sva-sva-śobhā-parītāṅgāś cānujagmuḥ purottamam ||23||
puṣpakād avaruhyāśu nara-yānam athāruhat |
sītayā sahito rāmaḥ parivāra-samāvṛtaḥ ||24||
ayodhyāṃ praviveśātha kṛta-kautuka-toraṇām |
hṛṣṭa-puṣṭa-janākīrṇām utsavaiḥ parībhūṣitām ||25||
vīṇā-paṇava-bheryādi-vāditrair āhatair bhṛśam |

adhiṣṭhātā'tra gopālo dhenu-pālana-tat-paraḥ |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ dalaṃ yad ākhyātaṃ tatra nanda-vanaṃ smṛtam ||43||
saptamaṃ bakulāraṇyaṃ dalaṃ ramyaṃ prakīrtitam |
tatrāṣṭamaṃ tāla-vanaṃ tatra dhenu-vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||44||
navamaṃ kumudāraṇyaṃ dalaṃ ramyaṃ prakīrtitam |
kāmāraṇyaṃ ca daśamaṃ padhānaṃ sarva-kāraṇam ||45||
kṛṣṇa-krīḍā-rasa-sthānaṃ pradhānaṃ dalam ucyate ||46||
dalam ekādaśaṃ proktaṃ bhaktānugraha-kāraṇam |
bhāṇḍīraṃ dvādaśa-dalaṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam |
kṛṣṇaḥ krīḍā-ratas tatra śrī-dāmādibhir āvṛtaḥ ||48||
trayodaśaṃ dalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatra bhadra-varaṃ smṛtam |
śrī-vanaṃ tatra ruciraṃ sarvaiśvaryasya kāraṇam |
kṛṣṇa-krīḍā-dala-mayaṃ śrī-kānti-kīrti-vardhanam ||50||
dalaṃ paṣcadaśaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatra loha-vanaṃ smṛtam |
kathitaṃ ṣoḍaśa-dalaṃ māhātmyaṃ karṇikā-samam ||51||
bāla-krīḍā-ratas tatra vatsa-pālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||52||
adhiṣṭhātā tatra bāla-gopālaḥ paṣcamābdikaḥ ||53||
nāmnā dāmodaraḥ proktaḥ premānanda-rasārṇavaḥ |
dalaṃ prasiddham ākhyātaṃ sarva-śreṣṭha-dalottamam ||54||
kṛṣṇa-krīḍā ca kiṣjalkī vihāra-dalam ucyate |
pārvaty uvāca—
vṛndāraṇyasya māhātmyaṃ rahasyaṃ vā kim adbhutam |
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ yad durlabhānāṃ ca durlabham ||57||
brahmādi-vāṣchitaṃ sthānaṃ sura-siddhādi-sevitam ||58||
yogīndrā hi sadā bhaktyā tasya dhyānaika-tat-parāḥ |
śrīmad-vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ pūrṇānanda-rasāśrayam |
bhūri-cintāmaṇis toyam amṛtaṃ rasa-pūritam ||60||
vṛkṣaṃ guru-drumaṃ tatra surabhī-vṛnda-sevitam |
strīṃ lakṣmīṃ puruṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ tad-daśāṃśa-samudbhavam ||61||
gati-nāṭyaṃ kalālāpa-smita-vaktraṃ nirantaram ||62||
śuddha-sattvaiḥ prema-pūrṇair vaiṣṇavais tad-vanāśritam |
bhujaṅga-śatru-nṛtyāḍhyaṃ sakalāmoda-vibhramam |
nānā-varṇaiś ca kusumais tad-reṇu-paripūritam ||65||
pūrṇendu-nityābhyudayaṃ sūrya-mandāṃśusevitam |
pūrṇānandāmṛta-rasam pūrṇa-prema-sukhārṇavam ||67||
guṇātītaṃ mahad-dhāma pūrṇa-prema-svarūpakam |
vṛkṣādi-pulakair yatra premānandāśru-varṣitam ||68||
govindāṅghri-rajaḥ sparśān nityaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ bhuvi ||69||
sahasra-dala-padmasya vṛndāraṇyaṃ varāṭakam |
vṛndāvana-vihāreṣu kṛṣṇaṃ kaiśora-vigraham ||73||
kālindī cākarod yasya karṇikāyāṃ pradakṣiṇām |
līlā-nirvāṇa-gambhīraṃ jalaṃ saurabha-mohanam ||74||
cakravākādi-vihagair maṣju-nānā-kala-svanaiḥ |
śobhamānaṃ jalaṃ ramyantaraṃ gāti-manoramam ||76||
tasyobhaya-taṭī-ramyā śuddha-kāṣcana-nirmitā |
gaṅgā-koṭi-guṇā proktā yatra sparśa-varāṭakaḥ ||77||
karṇikāyāṃ koṭi-guṇo yatra krīḍā-rato hariḥ |
kālindī-karṇikā kṛṣṇam abhinnam eka-vigraham ||78||
pārvaty uvāca—
madhye vṛndāvane ramye-maṣju-maṣjīra-śobhite |

divya-vraja-vayo-rūpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vṛndāvaneśvaram |
anādim ādiṃ sarveṣāṃ nanda-gopa-priyātmajam ||85||
paraṃ dhāma paraṃ rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ gokuleśvaram ||86||
suśrīmantaṃ navaṃ svacchaṃ śyāma-dhāma manoharam ||87||
navīna-nīrada-śreṇī-susnigdhaṃ maṣju-kuṇḍalam |
dalitāṃ jana-puṣjābha-cikkaṇaṃ śyāma-mohanam |
tad-ūrdhvaṃ dakṣiṇe kāle śyāma-cūḍā-manoharam |
nānā-varṇojjvalaṃ rājac-chikhaṇḍi-dala-maṇḍitam ||90||
mandāra-maṣju-go-pucchā-cūḍaṃ cāru-vibhūṣaṇam |
kvacid bṛhad-dala-śreṇī-mukuṭenābhimaṇḍitam ||91||
aneka-maṇi-māṇikya-kirīṭa-bhūṣaṇaṃ kvacit |
lolālaka-vṛtaṃ rājat-koṭi-candra-samānanam ||92||
kastūrī-tilakaṃ bhrājan-maṣju-go-rocanānvitam |
ānṛtyad-bhrū-latāśleṣa-smitaṃ sāci-nirīkṣaṇam |

vilasad-divya-māṇikyaṃ maṣju-kāṣcana-miśritam |
kare kaṅkaṇa-keyūraṃ kiṅkiṇī-kaṭi-śobhitam ||98||

gorocanādi-saṃmiśra-divyāṅga-rāga-citritam |

dhvaja-vajrāṅkuśāmbhoja-karāṅghri-tala-śobhitam |
nakhendu-kiraṇa-śreṇī-pūrṇa-brahmaika-kāraṇam ||102||
tad-daśāṃśaṃ mahā-viṣṇuṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||103||
tri-bhaṅgaṃ lalitāśeṣa-nirmāṇa-sāra-nirmitam ||104||
vāmāṃsārpita-sad-gaṇḍa-sphurat-kāṣcana-kuṇḍalam ||105||
paramaṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ govindākhyaṃ mahat-padam ||107||
vṛndāvaneśvaraṃ nityaṃ nirguṇasyaika-kāraṇam |
tan-māhātmyaṃ kiyad devi procyate tvaṃ mudā śṛṇu |
tat-kalā-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśā brahma-viṣṇu-maheśvarāḥ |
sṛṣṭi-sthity-ādinā yuktās tiṣṭhanti tasya vaibhavāḥ ||111||
tad-rūpa-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśāḥ kalāḥ kandarpa-vigrahāḥ |
jagan-mohaṃ prakurvanti tad-aṇḍāntara-saṃsthitāḥ ||112||
tad-deha-vilasat-kānti-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśako vibhuḥ |
tat-prakāśasya koṭy-aṃśa-raśmayo ravi-vigrahāḥ ||113||
tasya sva-deha-kiraṇaiḥ parānanda-rasāmṛtaiḥ |
paramāmoda-cid-rūpair nirguṇasyaika-kāraṇaiḥ ||114||
tad-aṃśa-koṭi-koṭy-aṃśā jīvanti kiraṇātmakāḥ |
āhuḥ pūrṇa-brahmaṇo’pi kāraṇaṃ veda-durgamam |
tad-aṃśa-saurabhānanta-koṭy-aṃśo viśva-mohanaḥ ||116||
tat-priyā prakṛtis tv ādyā rādhikā kṛṣṇa-vallabhā ||117||
pārvaty uvāca—
yad-ākarṇanam etasya ye vā pāriṣadāḥ prabhoḥ |
pūrvokta-rūpa-lāvaṇyaṃ divya-bhūṣāmbara-srajam ||2||
tad-bāhye yoga-pīṭhe ca svarṇa-siṃhāsanāvṛte ||3||
pratyaṅga-rabhasāveśāḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ |
lalitādyāḥ prakṛty-aṃśā mūla-prakṛtī rādhikā ||4||
saṃmukhe lalitā devī śyāmalā vāyu-koṇake |
uttare śrīmatī dhanyā aiśānyāṃ śrī-hari-priyā ||5||
viśākhā ca tathā pūrve śaibyā cāgnau tataḥ param |
padmā ca dakṣiṇe paścān nair ṛte kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ ||6||
yoga-pīṭhe kesarāgre cāru candrāvatī priyā |
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ puṇyāḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ ||7||
pradhāna-prakṛtis tv ādyā rādhā candrāvatī samā |
priyā ca śrī-madhumatī candrarekhā haripriyā |
ṣoḍaśādyāḥ prakṛtayaḥ pradhānāḥ kṛṣṇa-vallabhāḥ ||9||
vṛndāvaneśvarī rādhā tathā candrāvalī priyā |
abhinna-guṇa-lāvaṇya-saundaryāś cāru-locanāḥ ||10||
manoharā mugdha-veṣāḥ kiśorī-vayasojjvalāḥ |
agretanās tathā cānyā gopa-kanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||11||
śuddha-kāṣcana-puṣjābhāḥ suprasannāḥ sulocanāḥ |
tad-rūpa-hṛdayārūḍhās tad-āśleṣasam utsukāḥ ||12||
śyāmāmṛta-rase magnāḥ sphurat-tad-bhāva-mānasāḥ |
netrotpalārcite kṛṣṇa-pādābje'rpita-cetasaḥ ||13||
śruti-kanyās tato dakṣe sahasrāyuta-saṃyutāḥ |
jagan-mugdhīkṛtākārā hṛd-varti-kṛṣṇa-lālasāḥ ||14||
nānā-sattva-svarālāpa-mugdhīkṛta-jagat-trayāḥ |
tatra gūḍha-rahasyāni gāyantyaḥ prema-vihvalāḥ ||15||
deva-kanyās tataḥ savye divya-veṣā rasojjvalāḥ |
nānā-vaidigadhya-nipuṇā divya-bhāva-bharānvitāḥ ||16||
saundaryātiśayenāḍhyāḥ kaṭākṣāti-manoharāḥ |
tad-bhāva-magna-manasaḥ smita-sāci-nirīkṣaṇāḥ |
samāna-veṣa-vayasaḥ samāna-bala-pauruṣāḥ |
samāna-guṇa-karmāṇaḥ samānābharaṇa-priyāḥ ||19||
samāna-svara-saṅgīta-veṇu-vādana-tat-parāḥ |
śrīdāmā paścime dvāre vasudāmā tathottare ||20||
sudāmā ca tathā pūrve kiṅkiṇī cāpi dakṣiṇe |
tad-bāhye svarṇa-pīṭhe ca suvarṇa-mandirāvṛte ||21||
stokakṛṣṇaṃ subhadrādyair gopālair ayutāyutaiḥ ||22||
śṛṅgavīṇā-veṇu-vetra-vayo-veṣākṛti-svaraiḥ |
citrārpitaiś citra-rūpaiḥ sadānandāśru-varṣibhiḥ |
paścime saṃmukhe śrīmat-pārijāta-drumāśraye ||26||
tad-adhas tu svarṇa-pīṭhe svarṇa-maṇḍana-maṇḍite |
triguṇātīta-cid-rūpaṃ sarva-kāraṇa-kāraṇam ||28||
indranīla-ghana-śyāmaṃ nīla-kuṣcita-kuntalam |
padma-patra-viśālākṣaṃ makarākṛti-kuṇḍalam ||29||
catur-bhujaṃ tu cakrāsi-gadā-śaṃkhāmbujāyudham |
jyotī-rūpaṃ mahad-dhāma-purāṇaṃ vana-mālinam |
pītāmbara-dharaṃ snigdhaṃ divya-bhūṣaṇa-bhūṣitam ||31||
rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca nāgnajitī sulakṣaṇā ||32||
mitravindānuvindā sunandā jāmbavatī priyā |
suśīlā cāṣṭa-mahilā vāsudeva-priyās tataḥ ||33||
udbhrājitāḥ pāriṣadā vṛtayor bhakti-tatparāḥ |
tatrādhastu svarṇa-pīṭhe maṇi-maṇḍapa-maṇḍite |
īśvarasya priyānaṃ tam abhinna-guṇa-rūpiṇam ||36||
śuddha-sphaṭika-saṃkāśaṃ raktāmbuja-dalekṣaṇam |
nīla-paṭṭa-dharaṃ snigdhaṃ divya-bhūṣā-srag-ambaram ||37||
saṃtānavṛkṣamūletumaṇimandiramaṇḍitam |
asitāṃ bhojapuṣjābhamaravindadalekṣaṇam |
divyālaṅkārabhūṣābhir divya-gandhānulepanam ||41||
jaganmugdhīkṛtāśeṣasaundaryāścaryavigraham |
pūrvodyānemahā-raṇyesuradrumasamāśraye ||42||
tatrādhastusvarṇapīṭhehemama ṇḍapamaṇḍite |
divyoṣayāsamaṃ śrīmad-aniruddhaṃ jagatpatim |
sāṃ drānandaghanaśyāmaṃ susnigdhaṃ nīlakuntalam ||44||
subhrūnnatalatābhaṃ gīṃ sukapolaṃ sunāsikam |
kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ kaṇṭhabhūṣāvibhūṣitam |
priyabhṛtyagaṇārādhyaṃ yatra saṅgītakapriyam |
tasyodrdhvecāntarikṣecaviṣṇuṃ sarve śvareśvaram |
anādimādicidrūpaṣcidānandaṃ paraṃ vibhum ||48||
nīlakuṣcitasusnigdhakeśapāśātisundaram |
kirīṭakuṇḍalodgaṇḍaśuddhasatvātmabhir vṛtam |
ātmārāmaiścacidrūpaistanmūrtidhyānatatparaiḥ ||51||
hṛdayārūḍhataddhyānair nāsāgranyastalocanaiḥ |
kriyate'haitukībhaktiḥ kāyahṛdvṛttibhāṣitaiḥ ||52||
sukāntair apsaraḥ saṅghair nṛtyasaṅgītatatparaiḥ ||53||
tadaṃ gabhajanaṃ kāmaṃ vāṃ chadbhiḥ kṛṣṇalālasaiḥ |
tadagrevaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvaiścāntarikṣesukhāsane ||54||
prahlādanāradādyaiścakumāraśukavaiṣṇavaiḥ |
mantracūḍāmaṇiḥ proktaḥ sarvamantraikakāraṇam |
sarvakaiśoramantrāṇāṃ hetuścūḍāmaṇirmanuḥ |
japaṃ kurvanti manasāpūrṇapremasukhāśrayāḥ ||58||
kuṅkumaiḥ sitaraktādyaiścaturdikṣusamākulaiḥ |
śuklaṃ caturbhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ paścimedvārapālakam ||60||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-padmakirīṭādivibhūṣitam |
kirīṭa-kuṇḍaloddīpta-dvāra-pālakam uttare |
gauraṃ catur-bhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ śuṅkha-cakra-gadāyudham ||62||
kirīṭa-kuṇḍalādyaiś ca śobhitaṃ vana-mālinam |
pūrva-dvāre dvāra-pālaṃ gauraṃ viṣṇuṃ prakīrtitam ||63||
kṛṣṇa-varṇaṃ catur-bāhuṃ śaṃkha-cakrādi-bhūṣaṇam |
dakṣiṇa-dvāra-pālaṃ tu śrī-viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇa-varṇakam ||64||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caritaṃ hy etad yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ śuciḥ |
śṛṇuyād vāpi yo bhaktyā govinde labhate ratim ||65||
śrī-devy uvāca—
tvayānukaṃ pitaivāhaṃ bhūyo’py āhānukaṃ payā |
ekadāvādayanvīṇāṃ nāradomunipuṅgavaḥ |
kṛṣṇāvatāramājṣāyaprayayaunandagokulam ||4||

bhavabrahmādayo 'p yasmin ratiṃ vāṃ cchantiśāśvatīm |

narāḥ santi na teṣāṃ vaibhavabādhābhaviṣyati |
ity uktvā nandabhavanānniṣkrāṃ tomunipuṅgavaḥ ||14||
athāsaucintayāmāsamahā-bhāgavatomuniḥ ||15||
asyakāṃ tābhagavatīlakṣmīrnārāyaṇeharau |
vidhāya gopikā-rūpaṃ krīḍārthaṃ śārṅga-dhanvanaḥ ||16||
avaśyam avatīrṇā sā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ |
vimṛśyaivaṃ muni-varo gehāni vraja-vāsinām |
praviveśātithir bhūtvā viṣṇu-buddhyā supūjitaḥ ||18||
sarveṣāṃ ballavādīnāṃ ratiṃ nanda-sute parām |
dṛṣṭvā muni-varaḥ sarvān manasā praṇanāma ha ||19||
gopālānāṃ gṛhe bālāṃ dadarśa śveta-rūpiṇīm |
sa dṛṣṭvā tarkayāmāsa ramā hy eṣān asaṃśayaḥ ||20||
dṛṣṭvā muni-varas taṃ tu rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi ||25||
padma-patra-viśālākṣaṃ sugrīvaṃ sundara-bhruvam |
cāru-dantaṃ cāru-karṇaṃ sarvāvayava-sundaram ||26||
taṃ samāśliṣya bāhubhyāṃ snehāśrūṇi vimucya ca |
tataḥ sa-gadgadaṃ prāha praṇayena mahā-muniḥ ||27||
ayaṃ śiśus te bhavitāsu sakhā rāma-kṛṣṇayoḥ |
vihariṣyati tābhyāṃ ca rātriṃ divam atandritaḥ ||28||

kanīyasī śiśor asya jaḍāndha-badhirākṛtiḥ ||30||
utsāhād vṛddhaye yāce tvāṃ varaṃ bhagavattama |
prasanna-dṛṣṭi-mātreṇa susthirāṃ kuru-bālikām ||31||
śrutvaivaṃ nārado vākyaṃ kautukākṛṣṭa-mānasaḥ |
atha praviśya bhavanaṃ luṭhantīṃ bhūtale sutām ||32||
utthāpyāṃ ke nidhāyātisneha-vihvala-mānasaḥ |
atha bhāgavata-śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇasyātipriyo muniḥ |
dṛṣṭvā tasyāḥ paraṃ rūpam adṛṣṭāśrutam adbhutam ||34||
abhūt pūrva-samaṃ mugdho hari-premā mahā-muniḥ |
mahā-vismayam āpannas tūṣṇīm eva sthito'bhavat |
bhrāntaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu mayā svacchanda-cāriṇā |
asyārūpeṇa sadṛśī dṛṣṭvā naiva ca kutracit ||38||
na ko’pi śobhā-koṭy-aṃśaḥ kutrāpy asyāvilokitaḥ ||39||
mahā-māyā bhagavatī dṛṣṭā śailendra-nandinī |
sāpy asyāḥ sukumārāṅgī lakṣmīṃ nāpnoti karhicit |
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī kānti-vidyādyāś ca vara-striyaḥ ||41||
chāyām api spṛśanty asyāḥ kadācin naiva dṛśyate |
viṣṇor yan mohinī-rūpaṃ haro yena vimohitaḥ ||42||
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca tad api kuto'syāḥ sadṛśaṃ bhavet |
tato 'syās tattvam ājṣātuṃ na me śaktiḥ kathaṣcana ||43||
anye cāpi na jānanti prāyeṇaināṃ hareḥ priyām |
asyāḥ sandarśanād eva govinda-caraṇāmbuje ||44||
kṛṣṇasya sambhavaty asyā rūpaṃ parama-tuṣṭaye |
nibhṛte parituṣṭāva bālikāṃ divya-rūpiṇīm |
mahā-mohana-divyāṅgi mahā-mādhurya-varṣiṇi |
mahādbhuta-rasānanda-śithilī-kṛta-mānase ||48||
sṛṣṭi-sthiti-samāhāra-rūpiṇī tvam adhiṣṭhitā |
tattvaṃ viśuddha-sattvāśu-śaktir vidyātmikā-parā ||52||
paramānanda-sandohaṃ dadhatī vaiṣṇavaṃ param |
yogīndrāṇāṃ dhyāna-pathaṃ na tvaṃ spṛśasi karhicit |
icchā-śaktir jñāna-śaktiḥ kriyā-śaktis taveśituḥ ||54||
tavāṃśa-mātram ity evaṃ manīṣā me pravartate |
māyā-vibhūtayo'cintyās tan māyārbhaka-māyinaḥ ||55||
pareśasya mahā-viṣṇos tāḥ sarvās te kalākalāḥ |
ānanda-rūpiṇī śaktis tvam īśvari na saṃśayaḥ ||56||
tvayā ca krīḍate kṛṣṇo nūnaṃ vṛndāvane vane |
kaumāreṇaiva rūpeṇa tvaṃ viśvasya ca mohinī ||57||
tāruṇya-vayasā spṛṣṭaṃ kīdṛk te rūpam adbhutam |
kīdṛśaṃ tava lāvaṇyaṃ līlā-hāsekṣaṇānvitam ||58||
hari-mānuṣa-lobhena vapur āścarya-maṇḍitam |
draṣṭuṃ tad aham icchāmi rūpaṃ te hari-vallabhe ||59||
yena nanda-sutaḥ kṛṣṇo mohaṃ samupayāsyati |
idānīṃ mama kāruṇyān nijaṃ rūpaṃ maheśvari ||60||
mahā-māheśvarīṃ natvāmahā-nandamayīṃ parām |
mahā-prema-tarotkaṇṭhā-vyākulāṅgīṃ śubhekṣaṇām ||62||
īkṣamāṇena govindam evaṃ varṇayatā sthitam |
jaya kṛṣṇa mano-hāriṣ jaya vṛndāvana-priya ||63||
jaya kuṅkuma-liptāṅga jaya ratna-vibhūṣaṇa |
kadāhaṃ tvat-prasādena anayā divya-rūpayā ||65||
sahitaṃ nava-tāruṇya mano-hāri-vapuḥ śriyā |
evaṃ kīrtayatas tasya tat-kṣaṇād eva sā punaḥ |
catur-daśābda-vayasā saṃmitaṃ lalitaṃ param |
samānavayasaś cānyās tadaiva vraja-bālikāḥ ||68||
āgatya veṣṭayāmāsur divya-bhūṣāmbara-srajaḥ |
munīndraḥ sa tu niśceṣṭo babhūvāścarya-mohitaḥ ||69||
bālāyās tās tadā sakhyaś caraṇāmbu-kaṇair munim |
niṣicya bodhayāmāsur ūcuś ca kṛpayānvitāḥ ||70||
nūnam ārādhito devo bhaktānāṃ kāma-pūrakaḥ |
mahā-bhāgavataiś cānyair durdarśā durgamāpi ca |
kenāpy acintya-bhāgyena tava dṛṣṭi-pathaṃ gatā |
enāṃ pradakṣiṇī-kṛtya namaskuru punaḥ punaḥ |
kiṃ na paśyasi cārvaṅgīm atyanta-vyākulām iva ||75||
asminn eva kṣaṇe nūnam antardhānaṃ gamiṣyati |
nānayā saha saṃlāpaḥ kathaṣcit te bhaviṣyati ||76||
kiṃ tu vṛndāvane kāpi bhāty aśoka-latā śubhā ||77||
sarva-kāle'pi puṣpāḍhyā sarva-dig-vyāpi saurabhā |
tan-mūle hy ardha-rātre ca drakṣyasy asmān aśeṣataḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tāsāṃ sneha-vihvala-cetasām ||79||
yāvat pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamed daṇḍavan muniḥ |
muhūrta-dvitayaṃ bālāṃ nānā-nirmāṇa-śobhanām ||80||

evaṃ prabhāvā bāleyaṃ na sādhyā daivatair api ||81||

adya enāṃ varārohāṃ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣaṇām ||83||

tad-rūpam eva saṃsmṛtya praviṣṭo gahanaṃ vanam |

pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathānyāś ca vicitrābharaṇa-srajaḥ ||87||

suvinītatamaṃ prāha tatra iva karuṇānvitā |

tadekāgramanābhūtvāśṛṇudevivarānane |
āsīdugratapānāmamunirekodṛḍhavrataḥ ||1||
sāgnikohyagnibhakṣaś ca cacārātyadbhutaṃ tapaḥ |
jajāpaparamaṃ jāpyaṃ mantraṃ paṣcadaśākṣaram ||2||
kāmamantreṇapuṭitaṃ kāmaṃ kāmavarapradāt |
kṛṣṇāyetipadaṃ svāhāsahitaṃ siddhidaṃ param ||3||
dadhyaucaśyāmalaṅkṛṣṇaṃ rāsonmattaṃ varotsukam |

svedāṃ bhaḥ kaṇasaṃsiktalalāṭavalitānanam |

 tathāpi śūnyamātmānaṃ manyekṛṣṇaratiṃ vinā ||32||

dyotamānādiśaḥ sarvāḥ kurvatīvidyudujjvalāḥ |
pradhānaṃ yābhagavatīyayāsarvamidaṃ tatam ||14||
sṛṣṭisthityantar- ūpāyāvidyāvidyātrayīparā |
svarūpāśaktirupācamāyārūpācacinmayī ||15||
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dehakāraṇakāraṇam |
carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ yanmāyāpariraṃ bhitam ||16||
vṛndāvaneśvarīnāmnārādhādhātrānukāraṇāt |
tāmāliṅgyavasaṃtaṃ taṃ mudāvṛndāvaneśvaram ||17||
anyonyacumbanāśleṣamadāveśavighūrṇitam |
dhyāyedevaṃ kṛṣṇadevaṃ sacasiddhimavāpnuyāt ||18||
yojapecchṛṇuyādvāpisamahātmāsudurllabhaḥ ||19||
rāiṃ dhakācitrarekhācacandrāmadanasundarī |
śrī-priyāśrīmad-humatīśaśirekhāharipriyā ||20||
suvarṇaśobhāsaṃmohāpremaromāṃ carājitā |
vaivarṇyasveda-saṃyuktābhāvāsaktāpriyaṃ vadā ||21||
suvarṇamālinīśāṃ tāsurāsarasikā tathā |
sarvastrījīvanādīnavatsalāvimalāśayā ||22||
nipītanāmapīyūṣāsārādhāparikīrtitā |
sudīrghasmita-saṃyuktātaptacāmīkaraprabhā ||23||
mūrcchatpremanadīrādhāvaraṇālocanāṃ janā |
māyāmātsarya-saṃyuktādānasāmrājyajīvanā ||24||
suratotsavasaṅgrāmācitrarekhāprakīrtitā |
gaurāṃ gīnātidīrghācasadāvādanatatparā ||25||
dainyānurāganaṭanāmūrcchāromāṃ cavihvalā |
haridakṣiṇapārśvasthāsarvamantrapriyā tathā ||26||
anaṃ galobhamādhuryācandrāsāparikīrtitā |
premadhārojjvalākīrṇādalitāṃ janaśobhanā |
kṛṣṇānurāgarasikārāsadhvanisamutsukā ||28||
ahaṃ kārasamāyuktāmukhaninditacandramāḥ |
madhurālāpacaturājitendriyaśiromaṇiḥ ||29||
viviktarāsarasikāśyāmāśyāmamanoharā ||30||
premṇāpremakaṭākṣeṇahareścittavimohanī |
jitendriyājitakrodhāsāpriyāparikīrtitā ||31||
sutaptasvarṇagaurāṃ gīlīlāgamanasundarī |
madhurālāpacaturājitendriyaśiromaṇiḥ ||33||
kīrtitāsāmadhumatīpremasādhanatatparā |
saṃmohajvararomāṃ capremadhārāsamanvitā ||34||
dānadhūlivinodācarāsadhvanimahā-naṭī |
śaśirekhācavijṣeyāgopālapreyasīsadā ||35||
kṛṣṇātmā sottamā śyāmā madhu-piGgala-locanā |
śiva-kuṇḍe śivānandā nandinī dehikā-taṭe |
rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane ||37||
devakī mathurāyāṃ tu jātā me parameśvarī |
candra-kūṭe tathā sītā vindhye vindhya-nivāsinī ||38||
vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī vimalā puruṣottame |
vṛndāvanādhipatyaṃ ca dattaṃ tasyai prasīdatā ||39||
kṛṣṇe nānyatra devī tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane |
nityānanda-tanuḥ śaurir yo'śarīrīti bhāṣyate ||40||
vāyv-agni-nāka-bhūmīnām aGgādhiṣṭhita-devatā |
tathā kānti-yutaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kālaṃ mohayati dhruvam ||42||
na tasya prākṛtīmūrtirmedomāṃ sāsthisambhavā |

ānandakiraṇevṛndavyāptaviśvakalānidhiḥ ||45||
guṇātmatātmani yathā jīvāstatkiraṇāṃ gakāḥ |
bhujadvayavṛtaḥ kṛṣṇonakadāciccaturbhujaḥ ||46||
tata eva svabhāvo’yaṃ prakṛter bhāva īśvaraḥ |
puruṣaḥ prakṛtiś cādyau rādhā-vṛndāvaneśvarau ||48||
prakṛter vikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ vinā vṛndāvaneśvaram ||49||
svarṇasyanāśonahividyate tathā matsyādināśe'pinakṛṣṇavicyutiḥ ||50||
triguṇādiprapaṣco'yaṃ vṛndāvanavihāriṇaḥ |
narādhikāsamānārīnakṛṣṇasadṛśaḥ pumān |
vayaḥ paraṃ nakaiśorātsvabhāvaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ||52||
dhyeyaṃ kaiśorakaṃ dhyeyaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam |
śyāmamevaparaṃ rūpamādidevaṃ parorasaḥ ||53||
bālyaṃ paṣcamavarṣāntaṃ paugaṇḍaṃ daśamāvadhi |
aṣṭapaṣcakakaiśoraṃ sīmāpaṣcadaśāvadhi ||54||
bālyapaugaṇḍakaiśoraṃ vayovaṃ demanoharam |
bālagopālagopālaṃ smaragopālarūpiṇam ||56||
vaṃ demadanagopālaṅkaiśorākāramadbhutam |
akhaṇḍātulapīyūṣarasānandamahā-rṇavam |
jayatiśrī-patergūḍhaṃ vapuḥ kaiśorarūpiṇaḥ ||58||
guṇatrayamatītaṃ taṃ vaṃ devṛndāvaneśvaram ||60||
sulabhaṃ vraja-nārīṇāṃ durllabhaṃ tan mumukṣuṇām |
pārvaty uvāca—
bhukti-mukti-spṛhā yāvat piśācī hṛdi vartate |
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā bhadre yan me manasi vartate |
tat sarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sāvadhānā niśāmaya ||64||
smṛtvā guṇān smaran nāma gānaṃ vāmana-raṣjanam |
bodhayaty ātmanātmānaṃ satataṃ premṇi līyate ||65||
pārvatī-śiva-saṃvāde śrī-kṛṣṇa-rūpa-varṇanaṃ nāma
pārvaty uvāca—
vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca yad dharmaṃ sarvaṃ tathyaṃ ca me vada |
yat kṛtvā mānavāḥ sarve bhavāmbhodhiṃ taranti hi ||1||
atha dvādaśadhā śuddhir vaiṣṇavānām ihocyate |
bhaktyā pradakṣiṇā caiva pādayoḥ śodhanaṃ punaḥ |
pūjārthaṃ patra-puṣpāṇāṃ bhaktyaivottolanaṃ hareḥ ||3||
karayoḥ sarva-śuddhīnām iyaṃ śuddhir viśiṣyate |
tan-nāma-kīrtanaṃ caiva guṇānām api kīrtanam ||4||
bhaktyā śrī-kṛṣṇa-devasya vacasaḥ śuddhir iṣyate |
tat-kathā-śravaṇaṃ caiva tasyotsava-nirīkṣaṇam ||5||
pādodakaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ mālānām api dhāraṇam ||6||
ucyate śirasaḥ śuddhiḥ praṇatasya hareḥ puraḥ |
āghrāṇaṃ tasya puṣpāder nirmālyasya tathā priye ||7||
viśuddhiḥ syād antarasya ghrāṇasyāpi vidhīyate |
yatra puṣpādikaṃ yac ca kṛṣṇa-pāda-yugārpitam ||8||
pūjā ca paṣcadhā proktā tāsāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ||9||
abhigamanam upādānaṃ yogaḥ svādhyāya eva ca |
ijyā-paṣca-prakārārcā krameṇa kathayāmi te ||10||
tattvābhigamanaṃ nāma devatā-sthāna-mārjanam |
upādānaṃ nāma gandha-puṣpādi-cayanaṃ tathā |
svādhyāyo nāma mantrārthānusandhā-pūrvako japaḥ |
sūkta-stotrādi-pāṭhaś ca hareḥ saṅkīrtanaṃ tathā ||13||
tattvādi-śāstrābhyāsaś ca svādhyāyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
ijyā nāma sva-devasya pūjanaṃ ca yathārthataḥ ||14||
sārṣṭi-sāmīpya-sālokya-sāyujya-sārūpya-dā kramāt ||15||
prasaṅgāt kathayiṣyāmi śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
keśavādeś caturbāhor dakṣiṇordhva-kara-kramāt ||16||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-padmī keśavākhyo gadādharaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ padma-gadā-cakra-aṅkhāyudhaiḥ kramāt ||17||
mādhavaś cakra-śaṅkhābhyāṃ padmena gadayā bhavet |
gadābja-śaṅkha-cakrī ca govindākhyo gadādharaḥ ||18||
padma-śaṅkhāri-gadine viṣṇu-rūpāya te namaḥ |
sa-śaṅkhābja-gadā-cakra-madhusūdana-mūrtaye ||19||
sāri-kaumodakī-padma-śaṅkha-vāmana-mūrtaye ||20||
cakrābja-śaṅkha-gadine namaḥ śrīdhara-mūrtaye |
hṛṣīkeśa-sārigadā-śaṅkha-padmin namo’stu te ||21||
sābja-śaṅkha-gadā-cakra-padmanābhasva-mūrtaye |
śaṅkhābja-cakra-gadine namaḥ saṅkarṣaṇāya ca |
sāri-śaṅkha-gadābjāya vāsudeva namo’stu te ||23||
namo'niruddhāya gadā-śaṅkhābjāri-vidhāriṇe ||24||
sābja-śaṅkha-gadā-cakra-puruṣottama-mūrtaye |
namo'dhokṣaja-rūpāya gadā-śaṅkhāri-padmine ||25||
nṛsiṃha-mūrtaye padma-gadā-śaṅkhāri-dhāriṇe |
sa-gadābjāri-śaṅkhāya namaḥ śrī-kṛṣṇa-mūrtaye |
śālagrāma-śilā-dvāra gata-lagna-dvi-cakra-dhṛk ||27||
śuklābha-rekhaḥ śobhāḍhyaḥ sa devaḥ śrī-gadādharaḥ |
saṅkarṣaṇo'tha pradyumnaḥ sūkṣma-cakras tu pītakaḥ |
nīlo dvāre tri-rekhaś ca atha nārāyaṇo'sitaḥ |
madhye gadākṛtī rekhā nābhi-padmaṃ mahonnatam ||30||
athavā paṣca-bindos tu pūjanaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ ||31||
nīlas tri-rekhaḥ sthūlo'tha kūrma-mūrtiḥ sa bindukaḥ ||32||
kṛṣṇaḥ sa vartulāvarta-pāṇḍuro dhṛta-pṛṣṭhakaḥ |
śrīdharaḥ paṣca-rekhaś ca vanamālī gadāṅkitaḥ ||33||
nānā-varṇān eka-mūrtināga-bhogī tv anantakaḥ ||34||
sthūlo dāmodaro nīlo madhye cakraḥ sa-nīlakaḥ |
saṅkarṣaṇa-dvārakovyād atha brahmā sulohitaḥ ||35||
sudīrgha-rekhā suṣira eka-cakrāmbujaḥ pṛthuḥ |
pṛthu-cakraḥ sthūla-chidraḥ kṛṣṇo binduś ca bindumān ||36||
hayagrīvo’ṅkuśākāraḥ paṣca-rekhaḥ sa-kaustubhaḥ |
matsyo dīrghāmbujākāro dīrgha-rekhaś ca pāṇḍuraḥ |

dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣā hi prāpyante puruṣeṇa ca ||46||
śālagrāme maṇau yantre maṇḍale pratimāsu ca |
nityaṃ tu śrī-hareḥ pūjā kevale bhavanena tu ||1||
gaṇḍakyām eka-deśe tu śālagrāma-sthalaṃ mahat |
pāṣāṇaṃ tad-bhavaṃ pātu śālagrāmam iti sthitam ||2||
śālagrāma-śilā-sparśāt koṭi-janmāgha-nāśanam |

ādau śilāṃ parīkṣeta snigdhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ca mecakām ||5||
ākṛṣṇā madhyamā proktā miśrā-miśra-phala-pradā |

pratyahaṃ dvādaśa-śilāḥ śālagrāmasya yo'rcayet ||7||

śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu gahvaraṃ lakṣate naraḥ ||8||
pitaras tasya tiṣṭhanti tṛptāḥ kalpāntakaṃ divi |
vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ tatra yatra dvārāvatī-śilā ||9||
mṛto viṣṇu-puraṃ yāti tat-tīrthaṃ yojana-trayam |

manaskāma-samābhīṣṭaṃ krośa-mātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
kīṭako’pi mṛtiṃ yāti vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ yataḥ ||11||
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ yo mūlyam udghāṭayen naraḥ |
vikretācānumaṃ tācayaḥ parīkṣānumodakaḥ ||12||
sarve tenarakaṃ yāṃ tiyāvatsūryaś ca samplavaḥ |
cakrāsanaśilākāracitsvarūponiraṃ janaḥ ||15||
namo'stvoṃ kārarūpāyasadānandasvarūpiṇe |

mūrdhnicaiva hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ capṛṣṭhataḥ |

 yathā sthāneṣu tuṣyanti devatādvādasasmṛtāḥ |

aparādhās tathā viṣṇordvātriṃ śatparikīrtitāḥ ||44||
aparādhasahasrāṇikriyaṃ te'harniśaṃ mayā |
tavāhamitimāṃ matvākṣamasvamadhusūdana ||45||
aparādhasahasrāṇikṣamatesarvadāhariḥ ||46||
sāyaṃ prātardvijātīnāṃ śrutyuktamaśanaṃ tathā |
viṣṇu-bhaktāvaśiṣṭasyadinapāpātpramucyate ||47||
annaṃ brahmārasoviṣṇuḥ khādayenmāṃ samuccaran |
alābuṃ vartulākāraṃ masūraṃ casavalkalam |
tālaṃ śuklaṃ cavṛṃ tākaṃ nakhādedvaiṣṇavonaraḥ ||49||
vaṭāśvatthārkapatreṣu kuṃ bhītiṃ dukapatrayoḥ |
kovidārekadaṃ becanakhādedvaiṣṇanonaraḥ ||50||
āśvinemāsidugdhaṃ cakārttikecāmiṣanty ajet ||51||
bījapūraṃ caśākaṃ capratyakṣalavaṇaṃ tathā ||52||
yadidaivāccabhuṃ jītatadātannāmasaṃsmaret |
haimanti kaṃ sitāsvinnandhānyaṃ mudgāstilāyavāḥ ||53||
kalāpakaṃ gunīvārāḥ śākaṃ cahilamocikā |
kālaśākaṃ cavāstūkaṃ mūlakaṃ raktaketarat ||54||
payonuddhṛtasāraṃ capanasāmraharītakī ||55||
pippalījīrakaṃ caiva nāgaraṃ gakatiṃ tiḍī |
kadalīlavalīdhātrīphalānyaguḍamaikṣavam ||56||
tulasīpatrapuṣpādyair mālyaṃ vahatiyonaraḥ ||57||
viṣṇuṃ tamapijānīyātsatyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
dhātrīvṛkṣaṃ samāropyaviṣṇutulyobhavennaraḥ ||58||
kurukṣetraṃ vijānīyātsārddhaṃ hastaśa tatra yam |
tulasīkāṣṭhaghaṭitair udrākṣākārakāritaiḥ ||59||
nirmitāṃ mālikāṃ kaṇṭhenidhāyārcanamārabhet |
 tathā malakamālāṃ casamyakpuṣkaramālikām ||60||
kaṇṭhemālāṃ cayatnena dhārayedviṣṇupūjakaḥ |
nirmālyaṃ tulasīmālāṃ śirasyapicadhārayet ||61||
lalāṭe ca gadādhāryā mūrdhni cāpaṃ śaras tathā ||62||
śaṅkha-cakrānvitovipraḥ śmaśānemriyateyadi ||63||
prayāgeyāgatiḥ proktāsāgatis tasya niścitā |
yodhṛtvātulasīpatraṃ śirasāviṣṇutat-paraḥ ||64||
karotisarvakāryāṇiphalamāpnoticākṣayam |
tulasīkāṣṭhamālābhir bhūṣitaḥ karma ācaran ||65||
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ cakṛtaṃ koṭi-guṇaṃ bhavet |
nivedyakeśavemālāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhanirmitām ||66||
yādṛṣṭānikhilāghasaṅghaśamanīspṛṣṭāvapuḥ pāvanī |
rogāṇāmabhivanditānirasanīsiktāntakatrāsinī ||
pārvaty uvāca—
harerāmahare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetimaṃ galam |
antar- āntarakarmāṇikṛtvānāmāni casmaret |
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇetikṛṣṇetyāhapunaḥ punaḥ ||4||
so’pi pāpātpramucyetatūlarāśerivānalaḥ ||5||
jayādyetattvayāvāpyathavā śrī-śabdapūrvakam |
divāniśicasamdhyāyāṃ sarvakāleṣu saṃsmaret |
aharniśaṃsmaranrāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaticakṣuṣā ||7||
aśucirvāśucirvāpisarvakāleṣu sarvadā |
nāmasaṃsmaraṇādevasaṃsārānmucyatekṣaṇāt ||8||
yajṣavratatapodānaṃ sāṅgaṃ naivakalauyuge ||9||
gaṅgā-snānaṃ harer nāma nirapāyam idaṃ dvayam ||10||
gurv-aṅganā-koṭi-niṣevaṇaṃ ca |
steyān yathānyāni hareḥ priyeṇa
apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato’pi vā |
yaḥ smaret puṇḍīkākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ||12||
nāma-saṃsmaraṇād eva tathā tasyārtha-cintanāt |
sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ vāpi tathā paiṣṭīṃ srag-ākṛtim ||13||
pādayoś cihnitāṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ caiva samārabhet |
dakṣiṇasya pado’ṅguṣṭha-mūle cakraṃ bibharti yaḥ ||14||
dhyātṛcittadvirephāṇāṃ lobhanāyātiśobhanam |
pārśva-madhye’ṅkuśaṃ bhaktacitterabhasakāraṇam ||17||
mūlegadāṃ ca pāpādribhedanīṃ sarvadehinām ||18||
sarvavidyāprakāśāyadhattesabhagavān ajaḥ |
padmādīnyapicihnāni tatra dakṣeṇayatpunaḥ ||19||
vāmapādevasetso'yaṃ bibharttikaruṇānidhiḥ |
śṛṇuyātkīrttayennityaṃ sanirmuktona saṃśayaḥ |
māsakṛtyaṃ pravakṣyāmiviṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ param ||21||
jyeṣṭhetusnāpanaṃ kuryācchrīviṣṇoryatnataḥ śuciḥ |
brahmahatyāsahasrāṇijṣātājṣātakṛtāni ca |
koṭikoṭisahasrāṇihyupapāpāniyāni ca |
sarvāṇyathapraṇaśyanti paurṇamāsyāṃ tuvāsare ||24||
puruṣasūktenamantreṇapāvamānībhir eva ca ||25||
nālikerodakenātha tathā tālaphalāṃ bunā |
ghaṃ ghaṇṭāyainamaitighaṇṭāvādyaṃ pradāpayet ||27||
pāhi māṃ pāpinaṃ ghora-saṃsārārṇava-pātinam ||28||
ya evaṃ kurute vidvān brāhmaṇaḥ śrotriyaḥ śuciḥ |
āṣāḍha-śuklaikādaśyāṃ kuryāt svāpa-mahotsavam |
āṣāḍhe ca rathaṃ kuryāc chrāvaṇe śravaṇāvidhim ||30||
utthānaṃ śrī-hareḥ kuryād an yathā viṣṇudrohakṛt |
śubhecaivāśvinemāsimahā-māyāṃ capūjayet ||32||
sauvarṇīṃ rājatīṃ vāpiviṣṇurūpāṃ baliṃ vinā |
hiṃ sādveṣaunakartavyaudharmātmāviṣṇupūjakaḥ ||33||
kārtikepuṣyamāsecakāmataḥ puṇyamācaret |
dāmodarāyadīpaṣcaprāṃ śusthānepradāpayet ||34||
saptavartipramāṇenadīpaḥ syāccaturaṃ gulaḥ |
pakṣāṃ tecaprakartavyādīpamālāvaliḥ śubhā ||35||
mārgaśīrṣesitepakṣeṣaṣṭhyāṃ casitavastrakaiḥ |
pūjayejjagadīśaṃ cabrahmāṇaṃ caviśeṣataḥ ||36||
pauṣepuṣpābhiṣekaṃ cavarjayeccandanaṃ ślatham |
saṃkrāṃ tyāṃ māghamāsecasādhivāsitataṇḍulāt ||37||
viprabhojanamātreṇavyaṃ gaṃ sāṅ-gandhruvaṃ bhavet |
paṣcamyāṃ śuklapakṣetusnāpayitvā cakeśavam ||40||
pūjayitvā vidhānenacūtapallava-saṃyutaiḥ |
phalacūrṇaiścavividhair vāsitaiḥ paṭasādhitaiḥ ||41||
kānanaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ capradīptaṃ dīpadīpitam |
drākṣekṣuraṃ bhājaṃ bīranāgaraṃ gaṃ capūgakam ||42||
nālikeraṃ cadhātrīṃ capanasaṃcaharītakīm |
anyaiścavṛkṣakhaṇḍaiścasarvartukusumānvitaiḥ ||43||
vitānaiḥ kusumoddāmair vāripūrṇaghaṭais tathā ||44||
cūtaśākhopaśākhābhiḥ śobhitaṃ chatracāmaraiḥ |
jayakṛṣṇetisaṃsmṛtyapradakṣiṇapurassaram ||45||
phālgunecacaturdaśyāmaṣṭameyāmasaṃjṣake ||46||
athavā paurṇamāsyāṃ tupratipatsamdhisaṃjṣake |
haridrārāgayogāccaraṃ garūpair manoharaiḥ ||48||
anyair vāraṃ garūpaiścaprīṇayetparameśvaram |
ekādaśyāṃ samārabhyapaṣcamyāntaṃ samāpayet ||49||
paṣcāhāni try-ahānivā dolotsavo vidhīyate |
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dolamānaṃ sakṛnnarāḥ ||50||
dṛṣṭvā parādhanicayair muktāstenātrasaṃśayaḥ |
nikṣipyajalapātrecamāsimādhavasaṃjṣake ||51||
sauvarṇapātreraupyevātāmrevāpyathamṛṇmaye |
pratimāṃ vā mahā-bhāge tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate |
damanāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā śrī-viṣṇau ca samarpayet ||53||
vaiśākhe śrāvaṇe bhādre kartavyaṃ vā tad-arpaṇam |
vaiśākhe ca tṛtīyāyāṃ jala-madhye viśeṣataḥ ||55||
athavā maṇḍale kuryān maṇḍape vā bṛhad-vane |
sugandha-candanenāṅgaṃ supuṣṭaṃ ca dine dine ||56||
yathā prayatnataḥ kuryāt kṛśāṅgasyeva puṣṭidam |
candanāguru-hrībera-kṛṣṇa-kuṅkuma-rocanā ||57||
jaṭāmāṃ sīmurā caiva viṣṇor gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ |
dhṛṣṭaṃ ca tulasī-kāṣṭhaṃ karpūrāguru-yogataḥ |
yātrā kāle ca ye kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyā paśyanti mānavāḥ |
na teṣāṃ punar āvṛttiḥ kalpa-koṭi-śatair api ||60||
vṛndāvanaṃ tatra gatvā upaskṛtya phalāni ca |
nārikelaphalaṃ bījakośaṃ coddhṛtyadāpayet |
ghoṇṭāphalaṃ capanasaṃkośamuddhṛtyadāpayet ||63||
dadhnāvimiśritaṃ cānnaṃ ghṛtenāplutyadāpayet |
pācitaṃ piṣṭakaṃ pūpamaṣṭādaśaghṛtena ca ||64||
tailaiścaitilasaṃmiśraiḥ phalaṃ pakvaṃ pradāpayet |
yadyadevātmanaḥ prītaṃ tattadīśāyadāpayet ||65||
tyaktaṃ caviṣṇumuddiśyatadbhaktebhyoviśeṣataḥ ||66||
śrī-kṛṣṇarūpaguṇavarṇanaśāstravargabodhādhikāraihacedalamanyapāṭhaiḥ |
vṛndāvana-kṣiti-talaṃ yamunā-jalaṃ ca |
liptaṃ vapuḥ kila vṛthāgaru-candanādyaiḥ ||69||
sūtajīvaciraṃ sādhośrī-kṛṣṇacaritāmṛtam |
tvayāprakāśitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhavatāraṇam ||1||
śrī-kṛṣṇalīlāṃ nikhilāṃ brūhi dainandinīṃ prabho |
yayākarṇitayāsādhokṛṣṇebhaktirvivarddhate ||2||
guroḥ śiṣ yasya mantrasyavidhānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak |
vadāsmākaṃ mahā-bhāgatvaṃ hinaḥ paramaḥ suhṛt ||3||
ekadā yamunā-tīre samāsīnaṃ jagad-gurum |
nāradaḥ praṇipatyāha devadevaṃ sadāśivam ||4||
kṛṣṇamantrāmayā labdhāstvatto yecapituḥ pare |
tesarve sādhitāstatvānmantrarājādayo mayā ||6||
bahuvarṣasahasraistuśākamūlaphalāśinā |
śuṣkaparṇāṃ buvāyvādibhojinācanirāśinā ||7||
strīṇāṃ samdarśanālāpavarjinābhūmiśāyinā |
kāmādiṣaḍguṇaṃ jitvābāhyendriyaniyamyatā ||8||
evaṃ kṛte'pinaivātmāsaṃtuṣṭomama śaṅkara |
sādhupṛṣṭaṃ mahā-bhāgatvayālokahitaiṣiṇā |
rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ yadguhyānāṃ guhyam uttamam |
vakṣyāmiyugalaṃ tubhyaṃ kṛṣṇamantramanuttamam |
gopījanapadaṃ vallabhāntaṃ tucaraṇāniti ||14||
śaraṇaṃ caprapadyeca eṣapaṣcapadātmakaḥ |
mantracintāmaṇiḥ proktaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇomahā-manuḥ ||15||
etāṃ paṣcapadīṃ japtvāśraddhayāśraddhayāsakṛt |
kṛṣṇapriyāṇāṃ sānnidhyaṃ gacchatyevana saṃśayaḥ ||17||
napuraś ca raṇaprekṣānāsyanyāsavidhikramaḥ |
sarve 'dhikāriṇaścātracaṇḍālāṃ tāmunīśvara |
striyaḥ śūdrādayaś cāpi jaḍamūkādipaṃ gavaḥ ||19||
anyehūṇāḥ kirātāścapuliṃ dāḥ puṣkasās tathā |
ābhīrāyavanāḥ kaṃ kāḥ khasādyāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ||20||
daṃ bhāhaṃ kāraparamāḥ pāpāḥ paiśunyatatparāḥ |
gobrāhmaṇādihaṃ tāromaho papātakānvitāḥ ||21||
jñāna vai rāgyarahitāḥ śravaṇādivivarjitāḥ |
yadibhaktirbhavedeṣāṃ kṛṣṇesarve śvareśvare |
tadādhikāriṇaḥ sarve nānyathā muni-sattama ||23||
yājṣikodānanirataḥ sarvataṃ tropasevakaḥ |
satyavādīyatirvāpivedavedāṃ gapāragaḥ ||24||
brahmaniṣṭhaḥ kulīnovātapasvīvratatat-paraḥ |
atrādhikārīnabhavetkṛṣṇabhaktivivarjitaḥ ||25||
tasmād akṛṣṇabhaktāyakṛtaghnāyanamānine |
na ca śraddhāvihīnāyavaktavyaṃ nāstikāya ca ||26||
nacāśuśrūṣavevācyaṃ nāsaṃvatsarasevine |
śrī-kṛṣṇe'nanyabhaktāyadaṃ bhalobhavivarjine ||27||
ṛṣiścaivāhame tasya gāyatrīchaṃ daucyate ||28||
devatāballavīkāṃ tomantrasyaparikīrtitaḥ |
ācakrādyais tathā mantraiḥ paṣcāṃ gāniprakalpayet |
gamity evaṃ bhavedbījaṃ namaḥ śaktirihoditā ||31||
anti mārṇair daśāṃ gānitair eva ca tathā rcanam |
nyāsapūrvavidhānenakartavyaṃ harituṣṭaye |
sakṛduccāraṇādevakṛtakṛtyatvadāyinaḥ |
pītāmbaraṃ ghana-śyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ vanamālinam ||35||
barhi-barha-kṛtottaṃsaṃ śaśi-koṭi-nibhānanam |
ghūrṇāyamāna-nayanaṃ karṇikārāvataṃsinam ||36||
racitaṃ tilakaṃ bhāle bibhrataṃ maṇḍalākṛtim ||37||
taruṇāditya-saṃkāśaṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ virājitam |
gharmāmbu-kaṇikā-rājad-darpaṇābha-kapolakam ||38||
bibhrataṃ muralīṃ vāme pāṇau padmaṃ tathaiva ca |
kāṣcī-dāma-sphuran-madhyaṃ nūpurābhyāṃ lasat-padam ||41||
hasantaṃ priyayā sārdhaṃ hāsayantaṃ ca tāṃ muhuḥ ||42||
vṛndāraṇye smaret kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsthitaṃ priyayā saha ||43||
vāma-pārśve sthitāṃ tasya rādhikāṃ ca smaret tataḥ |
nīla-colaka-saṃvītāṃ tapta-hema-sama-prabhām ||44||
paṭṭāṣcalenāvṛtārdha-susmerānana-paṅkajām |
kānta-vaktre nyasta-netrāṃ cakorī-caṣcalekṣaṇām ||45||
aṅguṣṭha-tarjanībhyāṃ ca nija-kānta-mukhāmbuje |
arpayantīṃ pūga-phalaṃ parṇa-cūrṇa-samanvitam ||46||
kṣīṇa-madhyāṃ pṛthu-śroṇīṃ kiṅkiṇī-jāla-maṇḍitām ||47||
ratna-tāṭaṅka-keyūra-mudrā-valaya-dhāriṇīm |
raṇat-kaṭaka-maṣjīra-ratna-pādāṃ gulīyakām ||48||
lāvaṇya-sāra-mugdhāṅgīṃ sarvāvayava-sundarīm |
ānanda-rasa-saṃmagnāṃ prasannāṃ nava-yauvanām ||49||
tat-sevana-parābhāvyāś cāmara-vyajanādibhiḥ ||50||
atha tubhyaṃ pravakṣyāmimantrārthaṃ śṛṇunārada |
bahiraṃ gaiḥ prapaṣcasyasvāṃ śair māyādiśaktibhiḥ ||51||
gopanāducyategopīrādhikākṛṣṇa-vallabhā ||
devīkṛṣṇamayīproktārādhikāparadevatā ||52||
sarvalakṣmīsvarūpāsākṛṣṇāhlādasvarūpiṇī |
tataḥ sāprocyateviprahlādinītimanīṣibhiḥ ||53||
tatkalākoṭikoṭyaṃ śadurgādyāstriguṇātmikāḥ |
sātusākṣānmahā-lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇonārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||54||
iyaṃ durgāharīrudraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śakraiyaṃ śacī ||55||
sāvitrīyaṃ harirbrahmādhūmorṇāsauyamohariḥ |
bahunākiṃ muniśreṣṭhavinātābhyāṃ n akiṣcana ||56||
cidacillakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ rādhākṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat |
naśakyate mayā vaktuṃ varṣakoṭi-śatair api |
trailokyepṛthivīmānyājaṃ būdvīpaṃ tato varam ||58||
tatrāpibhārataṃ varṣaṃ tatrāpimathurāpurī |
 tatra rādhāsakhīvargastatrāpirādhikāvarā |
sāṃ nidhyādhikyatastasyā ādhikyaṃ syādyathottaram ||60||
pṛthivīprabhṛtīnāṃ tunānyatkiṣcidihoditam |
saiṣāhirādhikāgopījanastasyāḥ sakhīgaṇaḥ ||61||
tasyāḥ sakhīsamūhasyavallabhauprāṇanāyakau |
rādhākṛṣṇautayoḥ pādāḥ śaraṇaṃ syādihāśraye ||62||
prapadyegatavānasmijīvo'haṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ |
so'haṃ yaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptomama tasya yadastica ||63||
yugalārthas tathā nyāsaḥ prapattiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ |
ātmārpaṇamimepaṣcaparyāyāste mayoditāḥ ||65||
atha dīkṣā-vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada-tattvataḥ |
śravaṇād eva mucyeta vinā tasya vidhānataḥ ||1||
āviriṣcyāj jagat sarvaṃ vijṣāya naśvaraṃ budhaḥ |
ādhyātmikādi-trividha-duḥkham evānubhūya ca ||2||
anityatvāc ca sarveṣāṃ sukhānāṃ muni-sattama |
narāṇāṃ duṣkaratvaṃ hi vijṣāya ca mahā-matiḥ |
bhṛśam ārtas tato vipra māṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet ||5||
śānto vimatsaraḥ kṛṣṇe bhakto'nanya-prayojanaḥ |
ananya-sādhanaḥ śrīmān kāma-lobha-vivarjitaḥ ||6||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-rasa-tattvajṣaḥ kṛṣṇa-mantra-vidāṃ varaḥ |
kṛṣṇa-mantrāśrayo nityaṃ mantra-bhaktaḥ sadā śuciḥ ||7||
sad-dharma-śāsako nityaṃ sad-ācāra-niyojakaḥ |
sampradāyī kṛpā-pūrṇo virāgī gurur ucyate ||8||
evam ādi-guṇaḥ prāyaḥ śuśrūṣur guru-pādayoḥ |
gurau nitānta-bhaktaś ca mumukṣuḥ śiṣya ucyate ||9||
yat sākṣāt sevanaṃ tasya premṇā bhāgavato bhavet |
sa mokṣaḥ procyate prājṣair vedavedāṃ gavedibhiḥ ||10||
āśritya sva-guroḥ pādau nija-vṛttaṃ nivedayet |
sa sandehān apākṛtya bodhayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ||11||
sva-pāda-praṇataṃ śāntaṃ śuśrūṣuṃ nija-pādayoḥ |
atihṛṣṭa-manāḥ śiṣyaṃ manum adhyāpayet param ||12||
candanena mṛdāvāpi vilikhed bāhu-mūlayoḥ |
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tataḥ kuryād bhālādiṣu vidhānataḥ |
dāsa-śabda-yutaṃ nāma dhāryaṃ tasya prayatnataḥ ||15||
śrī-guruṃ pūjayec cāpi vastrālaṅkaraṇādibhiḥ ||16||
ya etaiḥ paṣcabhir vidvān saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛto bhavet |
dāsya-bhāgī sa kṛṣṇasya nānyathā kalpa-koṭibhiḥ ||18||
aṅkanaṃ cordhva-puṇḍraś ca mantro nāma-vidhāraṇam |
paṣcamo yāga ity uktāḥ saṃskārāḥ pūrva-sūribhiḥ ||19||
aṅkanaṃ śaṅkha-cakrādyaiḥ sa-cchidraṃ puṇḍram ucyate |
dāsa-śabda-yutaṃ nāma mantro yugala-saṃjṣakaḥ ||20||
guru-vaiṣṇavayoḥ pūjā yāga ity abhidhīyate |
ete parama-saṃskārā mayā te parikīrtitāḥ ||21||
atha tubhyaṃ prapannānāṃ dharmān vakṣyāmi nārada |
yān āsthāya gamiṣyanti hari-dhāma-narāḥ kalau ||22||
sevamāno guruṃ nityaṃ tat-kṛpāṃ bhāvayet sudhīḥ ||23||
satāṃ dharmāṃs tataḥ śikṣet prapannānāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
sveṣṭa-deva-dhiyā nityaṃ vaiṣṇavān paritoṣayet ||24||
tāḍanaṃ bhartsanaṃ kāmi-bhogyatvena yathā striyaḥ |
gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca tat-tad-grāhyaṃ tathā budhaiḥ ||25||
aihikyāmuṣmikī-cintā naiva kāryā kadācana |
aihikaṃ tu sadā bhāvyaṃ pūrvācarita-karmaṇā ||26||
āmuṣmikaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaḥ svayam eva kariṣyati |
sarvopāya-parityāgaḥ kṛṣṇīyātmatayārcanam |

 tathā yātānpradhakṣyetānupāyairdāruṇaiḥ kila |

pituḥ kṣayāhadivasevaiśākhādiṣuyatnataḥ ||44||

 tasya dānaprabhāveṇabhāvanāparibhāvitaḥ |

 tasya puṇyaṃ mahīdevakaścidvaktuṃ naśakyate |

 yasya śravaṇamātreṇanāmnoyātimahā-tamaḥ ||52||
