yamunāyāś ca māhātmyaṃ gaṇḍikāyās tathā mune |
vetravatyās tu māhātmyaṃ vacmy ahaṃ te na saṃśayaḥ ||23||
gilli-tīrthodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ śilā-kṣetraṃ mahac ca yat |
tat sarvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi khaṇḍe uttara-saṃjṣake ||24||
arbudeśvara-māhātmyaṃ tatra tīrthādikaṃ ca yat |
sarasvatyāś ca māhātmyaṃ siddha-kṣetrādikaṃ ca yat ||25||
gopī-candana-māhātmyaṃ paṭṭa-pūjāṃ tathaiva ca ||26||
niraṣjanasya māhātmyaṃ tathā vijñāna-darśanam |
tatra dīpa-pradānaṃ ca dhūpa-dānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||27||
kārttikasyātha māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ māghajaṃ tathā |
sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ vidhi-pūrvakam ||28||
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi jagannāthākhyam uttamam |
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate loko brahma-hatyādi-pātakāt ||29||
brāhmaṇāyatra bhuṣjanti vedaśāstra viśāradaḥ ||30||
anyeṣāṃ caiva lokānāṃ kākathā caiva suvrata |
paṣcaviṃśatyatranāgānartakyovividhās tathā ||31||
brahmahatyābālahatyāgavāṃ hatyātathaiva ca |
tāḥ sarvāvilayaṃ yānti jagannāthasyadarśanāt ||32||
viṣṇoḥ pūjanakaṃ puṣpais tanmāhātmyamapibruve ||33||
parvatānāṃ varṇanaṃ cadeśānāṃ varṇanaṃ tathā |
gopūjanādimāhātmyaṃ siddhānāṃ caiva pūjanam ||34||
kadalīgarbhadānaṃ cavṛkṣadānaṃ tataḥ param ||35||
aśvadānaṃ hastidānaṃ japamāhātmya muttamam |
mantradīkṣāgamaṃ caiva gurorlakṣaṇam eva ca ||36||
śiṣyasyalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ yathāpaurāṇikāviduḥ |
caraṇodakamāhātmyaṃ pitṛśrāddhādikaṃ ca yat ||37||
pitṛkṣayāhadānaṃ canīlotsargavidhis tataḥ |
śālagrāmasyadānasya māhātmyaṃ mālyagandhayoḥ |
daśamyaikādaśīvedhaṃ dvādaśīharivāsaram ||39||
teṣāṃ caiva tumāhātmyaṃ rudranāmādikaṃ ca yat |
mathurāyāś ca māhātmyaṃ kurukṣetrādikaṃ tathā ||40||
setubandhasyacākhyānaṃ śrīrāmeśvarajaṃ tathā |
tryaṃ bakasyacamāhātmyaṃ paṣcavaṭyāśca yatphalam ||41||
daṇḍakāraṇyamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuvāḍavasattama |
daṇḍakāraṇyamāhātmyaṃ nṛsiṃ hotpattikāraṇam ||42||
gītāyāś caiva māhātmyaṃ tathā bhāgavatasya ca |
kāliṃ dyāś caiva māhātmyamindraprasthasyavarṇanam ||43||
rukmāṃ gadacaritraṃ tumahimāvaiṣṇavasyaca |
vaiṣṇavehyekabhukte tu śṛṇuvāḍavasattama ||44||
sasāgarāṃ capṛthivīṃ dattvā caiva tuyatphalam |
sātvikāḥ sattva sampannārājasāḥ kāmukāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tāmasāadhamāḥ proktāvaiṣṇavānāṃ tulakṣaṇam ||46||
brāhmaṇāvaiṣṇavāyetuvedadharmaparāyaṇāḥ |
teṣāṃ māhātmyaṃ vakṣyāmi yathoktaṃ caiva nārada ||47||
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tuvakṣyāmisāṃ prataṃ ṛṣisattama ||48||
jvālāmukhyās tathākhyānaṃ himaśailekṣaṇaṃ tathā |
kāyasthānāṃ samutpatirgayāvyākhyānam eva ca |
eteṣāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ pādmedṛṣṭaṃ tathāśrutam |
rāmagayāyāmāhātmyaṃ tathāpretaśilābhavam |
brahmaṇaśca tathākhyānaṃ śilākhyānaṃ vadāmy aham ||52||
maheśvarakṛtāmbhaktiṃ viṣṇunācamahātmanā |
adyāpikāśyāṃ japatimahārudrohyanāmayam ||54||
māhātmyaṃ ca tatovakṣyesāgarasyahinārada |
tilatarpaṇajaṃ puṇyaṃ yavajaṃ puṇyam eva ca ||55||
tulasīdala saṃyuktaṃ tarpaṇaṃ devajaṃ tathā |
tanmāhātmyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktaṃ brahmaṇāmama ||56||
śaṅkhanādasya māhātmyaṃ puṇyaṃ cā saṃkhya saṃjṣakam ||57||
ravervārasya māhātmyaṃ yogasyaviṣṇu saṃjṣinaḥ |
vaidhṛtasyacamāhātmyaṃ vyatīpātasyavaitathā ||58||
annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tathaiva ca ||59||
śayyādānaṃ cagodānaṃ tathāvṛṣabham eva ca |
janmāṣṭamyāś ca māhātmyaṃ matsya māhātmyam eva ca ||60||
kūrma-māhātmyaṃ tat proktaṃ vārāhasya tathaiva ca |
māhātmyaṃ ca gavādīnāṃ dānānāṃ pravadāmy aham ||61||
tanmāhātmyaṃ tatovakṣyeśṛṇudevarṣisattama ||62||
prahareṣu pṛthakpūjāphalaṃ devarṣisattama ||63||
parśurāmasyacākhyānaṃ reṇukāyāvadhas tathā |
brāhmaṇānāṃ bhūmidānaṃ rāmeṇaivaca yatkṛtam ||64||
rāmasyāśramajaṃ puṇyaṃ vadāmy ahamaśeṣataḥ |
narmadāyās tathākhyānaṃ puṇyapūjanayos tathā ||65||
dānaṃ vedapurāṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ nirūpaṇam |
hiraṇyadānapuṇyaṃ cabrahmāṇḍadānam eva ca ||66||
padmapurāṇadānaṃ cakhaṇḍānāṃ vyaktayas tathā |
prathamaṃ sṛṣṭikhaṇḍaṃ cadvitīyaṃ bhūmikhaṇḍakam ||67||
svargakhaṇḍaṃ tṛtīyaṃ caturyaṃ pātāla saṃjṣakam |
uttaraṃ paṣcamaṃ proktaṃ khaṇḍānyanukrameṇavai ||68||
etatpadmapurāṇaṃ tuvyāsenatumahātmanā |
kṛtaṃ lokahitārthāyabrāhmaṇaśreyasetathā ||69||
śūdrāṇāṃ puṇyajananaṃ tīvradāridryanāśanam |
mokṣadaṃ sukhadaṃ cāśukalyāṇapradamavyayam |
śrutvādānaṃ tathākuryādvidhinātatranārada ||70||
uttara-khaṇḍe maheśa-nārada-saṃvāde bīja-samuccayo nāma
maheśa uvāca—
ekalakṣaṃ paṣcaviṃśat-sahasrā parvatās tathā |
teṣāṃ madhye mahatpuṇyaṃ badrikāśramam uttamam ||1||
naranārāyaṇodevoyatra tiṣṭhatinārada |
tasyasvarūpaṃ tejaśca vakṣyāmīhacasāṃ patam ||2||
himaparvataśṛṃ gecakṛṣṇākāratayādvija |
śvetaekastupuruṣaḥ kṛṣṇohyekatamaḥ punaḥ |
tenamārgeṇayeyānti himācalakṛtodyamāḥ ||4||
piṃ galaśvetavarṇaścajaṭādhārīmahāprabhuḥ |
kṛṣṇonārāyaṇohyeṣajagadādirmahāprabhuḥ ||5||
caturbāhurmahānśrīmānvyakto’vyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ |
ataetādṛśodevonabhūtonabhaviṣyati |
tatradevāva santīhaṛṣīṇāṃ cāśramās tathā ||8||
agnihotrāṇivedāścadhvaniḥ praśrūyatesadā |
tasyavaidarśanaṃ kāryaṃ koṭihatyāvināśanam ||9||
alakanaṃ dāyatragaṅgātatrasnānaṃ samācaret |
kṛtvāsnānaṃ tuvaitatramahāpāpāt pramucyate ||10||
yatraviśveśvarodevastiṣṭhatyevana saṃśayaḥ |
tadānārāyaṇodevobhaktānāṃ hikṛpākaraḥ |
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣādīśvarogaruḍadhvajaḥ |
śrī-nārāyaṇa uvāca—
tvaṃ kailāsavibhuḥ sākṣādrudrovaiviśvapālakaḥ ||13||

ekadānāradodraṣṭuṃ pāṇḍavānduḥkhakarśitān |

śṛṇusundarivakṣyāmistotraṃ cābhyudayaṃ tataḥ |
yac chrutvā mucyatepāpībrahmahānātra saṃśayaḥ ||1||
dhātāvaināradaṃ prāhatadahaṃ tubravīmite |

ajitaḥkhaṅgabhṛjjiṣṇuḥkṛṣṇaś caiva sanātanaḥ ||4||

trayāṇāmapilokānāṃ ādikartāsvayaṃ prabhuḥ |

āśvinaucāpikarṇautesūryacandraucacakṣuṣī |

dṛśyasesarvalokeṣu goṣucabrahmaṇeṣu ca ||12||

 saṃhṛtaṃ paramaṃ havyaṃ rahasyaṃ vaipunaḥ punaḥ |

śṛṇuṣva ikamanāḥkāṃ teyattvaṃ vaipūrvajanmani |

āsītkṛtayugasyāṃ temāyāpuryāṃ dvijottamaḥ |
ātreyodevaśarmetivedavedāṃ gapāragaḥ ||35||
ātitheyo’gniśuśrūṣuḥ sauravrataparāyaṇaḥ |

tau tu kṣetra-prabhāveṇa dharma-śīlatayā punaḥ |
vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ nītau mad-gaṇair mat-samīpagaiḥ ||41||
yāvaj jīvantu yat tābhyāṃ sūrya-pūjādikaṃ kṛtam |

śaivāḥ saurāś ca gāṇeśā vaiṣṇavāḥ śakti-pūjakāḥ |
mām eva prāpnuvantīha varṣāmbhaḥ sāgaraṃ yathā ||43||
tato guṇavatī śrutvā rakṣasān iha tāv ubhau |
pitṛ-bhartaja-duḥkhārtā karuṇaṃ paryadevayat ||1||
guṇavaty uvāca—
hā nātha hāpitas tyaktvā gacchataṃ kva mayā vinā |
bālāhaṃ kiṃ karomy adya hy anāthā bhavatā vinā ||2||
ko nu mām āsthitāṃ gehe bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ |
akiṣcit-kuśalāṃ snehāt pālayiṣyati duḥkhitām ||3||
hata-bhāgyā gata-sukhā hateśā hata-jīvitā |
śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmy adya tvan-nāthā bata bāliśā ||4||
evaṃ bahu-vilapyātha kurarīva bhṛśāturā |
papāta bhūmau vikalā rambhā vāta-hatā yathā ||5||
cirād āśvasya sā bhūmau vilapya karuṇaṃ bahu |
viṣṇu-bhakti-parā śāntā satya-śaucā jitendriyā ||8||
vrata-dvayaṃ tayā samyag ājanma-maraṇāt kṛtam |
ekādaśī-vrataṃ samyak sevanaṃ kārttikasya ca ||9||
kārttike māsi ye nityaṃ tulā saṃsthe divākare |
prātaḥ snāsyanti te muktā mahā-pātakino’pi ca ||11||
saṃmārjanaṃ gṛhe viṣṇoḥ svastikādi-nivedanam |
viṣṇu-pūjāṃ prakurvanti jīvan-muktāś ca te narāḥ ||12||
snānaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ dīpaṃ tulasī-vana-sevanam |
kārttike ye prakurvanti te narā viṣṇu-mūrtayaḥ ||13||
devānām api te vandyāḥ kiṃ yair ājanmataḥ kṛtam ||14||
nityaṃ viṣṇoḥ parikare bhaktā tat-para-mānasā ||15||
kadācij jarasā sātha kṛśāṅgī jvara-pīḍitā |
snātuṃ gaṅgāṃ gatā kānte kathaṣcic chanakais tathā ||16||
yāvaj jalāntara-gatā kampitā śīta-pīḍitā |
tāvat sā vihvalāpaśyad vimānaṃ prāptam ambarāt ||17||
viṣṇu-rūpa-dharaiḥ samyag vainateya-dhvajāṅkitaiḥ ||18||
cāmarair vījyamānāṃ tāṃ vaikuṇṭham anayan gaṇāḥ ||19||
atha brahmādi-devānāṃ yathā prārthanayābhuvam |
āgacchatā gaṇāḥ sarve yātās te’pi mayā saha ||21||
ete hi yādavāḥ sarve mad-gaṇā eva bhāmini |
yaś candra-śarmāso’krūras tvaṃ sā guṇavatī śubhe |
mama dvāre tvayā pūrvaṃ tulasī-vāṭikā kṛtā |
tasmād ayaṃ kalpa-vṛkṣas tavāṅgaṇataḥ śubhe ||24||
kārttike dīpamānaṃ ca yat tvayā tu kṛtaṃ purā |
yac ca vratādikaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇave bhartṛ-rūpiṇe |
niveditavatī tasmān mama bhāryā tvam āgatā ||26||
ājanma-maraṇāt pūrvaṃ kārttike yad vrataṃ kṛtam |
evaṃ ye kārttike māsi narā vrata-parāyaṇāḥ |
mat-sānnidhyaṃ gatās te’pi prītidā tvaṃ yathā mama ||28||
yajṣa-dāna-vrata-tapaḥ-kāriṇo mānavāḥ khalu |
itthaṃ niśamya bhuvanādhipates tadānīṃ
viśveśvaraṃ tribhuvanaika-nidāna-bhūtaṃ
kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya vacanaṃ nijagāda satyā ||30||
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
sarve’pikālāvayavāstavakālasvarūpiṇaḥ |
samānās tu kathaṃ nātha māsānāṃ kārttiko varaḥ ||1||
ekādaśī-tithīnāṃ ca māsānāṃ kārttikaḥ priyaḥ |
kathaṃ te deva-deveśa kāraṇaṃ kiṃ ca kathyatām ||2||
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayāsatyeśṛṇuṣva ikāgramānasā |
evam eva purāpṛṣṭonāradaḥ pṛthunāpriye |
uvāca— kārttikādhikye kāraṇaṃ sarvavin muniḥ ||4||
śaṃkhanāmābhavatpūrvamasuraḥ sāgarātmajaḥ |
jitvā devān nirākṛtya svarga-lokān mahāsuraḥ |
indrādi-loka-pālānām adhikārāṃs tathāharat ||6||
tad-bhayād atha te devāḥ suvarṇādri-guhāṃ gatāḥ |
nyavasan bahu-varṣāṇi sāvarodhāḥ sa-vāsavāḥ ||7||
suvarṇādri-guhā-durga-saṃsthitās tridaśā yadā |
hṛtādhikārās tri-daśāmayā yady api nirjitāḥ |
adya jṣātaṃ mayā devā veda-mantra-balānvitāḥ |
satya-lokāj jahārāśu vedānāṃ ca gaṇaṃ prabhuḥ ||11||
tān-mārgamāṇaḥ śaṅkho’pi samudrāntargato bhraman |
atha brahmāsuraiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaraṇam anvayāt |
pūjopakaraṇaṃ gṛhya vaikuṇṭha-bhavanaṃ gataḥ ||14||
tatra tasya prabodhāya gīta-vādyādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ saṃpūjya tridaśās tadā |
daṇḍavat patitā bhūmau tān uvācātha keśavaḥ ||17||
varado’haṃ suragaṇāgītavādyādimaṃ galaiḥ |
mano’bhilaṣitānkāmānsarvānevadadāmivaḥ ||18||
iṣasyaśuklaikādaśyāyāvadudbodhinībhavet |
niśāturyāṃ śaśeṣeṇagītavādyādimaṃ galaiḥ ||19||
pādyārghācamanīyādyairbhavadbhiryadyathākṛtam |
tadadbhutaguṇaṃ yasmājjātaṃ vaḥ sukhakāraṇam ||21||
vedāḥśaṃkhahṛtāḥ sarvetiṣṭhanty udaka saṃsthitāḥ |
tānānayāmy ahaṃ devāhatvāsāgaranandanam ||22||
adyaprabhṛtivedāstumantrabījamakhānvitāḥ |
bhavaṃ to’pimayāsārddhamāyāṃ tusamunīśvarāḥ ||24||
kāle’sminn eva kurvanti prātaḥ-snānaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
tesarvayajṣāvabhṛthaiḥ susnātāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ ||25||
yekārttike vrataṃ samyaṅnityaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
tedehāṃ tetvayāśakraprāpyāmadbhavanaṃ sadā ||26||
mama rūpadharāḥ sākṣājjīvan muktāś ca tenarāḥ ||28||
ekādaśyāṃ yataś cāhaṃ bhavadbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ |
ataś ca iṣātithirmānyāsadaivaprītidāmama ||30||
vratadvayaṃ samyag idaṃ naraiḥ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasyasānnidhyadamastinānyat |
dānānitīrthānitapāṃ siyajṣāḥ svarlokadānenasadāsurottamāḥ ||31||
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
ity uktvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥśapharītulyarūpadhṛk |
sataṃ kamaṇḍalaukṣipraṃ kṛpayākṣiptavānmuniḥ |
tatrāpinamama utāvatkāsāreprākṣipatsatām |
tato’vadhīt sataṃ śaṅkhaṃ viṣṇur vai matsya-rūpa-dhṛk |
atha taṃ sva-kare dhṛtvā badarī-vanam āgataḥ ||4||
tatrāhūyaṛṣīnsarvānidamājṣāpayadvibhuḥ |
jalāṃ tareviśīrṇāṃ stuyūyaṃ vedānpramārjatha ||5||
ānayadhvaṃ ca tvaritāḥ sarahasyaṃ jalāṃ tarāt |
tāvatprayāgetiṣṭhāmidevatāgaṇa saṃyutaḥ ||6||
uddhāritāḥṣaḍaṃ gāstevedāyajṣasamanvitāḥ ||7||
sasaevaṛṣirjātastadāprabhṛtipārthiva ||8||
labdhvāvedānsayajṣāṃ stubrahmāharṣasamanvitaḥ |
ayajaccāśvamedhenadevarṣigaṇa saṃvṛtaḥ ||10||
devadevajagannāthavijṣaptiṃ śṛṇunaḥ prabho |
harṣakālo’yamasmākaṃ tasmāttvaṃ varadobhava ||12||
sthāne’sminnṛṣayovedānnaṣṭānprāpuḥ punaḥ svayam |
yajṣabhāgānvayaṃ prāptāstvatprasādādramāpate ||13||
sthānametadapiśreṣṭhaṃ pṛthivyāṃ puṇyavarddhanam |
kālo’pyayaṃ mahāpuṇyobrahmaghnādiviśuddhikṛt |
sūryavaṃ śodbhavorājāgaṅgāmatrānayiṣyati |
sāsūryakanyayācātrakāliṃ dyā saṃgamiṣyati ||17||
yūyaṃ ca sarvebrahmādyānivasadhvaṃ mayāsaha |
dānaṃ tapovrataṃ homojapapūjādikāḥkriyāḥ |
anaṃ taphaladāḥ saṃtumatsāṃ nidhyapradāḥ sadā ||19||
darśanādasyatīrthasyavināśaṃ yāṃ tutat-kṣaṇāt ||20||
pitṝnnirdiśyayeśrāddhaṃ kurvaṃ tyatrasamāgatāḥ |
teṣāṃ pitṛgaṇāḥ sarveyāṃ tutematsalokatām ||22||
kālo’pyeṣamahāpuṇyaphalado’stusadānṛṇām |
sūryyemakarageprātaḥ snāyināṃ pāpa-nāśanam ||23||
darśanādevapāpāniyānti sūryādyathātamaḥ ||24||
salokatvaṃ sarūpatvaṃ samīpatvaṃ trayaṃ kramāt |
nṛṇāṃ dadāmy ahaṃ snānānmāghemakarageravau ||25||
yūyaṃ munīśvarāḥ sarveśṛṇudhvaṃ varado’smivaḥ |
badarīvanamadhye’haṃ sadātiṣṭhāmisarvagaḥ ||26||
jīvan muktāstadāteṣupāpaṃ naivāvatiṣṭhate ||28||
evaṃ devāndevadevastaduktvā tatraivāṃ tarddhānamāgātsavedhāḥ |
devāḥ sarve’pyaṃ śakais tatratasthuścāṃ tarddhānaṃ prāpurindrādayaste ||29||
imāṃ ca gāthāṃ śṛṇuyānnarottamoyaḥśrāvayedvāpiviśuddhacittaḥ |
satīrtharājaṃ badarīvanaṃ yatkṛtvāphalaṃ māṃ samavāpnuyāc ca ||30||
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
śaṃkhāsura-vadho vedāgame prayāga-māhātmyaṃ
pṛthur uvāca—
mahāphalaṃ tvayāproktaṃ munekārttikamāghayoḥ |
tayoḥ snānavidhiṃ samyaṅniyamānapinārada |
tvaṃ viṣṇor aṃśa-saṃjāto nājṣātaṃ vidyate tava |
tathāpivadataḥ samyaṅmāhātmyaṃ śṛṇuvenaja ||2||
āśvinasyatumāsasyayāśuklaikādaśībhavet |
rātryāṃ turyāṃ śaśeṣāyāṃ mudotiṣṭhatsadāvratī |
nairṛtyāṃ saṃvrajedvāsādbahiḥ sodakabhājanaḥ ||4||
divā saṃdhyāsukarṇasthabrahmasūtraudaṅmukhaḥ |
aṃ tardhāyatṛṇaṃ bhūmau śiraḥ prāvṛtyavāsasā ||5||
vaktraṃ niyamyayatnenaṣṭhīvanaśvāsavarjitaḥ |
kuryānmūtrapurīṣe ca rātrauceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||6||
gṛhītaśiśnaścotthāyagṛhītvāśucimṛttikām |
ekāliṅgegudepaṣcatathāvāmakaredaśa |
ubhayoḥ saptadātavyās tathātisrastupādayoḥ ||8||
yateścaturguṇaṃ rātrautadarddhaṃ śaucamācaret ||9||
tadarddhamapimārgasthaḥ strī-śūdrāṇāṃ tadarddhakam |
śaucakarmavi-hīnasyasakalāniṣphalāḥkriyāḥ ||10||
mukhaśuddhivi-hīnasyanomantrāḥ phaladāḥ smṛtāḥ |
daṃ tajihvāviśuddhiṃ ca tataḥ kuryātprayatnataḥ ||11||
āyurbalaṃ yaśovarcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūnica |
itimantraṃ samuccāryadvādaśāṃ gulakaṃ sadā |
samidhākṣīravṛkṣāsyakṣayāhopoṣaṇaṃ vinā ||13||
pratipaddarśanavamīṣaṣṭhīścārkadinaṃ vinā |
kaṇṭakīvṛkṣakārpāsanirguṇḍībrahmavṛkṣajam |
bilvairaṇḍavigandhāḍhyaṃ varjayed daṃ tadhāvanam ||15||
tatoviṣṇoḥ śivasyāpigṛhaṃ gacchetprasannadhīḥ |
gandha-puṣpasutāmbūlāngṛhītvābhaktitat-paraḥ ||16||
tatradevasyapādyārghādyupacārānpṛthak pṛthak |
kṛtvāstutvāpunarnatvākuryād gītādimaṃ galam ||17||
tālaveṇumṛdaṃ gādidhvaniyuktānsanṛttakān |
puṣpairgandhaiḥ satāmbūlairgāyanānapicārcayet ||18||
devālayegānaparāyatasteviṣṇumūrtayaḥ |
tapāṃ siyajṣa-dānānikṛtāni cajagadguroḥ ||19||
kvatvaṃ vasasideveśamayāpṛṣṭastupārthiva ||20||
viṣṇur evaṃ tadāprāhamad-bhaktiparitoṣitaḥ |
nāhaṃ vasāmivaikuṭheyogināṃ hṛdayena ca ||21||
mad-bhaktāyatragāyanti tatratiṣṭhāminārada |
satpurāṇakathāṃ śrutvā mad-bhaktānāṃ ca gāyanam ||22||
teṣāṃ pūjādikaṃ gandha-puṣpādikrayatenaraiḥ ||23||
tenaprītiṃ tathāyāminatathāmatprapūjanāt |
śirīṣonmattagirijāmallikāśālmalībhavaiḥ ||24||
arkajaiḥ karṇikāraiś caviṣṇur nārcyas tathākṣataiḥ |
japā-kunda-śirīṣaiś ca yūthikā-mālatī-bhavaiḥ ||25||
ketakī-bhava-puṣpaiś ca naivārcyaḥ śaGkaras tathā |
gaṇeśaṃ tulasī-patrair durgā naiva ca dūrvayā ||26||
muni-puṣpais tathā sūryaṃ lakṣmī-kāmo na cārcayet |
sugandhīni praśastāni pūjāyāṃ sarvadaiva tu ||27||
evaṃ pūjā-vidhiṃ kṛtvā deva-devaṃ kṣamāpayet |
mantra-hīnaṃ kriyā-hīnaṃ bhakti-hīnaṃ sureśvara ||28||
yat pūjitaṃ mayā deva paripūrṇaṃ tad astu me |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca ||29||
punaḥ kṣamāpayed devaṃ gāyanādyaṃ kṣamāpayet |
viṣṇoḥ śivasyāpi ca pūjanādikaṃ
nirdhūta-pāpāḥ saha pūrvajais te
prayānti viṣṇor bhavanaṃ manuṣyāḥ ||30||
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
niyama-varṇanaṃ nāma
nāḍīdvayāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ rātraugacchejjalāśayam |
tilagandhākṣataiḥ puṣpairdīpādyaiḥ sahitaḥśuciḥ ||1||
mānuṣedevakhāte ca nadyāṃ nadyośca saṃgame |
kramāddaśaguṇaṃ snānaṃ tīrthe’naṃ taphalaṃ smṛtam ||2||
viṣṇuṃ smṛtvātataḥ kuryāt saṃkalpaṃ savanasyatu |
tīrthādidevatādibhyaḥkramādarghādidāpayet ||3||
auṃ namaḥkamalanābhāyanamastejalaśāyine |
namas te’stu hṛṣīkeśa-gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo ’stute ||4||
vaikuṇṭhe ca prayāge ca tathā badarikāśrame |
ato devāmāmavaṃ yato viṣṇur vicakrame |
kārttike’haṃ kariṣyāmi prātaḥ snānaṃ surottama |
dhyātvāhaṃ tvāṃ ca deveśa jale’smin snātum udyataḥ |
tava prasādāt pāpaṃ me dāmodara vinaśyatu ||8||
nitya-naimittike kṛṣṇe kārttike pāpa-nāśane |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rādhayā sahito hare ||9||
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ rādhayā sahitohare ||10||
smṛtvā bhāgīrathīṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ sūryaṃ jale viśet |
nābhi-mātre jale tiṣṭhan vratī snāyād yathā-vidhi ||11||
tilāmalaka-cūrṇena gṛhī snānaṃ samācaret |
vana-sthānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca tulasī-mūla-mṛttikā ||12||
saptamī-daśa-navamī dvitīyā-daśamīṣu ca |
trayodaśyāṃ ca na snāyād dhātrī-phala-tilaiḥ saha ||13||
ādau kuryān mala-snānaṃ mantra-snānaṃ tataḥ param |
strī-śūdrāṇāṃ na vedoktair mantrais teṣāṃ purāṇa-jaiḥ ||14||
snāna-mantrāḥ—
tridhābhūd deva-kāryāya yaḥ purā bhakti-bhāvataḥ |
sa viṣṇuḥ sarva-pāpaghnaḥ punātu kṛpayātra mām ||15||
viṣṇor ājṣām anuprāpya kārttika-vrata-kāraṇāt |
veda-mantrāḥ sa-bījās tu sa-rahasyāḥ sa-vīryakāḥ |
kaśyapādyāś ca munayo māṃ punantu sadaiva te ||17||
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvās tīrthāni jala-dāna-dāḥ |
sa-sapta-sāgarāḥ sarve māṃ punantu jalāśayāḥ ||18||
pativratās tv adityādyā yakṣāḥ siddhāḥ sa-pannagāḥ |
oṣadhyaḥ parvatāś cāśu māṃ punantu trilokajāḥ ||19||
devarṣīn mānava-pitṝṃs tarpayec ca yathā-vidhi ||20||
yāvantaḥ kārttike māsi vartante pitṛ-tarpaṇe |
tilās tat-saṃkhyakābdāni pitaraḥ svarga-vāsinaḥ ||21||
tato jalād viniṣkramya śuci-vastrāvṛto vratī |
prātaḥ-kāloditaṃ karma samāpyārced dhariṃ punaḥ ||22||
tīrthādi-devān saṃsmṛtya punar arcāṃ pradāpayet |
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ danujendra-niṣūdana ||24||
tataś ca brāhmaṇān bhaktyā bhojayed veda-pāragān |
gandha-puṣpaiḥ sa-tāmbūlaiḥ praṇamec ca punaḥ punaḥ ||25||
tīrthāni dakṣiṇe pāde vedāś ca mukham āśritāḥ |
sarvāṅge saṃsthitā devāḥ pūjitāḥ syur dvijārcanāt ||26||
avyakta-rūpiṇo viṣṇoḥ svarūpaṃ brāhmaṇā bhuvi |
nāvamānyāno virodhyāḥ kadācic chubham icchatā ||27||
tāṃ vai hari-priyāṃ devi tulasīm arcayed vratī |
pradakṣiṇa-namaskārān kuryād ekāgra-mānasaḥ ||28||
devais tvaṃ nirmitā pūrvam arcitāsi munīśvaraiḥ |
tato viṣṇu-kathāṃ śrutvā paurāṇīṃ snigdha-mānasaḥ |
taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ muniṃ vipraṃ pūjayed bhaktimān vratī ||30||
evaṃ pūrṇa-vidhiṃ samyak pūrvoktaṃ bhaktimān naraḥ |
rogāpahaṃ pāpa-vināśa-kṛt paraṃ
viṣṇu-priyād anyatamaṃ hi bhū-tale ||32||
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
kārttika-vratināṃ puṃsāṃ niyamāya prakīrtitāḥ |
tān śṛṇuṣva mayā rājan kathyamānān samantataḥ ||1||
sarvāmiṣāṇi māṃsāni kṣaudraṃ sauvīrakaṃ tathā |
rāja-māṣādikaṃ cāpi naivādyāt kārttika-vratī ||2||
bhāva-duṣṭaṃ śabda-duṣṭaṃ varjayet kārttika-vratī ||3||
parānnaṃ ca para-drohaṃ para-dārā-gamaṃ tathā |
tīrthe pratigṛhaṃ nāpi gṛhṇīyāt kārttika-vratī ||4||
strī-rāja-mahatāṃ nindāṃ varjayet kārttike vratī ||5||
prāṇy-aṅgam āmiṣaṃ cūrṇaṃ phalejaṃ vīram āmiṣam |
dhānye masūrikā proktā cānnaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā ||6||
ajā-go-mahiṣī-kṣīrād anya-dugdhādi cāmiṣam |
dvija-krītā-rasāḥ sarve lavaṇaṃ bhūmijaṃ tathā ||7||

 saṃbhakṣayātmanaḥśīghraṃ māṃ saṃtvaṃ hastapādayoḥ ||28||
saśivenaivamājṣaptaścakhādapuruṣaḥ svayam |
hastapādodbhavaṃ māṃ saṃśiraḥśeṣoyadābhavat ||29||
dṛṣṭvāśiro’vaśeṣaṃ tusuprasannaḥ sadāśivaḥ |
puruṣaṃ bhīma-karmāṇaṃ tamuvāca—savismayaḥ ||30||
tvaṃ kīrtimukha saṃjṣohibhavamaddvāragaḥ sadā |
nārcayaṃ tīhayepūrvaṃ teṣāmarcāvṛthābhavet ||32||
ataḥ sabarbarodbhūtaiti bhūmau pṛthāṃ gataḥ ||33||
tataś ca rāhuḥ punarevajātamātmānamasminnitimanyamānaḥ |
sametyasarvaṃ katha yāṃ babhūvajalandharāyeśaviceṣṭitaṃ tat ||34||
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
nirjagāmāśudaityānāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ||1||
gatastasyāgrataḥśukrorāhurdṛṣṭisthito’bhavat |
daityasainyavṛtais tatravimānānāṃ śatais tadā |
vyarājatanabhaḥ pūrṇaṃ prāvṛṣīvabalāhakaiḥ ||3||
tasyodyogaṃ tadādṛṣṭvādevāḥśakrapurogamāḥ |
alakṣitatvarājagmuḥśūlinaṃ tevyajijṣapan ||4||
najānāsikathaṃ svāmindevāvijṣāpayanti bho |
itidevavacaḥśrutvā prahasyavṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
mahāviṣṇuṃ samāhūyavacanaṃ cedamabravīt ||6||
jālandharaḥkathaṃ viṣṇonahataḥ saṃgaretvayā |
tadbhayāccāpayāto’sityaktvāvaikuṇṭhamātmanaḥ ||7||
bhagavān uvāca—
tavāṃ śa saṃbhavatvāc cabhrātṛtvāc catathāśriyaḥ |
nāyamebhirmahātejāḥśastrāstrairvadhyatemayā |
devaiḥ sarvaiḥ svatejoṃ śaḥśastrārthedīyatāṃ mama ||9||
atha viṣṇumukhādevāḥ svatejāṃ sidadustadā |
tānyekatvaṃ gatānīśodṛṣṭvātejomahāṃ stadā ||10||
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāmajvālāmālātibhīṣaṇam ||11||
tejaḥ-śeṣeṇa ca tadā vajraṃ ca kṛtavān haraḥ |
tāvajjalandharodṛṣṭaḥkailāsatalabhūmiṣu ||12||
hastyaśvaratha pattīnāṃ koṭībhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāharṣitāḥ sarvedevājagmuryathāgatam ||13||
gaṇāścasamanahyaṃ tayuddhāyātitvarānvitāḥ |
naṃ dībhavaktrasenānīmukhāḥ sarveśivājṣayā ||14||
avaterurgaṇāḥ sarvekailāsādyuddhadurmadāḥ |
pramathādhipadaityānāṃ ghoraṃ śastrāstra saṃkulam |
bherīmṛdaṃ gaśaṃkhaughanisvanairvīraharṣaṇaiḥ ||16||
gajāśvaratha śabdaiś canāditābhūrvyakaṃ pata |
śaktitomarabāṇaughairmuśalaprāsapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||17||
vyarājatanabhaḥ pūrṇamulkābhiriva saṃvṛtam |
nihatair atha nāgāśvaiḥ sarvābhūmirvyarājata ||18||
vajrāhatāścalaśiraḥśakalairiva saṃvṛtā |
vasāsṛṅmāṃ sapaṃ kādyairbhūragamyābhavattadā |
yuddhepunaḥ punaś caiva mṛta saṃjīvanībalāt |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāvyākulībhūtvāgaṇāḥ sarvebhayārditāḥ ||21||
śaśaṃ surdevadeveśaṃ tatsarvaṃ śukraceṣṭitam |
atha rudramukhātkṛtyābabhūvātīvabhīṣaṇā ||22||
tālajaṃ ghodarīvakrāstanāpīḍitabhūruhā |
sāyuddhabhūmimāsādyabhakṣayaṃ tīmahāsurān ||23||
bhārgavaṃ svakaredhṛtvājagāmāṃ tarhitābhavat |
vidhṛtaṃ bhārgavaṃ dṛṣṭvādaityasainyagaṇāstadā ||24||
athābhajyatadaityānāṃ senāgaṇabhayārditā ||25||
vāyuvegahatāyadvatprakīrṇatṛṇa saṃhatiḥ |
bhagnāṃ gatabhayātsenāṃ dṛṣṭvāharṣaṃ gaṇāyayuḥ ||26||
niśumbhaśumbhasenānyaukālanemiścavīryavān |
trayastevārayāmāsurgaṇasenāṃ mahābalāḥ ||27||
muṃ ca taḥśaravarṣāṇiprāvṛṣīvabalāhakāḥ |
tatodaityaśaraughāsteśalabhānāmivavrajāḥ ||28||
rurudhuḥkhaṃ diśaḥ sarvāgaṇasenāmakaṃ payan |
gaṇāḥśaraśatair bhinnārudhirāsāravarṣiṇaḥ ||29||
va saṃtekiṃ śukābhāsānaprājṣāyatakiṃ ca na |
patitāḥ pātyamānāścachinnābhinnāstadāgaṇāḥ ||30|
tataḥ prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ vilokyagajāsyanaṃ dīśvarakārttike yāḥ |
cirānvitādaityavarānprasahyanivārayāmāsuramarṣaṇāste ||32||
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
tegaṇādhipatīndṛṣṭvānaṃ dībhamukhaṣaṇmukhān |
amarṣādabhyadhāvaṃ tadvaṃ dvayuddhāyadānavāḥ ||1||
naṃ dinaṃ kālanemiścaśumbholambodaraṃ tathā |
niśumbhaḥṣaṇmukhaṃ vegādabhyadhāvatadaṃ śitaḥ ||2||
niśumbhaḥkārttike yasyamayūraṃ paṣcabhiḥ śaraiḥ |
tataḥśaktidharaḥśaktiṃ yāvajjagrāharoṣitaḥ |
tatonaṃ dīśvarobāṇaiḥ kālanemimavidhyata |
tadapāsyasaśūlenataṃ vakṣasyahanaddṛḍham ||6||
saśūlabhinnahṛdayohatāśvohatasārathiḥ |
adreḥśikharamāmucyaśailādriṃ so’pyapātayat ||7||
atha śumbhogaṇeśaścaratha mūṣakavāhanau |
atha śumbhaṃ gaṇādhyakṣo hṛdi vivyādha patriṇā |
sārathiṃ paṣcabhirbāṇaiḥ pātayāmāsabhūtale ||9||
tataḥśumbho’tikruddho’pibāṇaṣaṣṭyāgaṇādhipam |
mūṣakaḥśarabhinnāṃ gaścacālakṛtavedanaḥ |
tato lambodaraḥ śumbhaṃ hatvā paraśunā hṛdi |
apātayattadā bhūmau mūṣakaṃ cāruhatpunaḥ ||12||
taṃ pīḍyamānamālokyavīrabhadromahābalaḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍābhairavāścāpi vetālāyoginīgaṇāḥ |
piśācāyoginī saṃghāgaṇāścāpi tamanvayuḥ ||15||
tataḥkilakilāśabdaiḥ siṃhanādaiḥ saghurghuraiḥ |
vināditāḍamarukaiḥ pṛthivīsamakaṃ pata ||16||
tatobhūtānidhāvanti bhakṣayanti smadānavān |
utpatanti patanti smananṛtuścaraṇāṃ gaṇe ||17||
naṃ dīcakārttike yaścasamāyātautvarānvitau |
vyākulāsābhavatsenāviṣaṇṇavadanātadā ||19||
pravidhvastāṃ tataḥ senāṃ dṛṣṭvāsāgaranandanaḥ |
hastyaśvaratha saṃhrādaḥ##khabherīravastadā |
jālandharaśaravrātair nīhārapaṭalairiva |
gaṇeśaṃ paṣcabhirvidhvāśailādrimapipaṣcabhiḥ |
vīrabhadraṃ ca viṃśatyānanādajaladasvanaḥ ||23||
vyāghūrṇaḥśaktinirbhinnaḥkiṃ cidvyākulamānasaḥ ||24||
tataḥkrodhaparītākṣaḥkārttike yaṃ jalandharaḥ |
gadayātāḍayāmāsasacabhūmitale’patat ||25||
tatogaṇeśvaraḥkruddhogadāṃ paraśunācchinat ||26||
gaṇeśaṃ pātayāmāsa ratham anyaṃ samāruhat ||28||
abhyayād atha vegena vīrabhadraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ |
vīrabhadras tasya hayāṃs tathā bāṇair apātayat |
patitaṃ vīrabhadraṃ tudṛṃ ṣṭvārudragaṇābhayāt |
āgatās teraṇaṃ hitvākrośamānāmaheśvaram ||1||
atha kolāhalaṃ śrutvā gaṇānāṃ ca ndraśekharaḥ ||2||
abhyayādvṛṣamārūḍhaḥ saṃgrāmaṃ prahasanniva |
rudramāyāṃ tamālokyasiṃhanādairgaṇāḥ punaḥ ||3||
nivṛttāḥ saṃgaredetyānnijaghnuḥśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ |
daityāścabhīṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ dṛṣṭvāsarvevidudruvuḥ ||4||
kārttika-vratinaṃ dṛṣṭvāpātakānīvatadbhayāt |
roṣādadhāvaccaṇḍīśaṃ muṃ ca nbāṇānsahasraśaḥ |
śumbhoniśubho’śvamukhaḥkālanemirbalāhakaḥ ||6||
khaṅgaromāpracaṇḍaścaghasmaraścaśivaṃ yayuḥ |
bāṇāṃ dhakāra saṃcchannaṃ dṛṣṭvāgaṇabalaṃ śivaḥ ||7||
tadbāṇajālaṃ vicchidyasvabāṇairāvṛṇonnabhaḥ |
daityāṃś cabāṇavātyābhiḥ pīḍitānakarottadā ||8||
pracaṇḍajālabāṇaughairapātayatabhūtale |
khaṅgaromṇaḥśiraḥkopāttathāparaśunācchinat ||9||
balāhakasyacaśiraḥkhaṇṭvāgenākaroddvidhā |
baddhvācaghasmaraṃ daityaṃ pāśenābhyahanādbhuvi ||10||
vṛṣabheṇahatāḥkecitkecidbāṇairnirākṛtāḥ |
naśekurasurāḥ sthātuṃ gajāḥ siṃhārditāyathā ||11||
tataḥkopaparītātmāvegādrudraṃ jalandharaḥ |
āhvayāmāsasamaretīvrāśanisamasvanaḥ ||12||
ity uktvā bāṇasaptatyājaghānavṛṣabhadhvajam |
tānaprāptānśitair bāṇaiś cicchedaprahasanniva ||14||
sacchinnadhanvāvirathogadāmādāyavīryavān ||15||
tathāpimuṣṭimudyamyayayaurudrajighāṃ sayā ||16||
tāvacchivenabāṇaughaiḥ krośamātramapākṛtaḥ |
sasarjamāyāṃ gāṃ dharvīmadbhutāṃ rudramohinīm |
tatojaguścananṛturgandharvāpsarasāṃ ragaṇāḥ ||18||
tālaveṇumṛdaṃ gāṃś cavādayaṃ taḥ parasparam |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāmahadāścaryaṃ rudronādavimohitaḥ ||19||
kāmārtaḥ saṣjagāmāśuyatragaurīsthitābhavat |
daśadordaṇḍapaṃ cāsyastrinetraścajaṭādharaḥ |
mahāvṛṣabhamārūḍhaḥ sababhūvajalandharaḥ ||22||
yāvaddadarśacārvagīṃ pārvatīṃ danujeśvaraḥ |
tāvatsavīryaṃ mumucejaḍāṃ gaścābhavattadā ||24||
atha jṣātvātadāgaurīdānavaṃ bhayavihvalā |
jagāmāṃ tarhitātāvatsātadottaramānasam ||25||
tāmadṛṣṭvātadādaityaḥkṣaṇādvidyullatāmiva |
pārvatyapimahāviṣṇuṃ sasmāramanasātadā |
tāvaddadarśataṃ devīsopaviṣṭaṃ samīpagam ||27||
pārvatyuvāca—
nānyathāsabhavedvadhyaḥ pātivratyātsurakṣitaḥ ||29||
aṃ tarddhānagatāṃ māyāṃ dṛṣṭvātububudhetadā |
tataḥśivovismitamānasaḥ punarjagāmayuddhāyajalandharaṃ ruṣā ||31||
sacāpi daityaḥ punarāgataṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvāśaraughaiḥ samavākiradraṇe ||32||
pātivratyasyabhaṃ gāyavṛndāyāścākaronmatim ||1||
bhartāraṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ digambaram ||2||
kṛṣṇaprasūnabhūṣāḍhyaṃ kravyādagaṇasevitam |
dakṣiṇāśāṃ gataṃ muṇḍaṃ tamasāvyāvṛtaṃ tadā ||3||
tataḥ prabuddhāsābālāsvasvapnaṃ pravicinvatī ||4||
dadarśoditamādityaṃ sacchidraṃ niścalaṃ muhuḥ |
tadaniṣṭamitijṣātvārudatībhayavihvalā ||5||
kutracinnālabhaccharmagopurāṭṭālabhūmiṣu |
tatrāpisāgatābālānālabhatkutracitsukham |
vanādvanāṃ taraṃ yātānaivavedātmanastadā ||7||
tatobhramaṃ tesābālādadarśātivibhīṣaṇau |
rākṣasausiṃhavadanaudaṃṣṭrānayanabhīṣaṇau ||8||
taudṛṣṭvāvihvalātīvapalāyanaparātadā |
dadarśatāpa saṃśāntaṃ saśiṣyaṃ maunamāsthitam ||9||
tatas tatkaṇṭhaāsajyanijāṃ bāhulatāṃ bhayāt |
munemāṃ rakṣaśaraṇamāgatāmityabhāṣata ||10||
munistāṃ vihvalāṃ dṛṣṭvārākṣasānugatāṃ tadā |
huṃ kāreṇaivataughoraucakāravimukhauruṣā ||11||
yaddhuṃ kārabhayatrastaudṛṣṭvātaugaganaṃ gatau |
praṇamyadaṇḍavad bhūmau vṛndāvacanam abravīt ||12||
vṛndovāca—
rakṣitāhaṃ tvayāghorādbhayāttasmātkṛpānidhe |
kiṃ cidvijṣaptum icchāmikṛpayātanniśāmaya ||13||
tāvatkapīśāvāyātautaṃ praṇamyāgrataḥ sthitau ||15||
gatvākṣaṇārddhādāgatyavānarāvagrataḥ sthitau ||16||
śiraḥkabaṃ dhahastautaudṛṣṭvābdhitanayasyasā |
papātamūrchitā bhūmau bhartṛvyasanaduḥkhitā ||17||
kamaṇḍalujalaiḥ siktāmunināśvāsitātadā |
svabhartṛbhālesābhālaṃ kṛtvākhinnārurodaha ||18||
vṛndovāca—-
yena devāḥ sa-gandharvā nirjitā hariṇā saha |
ruditveti tadā vṛndā taṃ muniṃ vākyam abravīt |
vṛndovāca—
kṛpā-nidhe muni-śreṣṭha jīvanaṃ me’sya supriyam ||21||
nāyaṃ jīvayituṃ śakyo rudreṇa nihato yudhi |
tathāpi tvat-kṛpāviṣṭa evaṃ saṃjīvayāmy aham ||23||
vṛndām āliṅgya tad-vaktraṃ cucumbe prīta-mānasaḥ ||24||
atha vṛndāpi bhartāraṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣita-mānasā |
kadācit suratasyānte dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ tam eva hi |
vṛndovāca—
dhik tavedaṃ hare śīlaṃ para-dārābhigāminaḥ |
jṣāto’si tvaṃ mayā samyaṅ māyā-pratyakṣa-tāpasaḥ ||27||
tāv eva rākṣasau bhūtvā bhāryāṃ tava hariṣyatha ||28||
tvaṃ cāpi bhāryā duḥkhārto vanekapi sahāyavān |
bhrama sarveśvareṇāyaṃ yas te śiṣyatvam āgataḥ ||29||
ity uktvā sā tadā vṛndā prāviśad dhavya-vāhanam |
viṣṇunā vāryamāṇāpi tasminn āsakta-mānasā ||30||
vṛndācitā-bhasma-rajo’vaguṇṭhitaḥ |
kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
cakāra māyayā gaurīṃ try-ambakaṃ mohayaṃs tadā ||1||
rathoparigatāṃ dṛṣṭvā rudantīṃ ca tadā śivaḥ |
śumbha-niśumbha-daityaiś ca vadhyamānāṃ dadarśa saḥ ||2||
gaurīṃ tathā-vidhāṃ dṛṣṭvā śivo’py udvigna-mānasaḥ |
avāṅ-mukhaḥ sthitas tūṣṇīṃ vismṛtya sva-parākramam ||3||
tato jajṣe satāṃ māyāṃ viṣṇunā samprabodhitaḥ |
raudra-rūpa-dharo jāto jvālā-mālāti-bhīṣaṇaḥ ||5||
tasyātīva mahā-raudraṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāsurāḥ |
na śekuḥ pramukhe sthātuṃ bhejire ca diśo daśa ||6||
tataḥ śāpaṃ dadau devas tayoḥ śumbha-niśumbhayoḥ |
bāṇāndhakāra-saṃcchannaṃ yathā bhūmi-talaṃ mahat ||8||
yāvad rudraḥ praciccheda tasya bāṇāṃs tvarānvitaḥ |
tāvat sa parigheṇāśu jaghāna vṛṣabhaṃ balī ||9||
vṛṣas tena prahāreṇa parāvṛtto raṇāṅgaṇāt |
rudreṇākṛṣyamāṇo’pi na tasthau raṇa-bhūmiṣu ||10||
rathātkāyaḥ papātorvyāṃ nādayanvasudhātalam |
dṛṣṭvādehodbhavaṃ tejastadgaurīśelayaṃ gatam |
atha cendrādayodevāharṣādutphullalocanāḥ ||14||
praṇamyaśirasārudraṃ śaśaṃ surviṣṇuceṣṭitam |
mahādevatvayādevārakṣitāḥśatrujādbhayāt ||15||
vṛndālāvaṇya saṃbhrāṃ toviṣṇustiṣṭhatimohitaḥ ||16||
gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ devāviṣṇor mohāpanuttaye |
śaraṇyāṃ mohinīṃ māyāṃ sāvaḥkāryaṃ kariṣyati ||17||
devāścatuṣṭuvurmūlaprakṛtiṃ bhakta-vatsalām ||18||
yadicchayāviśvamidaṃ bhavābhavautanotiśuddhāṃ prakṛtiṃ natāḥ smatām ||19||
yehitrayoviṃśatibhedi saṃjṣitājagatyaśeṣesamadhiṣṭhitāpurā |
yadrūpakarmāṇijaḍāstrayo’pitedevāvidurnaprakṛtiṃ natāḥ smatām ||20||
yadbhaktiyuktāḥ puruṣāstunityaṃ dāridryavyāmohaparābhavādikam |
naprāpnuvantyevahibhakta-vatsalāṃ sadaivaviṣṇoḥ prakṛtiṃ natāḥ smatām ||21||
stotrametattri saṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedekāgramānasaḥ |
dāridramohaduḥkhāninakadācitspṛśanti tam ||22||
dadṛśurgaganetatrajvālāvyāptadigaṃ tarām ||23||
tanmadhyādbhāratīṃ sarvedadṛśurvyomacāriṇīm |
ahamevatridhābhinnātiṣṭhāmitrividhairguṇaiḥ ||24||
gaurīlakṣmīsvarācetirajaḥ sattvatamoguṇaiḥ |
tatragacchatataṃ kāryaṃ vidhāsyanti cavaḥ surāḥ ||25||
śṛṇvatāmitidevānāmaṃ tarddhānamagānmahaḥ |
devānāṃ vismayotphullanetrāṇāṃ tattadānṛpa ||26||
tataḥ sarve’pitedevāgatvātadvākyanoditāḥ |
gaurīṃ lakṣmīṃ svarāṃ caivapraṇemurbhaktitat-parāḥ ||27||
tatas tās tān surān dṛṣṭvā praṇatān bhakta-vatsalāḥ |
bījāni pradadus tebhyo vākyāny ūcuś ca bhūmipa ||28||
devya ūcuḥ—
imāni kṣetra-bījāniviṣṇur yatrāvatiṣṭhati |
nirvapadhvaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhavatāṃ siddhim eṣyati ||29||
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
dhātrī ca mālatī caiva tulasī ca nṛpottama ||1||
dhātry-udbhavā smṛtā dhātrī mābhavā mālatī smṛtā |
gaurī bhavā ca tulasī tamaḥ-sattva-rajo-guṇāḥ ||2||
strīrūpiṇyauvanaspatyaudṛṣṭvāviṣṇustadānṛpa |
uttasthausaṃbhramādvṛndārūpātiśayamohitaḥ ||3||
dadarśa tās tadā mohāt kāmāsaktena cetasā |

evaṃ śayyāṃ tu saṃkalpa praṇipatya ca tān dvijān |
prārthayec cānumodārthaṃ viṣṇu-lokaṃ vrajāmy aham ||51||
tato vrajen nara-śreṣṭho viṣṇoḥ sthānam anāma yam |
maṇḍapa-sthāṃ stutān viprān iti vācyaṃ muhur muhuḥ ||52||
mantra-hīnaṃ kriyā-hīnaṃ sarva-hīnaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
sarvaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yā tu bhavad-vākya-prasādataḥ |
viṃśaty-adhika-śatatamo’dhayāyaḥ
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya punaḥ papraccha pāvakiḥ |
śālagrāmārcanaṃ bhūyas tac chṛṇudhvaṃ tapo-dhanāḥ ||1||
bhagavan yogināṃ śreṣṭha sarve dharmāḥ śrutā mayā |
śālagrāmārcanaṃ brūhi vistareṇa mama prabho ||2||
sādhu sādhu mahā-prājṣa yan māṃ hi paripṛcchasi |
tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ mama vatsala ||3||
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu trailokyaṃ sa-carācaram |
mahāśaya mahāsena nityaṃ tiṣṭhati saṃhitam ||4||
dṛṣṭaṃ praṇamitaṃ yena snāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ tathā |
yajṣa-koṭi-guṇaṃ puṇyaṃ gavāṃ koṭi-phalaṃ labhet ||5||
smṛtaṃ saṅkīrtitaṃ dhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ ca namaskṛtam ||8||
śālagrāma-śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā yānti pāpāny anekaśaḥ |
siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā yānti vane mṛga-gaṇā bhayāt ||9||
namaskāraṃ tu manujaḥ śālagrāma-śilārcane |
bhaktyā vā yadi vā’bhaktyā kṛtvā muktim avāpnuyāt ||10||
yaḥ karoti naro nityaṃ śālagrāma-śilārcanam ||11||
gītair vādyais tathā stotraiḥ śālagrāma-śilārcanam ||12||
śālagrāma-namaskāro bhāvenāpi naraiḥ kṛtaḥ |
mānuṣatvaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ mad-bhaktā ye narā bhuvi ||14||
mad-bhaktās tīvra-pāpiṣṭhā mat-prabhuṃ na namanti ye |
mal-liṅga-sparśanaṃ kāryaṃ nānyāśuddhir vidhīyate |
yā tithir dayitā viṣṇoḥ sā tithir mama vallabhā ||17||
na kṛtaṃ martya-loke yaiḥ śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu yaḥ karoti mamārcanam ||21||
bhuktvā nya-deva-naivedyaṃ dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca ret ||24||
yo hi māheśvaro bhūtvā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca na pūjayet ||26||
dveṣṭā ca yāti narakaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa |
jyeṣṭhāśramī gṛhe yasya muhūrtam api viśramet ||27||
pitā mahā-yugāny aṣṭau bhavaty amṛta-bhojinaḥ |
saṃsāre duḥkha-kāntāre nimajjyante narādhamāḥ ||28||
varṣa-koṭi-sahasrāṇi kṛṣṇārādhana-varjitāḥ |
snehād abhyarcitair liṅgaiḥ śālagrāma-samudbhavaiḥ ||29||
muktiṃ prayānti manujā yoga-sāṅkhyena varjitāḥ |
mal-liṅga-koṭibhir dṛṣṭair yat phalaṃ pūjitaiḥ stutaiḥ ||30||
śālagrāma-śilāyāṃ tu ekasyām iha tad bhavet |
dvādaśaiva śilā yo vai śālagrāma-samudbhavāḥ ||31||
koṭi-liṅga-sahasrais tu pūjitair jāhnavī-taṭe ||32||
kāśī-vāse yugāny aṣṭau dinenaikena tad bhavet |
nāhaṃ brahmādayo devāḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ samīhate |
kartavyaṃ mama tad-bhaktyā śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
śālagrāma-śilā-rūpī yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ ||35|
tatra devāsurā yakṣā bhuvanāni caturdaśa ||36||
surāṇāṃ kīrtanaiḥ sarvaiḥ koṭibhiś ca phalaṃ labhet |
tat phalaṃ kīrtanād eva keśave sukṛtaṃ kalau ||37||
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu sakṛt piṇḍena tarpitāḥ |
ye pibanti narā bhaktyā śālagrāma-śilā-jalam |
prāyaścitte samutpanne kiṃ dānaiḥ kim upoṣaṇaiḥ |
cāndrāyaṇaiḥ sucīrṇaiś ca pītvā pādodakaṃ hareḥ ||40||
yaḥ karoti taḍāge tu pratimāṃ jala-śāyinīm |
koṭibhiś cāpi kiṃ kāryam anya-devaiś ca pūjitaiḥ ||41||
phala-pramāṇaṃ naivāsti śālagrāma-śilārcane |
yo dadāti śilāṃ viṣṇoḥ śālagrāma-samudbhavām ||43||
viprāya viṣṇu-bhaktāya teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ śataiḥ |
sastrātaḥ sarva-tīrtheṣu sarva-yajṣeṣu dīkṣitaḥ |
śālagrāma-śilā-toyair abhiṣekaṃ samācaret ||45||
svarge martye ca pātāle pāṣāṇāḥ santi vai guha |
śālagrāma-śilā-grāvṇā nāsti nāsti samā punaḥ ||46||
tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti śālagrāma-śilārcanāt |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ mūlaṃ dūrvā-dalaṃ tathā ||48||
jāyate meruṇā tulyaṃ śālagrāme samarpitam |
yat tu pūrvaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ keśave kleśa-nāśanam ||50||
kva tvaṃ vasasi he viṣṇo kim ādhāraḥ kim āśrayaḥ ||51||
nivasāmi sadā śambho śālagrāmodbhave’śmani ||52||
tatraiva ratha-cakrāṅke yāni nāmāni me śṛṇu |
dvāra-deśe same cakre dṛśyete nāntaraṃ yadi |
vāsudevaḥ sa vijṣeyaḥ śuklaś caivātiśobhanaḥ ||53||
suṣiraṃ cchidra-bahulaṃ dīrghākāraṃ tu tad bhavet ||54||
aniruddhas tu pītābho vartulaś cātiśobhanaḥ |
rekhā-trayāṅkito dvāri dṛṣṭa-padmena cihnavat ||55||
śyāmo nārāyaṇo devo nābhi-cakre tathonnate |
dīrgha-reṣā-samopeto dakṣiṇe suṣirānvitaḥ ||56||
ūrdhvaṃ mukhaṃ ca jānīyāt sundaraṃ hari-rūpiṇam |
kāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva arthadaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||57||
parameṣṭhī ca śuklābhaḥ padma-cakra-samanvitaḥ |
bimbākṛtis tathā pṛṣṭhe suṣiraṃ cātipuṣkalam ||58||
kṛṣṇa-varṇas tathā viṣṇur mūle cakre suśobhane |
dvāropari tathā rekhā lakṣyate madhya-deśataḥ ||59||
kapilo narasiṃhaś ca pṛthu-cakraḥ suśobhitaḥ |
vārāhaḥ śakti-liṅgas tu cakre ca viṣame smṛte |
indra-nīla-nibhaḥ sthūlas tri-rekho nābhitaḥ śubhaḥ ||61||
dīrghā kāṣcana-varṇā yā bindu-traya-vibhūṣitā |
matsyākhyā sā śilā jṣeyā bhukti-mukti-phala-pradā ||62||
kūrmas tathonnataḥ pṛṣṭhe vartulaś cakra-pūritaḥ |
hayagrīvo hayākāro rekhā-paṣcaka-bhūṣitaḥ |
bahu-bindu-samākīrṇaḥ pṛṣṭhe nīlaṃ ca rūpakam ||64||
vaikuṇṭham avibhinnāṅgaṃ cakram ekaṃ tathā dhvajam |
dvāropari tathā rekhā guṣjākārā suśobhanā ||65||
śrīdharas tu tathā devaś cihnito vanamālayā |
kadamba-kusumākāro rekhā-paṣcaka-bhūṣitaḥ ||66||
vartulaś cātihrasvaś ca vāmanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
sudarśanas tato devaḥ śyāma-varṇo mahā-dyutiḥ |
vāma-pārśve gadā-cakre rekhā caiva tu dakṣiṇe ||68||
dūrvābhaṃ dvāra-saṅkīrṇaṃ pīta-rekhaṃ tathaiva ca ||69||
nānā-varṇo hy anantas tu nānā-bhogena cihnitaḥ |
dṛśyate śikhare liṅgaṃ śālagrāma-śilodbhavam |
cakrāṅkitaṃ hiraṇyāṅgaṃ raśmi-jālaṃ vinirdiśet |
suvarṇa-rekhā-bahulaṃ sphāṭika-dyuti-śobhitam ||74||
rūkṣā udvega-jananī vakrā dāridrya-bhāginī ||76||
ekaṃ sudarśanaṃ jṣeyaṃ lakṣmī-nārāyaṇaṃ dvayam |
tṛtīyaṃ cācyutaṃ vidyāc caturthaṃ tu janārdanam ||77||
paṣcamaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ pradyumnam eva ca |
saṅkarṣaṇaṃ saptamaṃ ca aṣṭamaṃ puruṣottamam ||78||
navamaṃ ca nava-vyūhaṃ daśamaṃ tu tad-ātmakam |
ekādaśaṃ cāniruddhaṃ dvādaśaṃ dvādaśātmakam ||79||
ata ūrdhvaṃ tu cakrāṇi dṛśyante’nanta-saṃjṣake |
khaṇḍite truṭite bhagne śālagrāme na doṣa-bhāk ||80||
iṣṭā ca yasya yā mūrtiḥ satāṃ yatnena pūjayet |
śālagrāma-śilā yatra tatra saṃnihito hariḥ ||82||
tatra dānaṃ japaḥ snānaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ śatādhikam |
tatra koṭi-guṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ mahā-phalam |
tat sarvaṃ nirdahaty āśu śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
śālagrāmodbhavo devo yatra dvārāvatī bhavaḥ ||85||
bhoktavyaṃ viṣṇu-naivedyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
na stutir nāpi cācāraḥ śālagrāma-śilārcane |
śālagrāma-śilāgre tu kṛtvā svastikam ādarāt ||88||
kārttike tu viśeṣeṇa punāty ā-saptamaṃ kulam |
aṇu-mātraṃ tu yaḥ kuryān maṇḍalaṃ keśavāgrataḥ ||89||
mṛdā dhātu-vikāraiś ca kalpa-koṭiṃ divaṃ vaset |
kārttike svastikaṃ kṛtvā samam etan na saṃśayaḥ |
tat pāpaṃ nāśam āyāti maṇḍayitvā harer gṛham |
maṇḍalaṃ kurute nityaṃ yā nārī keśavāgrataḥ |
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye śrī-kṛṣṇa-satyabhāmā-saṃvāde
śāligrāma-māhātmyaṃ nāma
dhātrī-cchāyāṃ samāśritya kuryāt piṇḍaṃ tu yo guha |
dhatte dhātrī-phalaṃ vatsa-dhātrī-phala-vibhūṣitaḥ ||2||
dhātrī-phala-kṛtāhāro naro nārāyaṇo bhavet |
yaḥ kaścid vaiṣṇavo loke dhatte dhātrī-phalaṃ guha ||3||
priyo bhavati devānāṃ manuṣyāṇaṃ ca kā kathā |
na jahyāt tulasī-mālāṃ dhātrī-mālāṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4||
yāvat tiṣṭhati kaṇṭha-sthā dhātrī-mālā narasya hi |
tāvat tasya śarīre tu pratiṣṭhati ca keśavaḥ ||5||
dhātrīṃ phalaṃ tu tulasī-mṛttikā-dvārakodbhavā |
yāvad dināni vahate dhātrī-mālāṃ kalau naraḥ |
vahate kaṇṭha-deśe tu kalpa-koṭi-ṃ divaṃ vaset ||8||
saṃniyamyendriya-grāmaṃ śālagrāma-śilārcanam |
yaḥ kuryān mānavo bhaktyā puṣpe puṣpe’śvamedha-jam ||9||
surāṇāṃ ca yathā viṣṇuḥ puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī tathā |
tulasī-mālayā viṣṇuḥ pūjito yena kārttike ||11||
yamākṣara-kṛtāṃ mālāṃ sphuṭaṃ śauriḥ pramārjati |
śrī-candanaṃ sa-karpūram aguruṃ ca sa-kuṅkumam ||12||
ketakī-dīpa-dānaṃ ca sarvadā keśava-priyam |
dīpa-dānaṃ mahāsena-kulānāṃ tārayec chatam |
kārttike ca dināny eva dīpa-dānaṃ tu paṣcamam |
ketakī-mālayā yena kārttike puṣpa-maṇḍapam ||15||
samāḥ sahasraṃ suprīto jāyate madhusūdanaḥ |
arcayitvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ kusumaiḥ ketakī-bhavaiḥ ||17||
puṇyaṃ tad-bhavanaṃ yāti keśavasya śivaṃ guha |
vihāya sarva-puṣpāṇi muni-puṣpeṇa keśavam ||21||
muni-puṣpa-kṛtāṃ mālāṃ yo dadāti janārdane ||22||
tulasī-dalena saṃprītaḥ kārttike ca tathā hariḥ ||
praśrayāvanataṃ dṛṣṭvā kumāraṃ bhakti-tat-param ||25||
punaḥ provāca bhagavān mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ |
śṛṇu dīpasya māhātmyaṃ kārttike śikhi vāhana ||26||
pitaraś caiva vāṣchanti sadā pitṛ-gaṇair vṛtāḥ |
teneṣṭaṃ kratubhiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ tīrthāvagāhanam ||29||
ekādaśyāṃ parair dattaṃ dīpaṃ prajvālya mūṣikā ||31||
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya parāṃ gatim avāpa sā |
lubdhako’pi caturdaśyāṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram ||32||
nirbhakṣaḥ paramaṃ prāpya viṣṇu-lokaṃ jagāma saḥ |
śvapākasyāśrayād vaiśyā dīpaṃ kṛtvā paraiḥ kṛtam ||33||
śuddhā līlāvatī bhūtvā jagāma svargam akṣayam |
gopaḥ kaścid amāvasyāṃ pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ||34||
tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyā rātrāv astamate ravau ||35||
gṛheṣu sarva-goṣṭheṣu sarveṣv āyataneṣu ca |
devālayeṣu devānāṃ śmaśāneṣu saraḥsu ca ||36||
ghṛtādinā śubhārthāya yāvat paṣca-dināni ca |
pāpinaḥ pitaro ye ca lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ |
te’pi yānti parāṃ muktiṃ dīpa-dānasya puṇyataḥ ||37||
uttara-khaṇḍe kārttika-māhātmye
dīpa-gandha-dhātrī-māhātmya-varṇano nāma
dīpāvaliphalaṃ nāthaviśeṣādbrūhisāṃ pratam |
kimarthaṃ kriyatesātutasyāḥkādevatābhavet ||1||
praharṣaḥko’tranirdiṣṭaḥkrīḍākātraprakīrtitā ||2||
itiskaṃ davacaḥśrutvā bhagavānkāmaśoṣaṇaḥ |
sādhūktvākārttikaṃ viprāḥ prahasannidamabravīt ||3||
śrīśiva uvāca—
kārttikasyāsitepakṣetrayodaśyāṃ tupāvake |
mṛtyunā pāśa-hastena kālena bhāryayā saha |
trayodaśīdīpa-dānātsūryajaḥ prīyatāmiti ||5||
kārttike kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ vidhūdaye |
avaśyamevakartavyaṃ snānaṃ ca pāpabhīrubhiḥ ||6||
pakṣepratyūṣasamayesnānaṃ kuryād ataṃ dritaḥ ||7||
tailelakṣmīrjalegaṅgādīpāvalyāṃ ca turdaśīm |
prāptaḥ snānaṃ hiyaḥ kuryād yamalokaṃ napaśyati ||8||
apāmārgas tathātuṃ bīprapunnāṭaṃ ca vāhvalam |
sītāloṣṭasamāyuktasakaṇṭakadalānvita |
harapāpamapāmārgabhrāmyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||10||
apāmārgaṃ prapunnāṭaṃ bhrāmayecchirasopari |
tataś ca tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yamarājasyanāma bhiḥ ||11||
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca |
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarva-bhūta-kṣayāya ca ||12||
audumbarāya dadhnāya nīlāya parameṣṭhine |
narakāya pradātavyo dīpaḥ saṃpūjya devatāḥ |
tataḥ pradoṣa-samaye dīpān dadyān manoharān ||14||
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhavaneṣuviśeṣataḥ |
kūṭāgāreṣucaityeṣusabhāsucanadīṣuca ||15||
prākārodyānavāpīṣupratolīniṣkuṭeṣuca |
maṃ durāsuviviktāsuhastiśālāsucaiva hi ||16||
evaṃ prabhātasamayehyamāvāsyāṃ tupāvakaṃ |
snātvā devānpitṝnbhaktyāsaṃpūjyāthapraṇamyaca ||17||
kṛtvātupārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ dadhikṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ |
teṣāṃ goṣṭhīṃ ca mānaṃ ca kṛtvāsaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ ||19||
vaktṛṇāṃ vatsaraṃ yāvatprītirutpadyateguha |
pumānvaivatsaraṃ yāvallakṣmīstaṃ naivamuṣcati ||21||
abhayaṃ prāpyaviprebhyoviṣṇubhītāsuradviṣaḥ |
suptaṃ kṣīrodadhaujṣātvālakṣmīṃ padmāśritāṃ tathā ||22||
tvaṃ jyotiḥśrīraviścandrovidyutsauvarṇatārakaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirdīpajyotiḥ sthitātuyā ||23||
yālakṣmīrdivasepuṇyedīpāvalyāṃ ca bhūtale |
gavāṃ goṣṭhetukārttikyāṃ sālakṣmīrvaradāmama ||24||
śaṃ karaścabhavānīcakrīḍayādyūtamāsthitau |
bhavānyābhyarcitā lakṣmīr dhenu-rūpeṇa saṃsthitā ||25||
ato’yaṃ śaṅkaro duḥkhī gaurī nityaṃ sukhe sthitā ||26||
tāvannagaranārībhis tūryaḍiṇḍimavādanaiḥ |
niṣkāsyateprahṛṣṭābhiralakṣmīścagṛhāṃ gaṇāt ||28||
prātargovarddhanaḥ pūjyodyūtaṃ rātrausamācaret ||29||
bhūṣaṇīyās tathāgāvovarjyāvahanadohanāt |
viṣṇu-bāhu-kṛtocchrāya gavāṃ koṭi-prado bhava |
yā lakṣmīr loka-pālānāṃ dhenu-rūpeṇa saṃsthitā ||31||
ghṛtaṃ vahati yajṣānāṃ mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu |
agrataḥ santu me gāvo gāvo me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ |
sadbhāvenaivasaṃtoṣyadevānsatpuruṣānnarān |
itareṣāmannapānairvākyadānenapaṇḍitān ||33||
vastrais tāmbūladīpaiś capuṣpakarpūrakuṃ kumaiḥ |
grāmarṣabhaṃ ca dānaiś casāmaṃ tānnṛpatirdhanaiḥ |
padātijanasaṃ##ścagraiveyaiḥ kaṭakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||35||
svānamātyāṃ ścatānrājātoṣayetsvajanānpṛthak |
yathārthaṃ toṣayitvātutatomallānnaṭāṃs tathā ||36||
vṛṣabhāṃ ścamahokṣāṃ ścayuddhyamānānparaiḥ saha |
rājānyāṃ ścāpi yodhāṃ ścapadātīnsasamalaṅkṛtān ||37||
maṃ cārūḍhaḥ svayaṃ paśyennaṭanartakacāraṇān |
tatoparāhṇasamayepūrvasyāṃ diśipāvake ||39||
mārgapālīṃ prabadhnīyāddurgastaṃ bhe’thapādape |
kuśakāśamayīṃ divyāṃ laṃ bakairbahubhirguha ||40||
vīkṣayitvāgajānaśvānmārgapālyāstalenayet |
gāvairvṛṣāṃ ścamahiṣānmahiṣīrghaṇṭikotkaṭāḥ ||41||
namaskāraṃ tataḥ kuryānmantreṇānenasuvrataḥ ||42||
pūjāṃ kuryāttataḥ sākṣād bhūmau maṇḍalakekṛte ||45||
balimālikhyadaityendraṃ varṇakaiḥ paṣcaraṃ gakaiḥ |
sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ vindhyāvalisamanvitam |46||
kūṣmāṇḍamayajaṃ bhorumadhudānavasaṃvṛtam |

prāyaścittaṃ paraṃ tīrthe snānaṃ ca ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam ||89||
kiṃ tu tīrthe tyajed bhīru manasāpy aśubhaṃ kṛtam |
prayāga-snāna-śuddhātvaṃ svargaṃ yāsyasi niścitam ||90||
prayāga-snāna-mātreṇa nṛṇāṃ svargo na saṃśayaḥ |
anya-deśa-kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tat-kṣaṇād eva bhāmini ||91||

śṛṇu bhīru purā śakro gautamasya muner vadhūm ||92||

ṛṣi-strī-gantur indrasya tasyāś ca puratas tadā |

āyuḥ-kīrtir yaśo-dharma-dhair ya-dhvaṃsakarī tathā |
dhiṅ manmathaṃ durācāram āpadāṃ niya##||99||

aparādhād yathā janma syād ihāmutra-niṣphalam |

devarāja vacaḥ śrutvā jagau vipro bṛhaspatiḥ ||113||
śṛṇu devendra vakṣye'ham upāyaṃ pāpa-nāśanam |

tyaktvā bandhu-janaṃ sarvaṃ dāsa-dāsī-gṛhaṃ tathā |

narakārṇava-sampāta-dāruṇāntara-vahninā ||124||
hṛdaye kuṇapa-vyāghra tadā tat-tapyamānayā |
mayā gatvā kṛtaṃ snānaṃ māghe māsi sitāsite ||125||

ramamāṇā tu kailāse girijā yāḥ priyā sakhī ||127||

mat-prītaye caritraṃ svaṃ tvaṃ brūhi mama rākṣasa |
karmaṇā kena jāto'si virūpo'tibhayaṅkaraḥ ||130||

ato vakṣyāmi te bhadre duṣkṛtaṃ yat svayaṃ kṛtam ||133||
śṛṇu suśroṇy ahaṃ kāśyāṃ bahvṛco veda-pāragaḥ ||134||
jātaḥ purā dvijaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kule mahati nirmale |

anyac ca pātakaṃ tatra mamābhūn mūḍha-cetasaḥ |

pratijṣāṃ tu dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yatiṣye tava muktaye |
bahavo hi kṛtā māghā varṣe varṣe yathā-vidhi ||152||

gūḍho dharmo hi kartavya ity ūcur vibudhā janāḥ |
ārtedānaṃ praśaṃsanti munayo veda-vādinaḥ ||154||

deva-yānaṃ samārūḍhaḥ saharṣotphulla-locanaḥ |

tvam asti nāsti vaikuṇṭha tvām ahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ |
tvaṃ karma-phala-dātā ca dīkṣitānāṃ kriyā-phalam ||257||
tvaṃ hetuḥ sarva-bhūtānāṃ tvam eva śaraṇaṃ mama ||
yuvatīnāṃ yathā yūni yūnāṃ ca yuvatau yathā ||258||
api pāpaṃ durācāraṃ naraṃ tvat-praṇataṃ hare ||259||
nekṣante kiṅkarā yāmyā ulūkās tapanaṃ yathā |
yaṃ na spṛśanti guṇa-jāti-śarīra-dharmāyaṃ
yaṃ ca spṛśanti munayo gata-saṃga-mohās
sthūlaṃ vilāpya karaṇe karaṇaṃ nidāne
tat-kāraṇaṃ karaṇa-kāraṇa-varjite ca |
yad-dhyāna-saṃvahana-ghūrṇa-vaśīkṛtāṃ tām
aiśvarya-cāru-guṇi rnī sukha-mokṣa-lakṣmīm |
āliṅgya śerata ihātma-sukhaika-bhājas
yaṃ tāpayanti na sadā madanādi-doṣās
yad-dhyāna-saṃgatam alaṃ vijahātya-vidyāṃ
yaj-jñānam ullasad asidy ṃśayāriṃ
taṃ tvāṃ hariṃ vaśadibodhaghanaṃ namāmi ||266||
carācarāṇibhūtāni sarvāṇi caharervaśe |
yathānārāyaṇaḥ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃ gamam |
darśayāmāsacātmānaṃ saprītaḥpuruṣottamaḥ ||270||
jagāma kamalā-kāntaḥ stutyā vipreṇa toṣitaḥ ||271||
kṛta-kṛtyo dvijaḥ so'pi vāsudeva-parāyaṇaḥ |
śiṣyaiḥ sārdhaṃ japan stotraṃ tasminn āste tapo-vane ||272||
kīrtayedyaidaṃ stotraṃ śṛṇuyādyo'pimānavaḥ |
ātmavidyāprabodhaṃ calabhatebrāhmaṇaḥ sadā |
nṛṇāmbhavatisarveṣāmasyastotrasyakīrtanāt ||275||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yaṃ yaṃ kāmayatesadā |
acirāttamavāpnotistotreṇānenamānavaḥ ||279||
nṛṇāmbhavatinityaṃ dhīrimāṃ saṃśṛṇvatāṃ stutim ||280||
mahāpātakayuktovāyuktovāhyupapātakaiḥ |
prajṣālakṣmīryaśaḥkīrtijñānadharmavivardhanam |
duṣṭagrahopaśamanaṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam ||282||
sarvavyādhiharaṃ pathyaṃ sarvāriṣṭaniṣūdanam |
durgatestaraṇaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ ||283||
nakṣatragrahāpīḍāsurājacorabhayeṣuca |
siṃ havyāghrabhayaṃ nāstinābhicārabhayaṃ tathā |
pūtanājṛṃ bhakebhyaścavighnebhyaścaivasarvadā |
nṛṇāṃ kvacidbhayaṃ nāstistavehyasminprakīrtite ||286||
vāsudevasyapūjāṃ yaḥkṛtvāstotramudīrayet |
gaṅgādipūṇyatīrtheṣuyāsnānair nāpyategatiḥ |
tāṃ gatiṃ samavāpnotipaṭhanpuṇyāmimāṃ stutim ||288||
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vātrikālaṃ vāpiyaḥpaṭhet |
sarvadāsarvakāleṣuso'kṣayaṃ sukhamaśnute ||289||
caturṇāmapivedānāṃ trirāvṛttyācayat phalam |
akṣayyaṃ dhanamāpnotistrīṇāmbhavativallabhaḥ |
pūjāṃ viṃ datiloke'smiṃ cchraddhayāsaṃsmaranharīm ||291||
alakṣmī-kāla-karṇī ca duḥ svapnaṃ durvicintitam |
sadyo naśyanti bhaktānām etaṃ saṃśṛṇvatāṃ stavam ||293||
prātar utthāya yo'dhīte śucir viṣṇu-parāyaṇaḥ |
deva-dyuti-praṇītaṃ vai viṣṇu-prīti-karaṃ śubham |
viṣṇu-prasāda-jananaṃ viṣṇu-darśana-kārakam ||295||
yaḥ paṭhet satataṃ bhaktyā viṣṇu-lokaṃ sa gacchati ||296||
iti te kathitaṃ stotraṃ guhyaṃ pāpa-praṇāśanam |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi piśācasya vimocanam ||297||
uttara-khaṇḍe māgha-māhātmye vasiṣṭha-dilīpa-saṃvāde
śrūyatāṃ yepiśācāścamocitāstenatadvane |
āsīdrājācitranāmādrāviḍeviṣayepurā ||1||
somānvayemahāvīraḥ śūraḥ śastrāstrapāragaḥ |
svarṇair nānāvidhair atnaiḥ pūrṇakośomahādhanaḥ |
madhyenārīsahasrasyasadākrīḍatitatparaḥ ||3||
straiṇaḥkāmīsadālubdhaścaṇḍakopaḥ sapārthivaḥ |
viṣṇuṃ niṃ datiso'tyarthaṃ vaiṣṇavāndveṣṭisarvadā |
ko'sauviṣṇuḥkvadṛṣṭo'saukvacāstekenakīrtyate ||5||
itthaṃ nasahateviṣṇuṃ sarājādaivamohitaḥ |
nārāyaṇaṃ bhajante yetānpīḍayatiko'pitaḥ ||6||
nabrāhmaṇānnavedāṃś cavaidikaṃ karmanavratam |
nadānaṃ manyatedātuṃ pākhaṇḍasthitisaṃsthitaḥ ||7||
anītyācaṇḍadaṇḍaiś ca prajāpīḍāṃ karotisaḥ |
niṣṭhuronirdayaḥkrūraḥpuṇyakāryaparāṅmukhaḥ ||8||
cyutācāro'cyutadveṣṭācyutāgniścacyutakriyaḥ |
so'nuśāstijanaṃ bhūpaḥkālarūpaivāparaḥ ||9||
tato bahutithekālesarājāpaṣcatāṃ gataḥ |
athakiṃ karayūthenapīḍyamānobhṛśaṃ tadā |
caṇḍārkaraśmisantaptevṛkṣacchāyāvivarjite |
taptāṃ gāraprakīrṇecavahnijvālāsamākule ||12||
lohatuṇḍaiś ca kākolair hanyamānaḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
vṛkair daṃ ṣṭrākarālaiś ca śvabhirghoraiś ca bhakṣitaḥ ||13||
śṛṇvankraṃ ditamanyeṣāṃ nṛṇāṃ kilbiṣakāriṇām |
śṛṇubhūpagatiṃ tasyatasmiṃ ṃ llokesuduḥ sahām |
nirayānnirayaṃ yātaḥparyāyeṇasabhūpatiḥ ||15||
ādauprayātastāmisredāruṇebhūriduḥkhade |
paścānmagnaḥ sabhūpālodustareduḥkhamūrchitaḥ |
saṃjīvanemahāvīcautāpanesampratāpane ||18||
pratāpanarakaṃ rājāduḥkhāgnipluṣṭamānasaḥ |
sampātaṃ casakākolaṃ kuḍūmalaṃ pūtimṛttikam ||19||
lohaśaṃ kuṃ mṛgīyaṃ traṃ paṃ thānaṃ śālmaliṃ nadīm |
praviṣṭo'thamahābhīmaṃ durdarśaṃ durgamaṃ punaḥ ||20||
evameteṣusarveṣupatitvāpāpakṛnnṛpaḥ ||21||
aviṃ dannarakeghoresaṃtāpaṃ yātanāma yam |
viṣṇupradveṣaghoṣeṇayugānāmekaviṃ śatiḥ ||22||
bhuktvā ca yātanāṃ yāmyāṃ nistīrṇanarakonṛpaḥ |
samayādgirirājetupiśāco'bhūttadāmahān ||23||
napaśyatyaśanaṃ toyaṃ merāvapisadāgirau ||24||
kadācitparyaṭanso'thapiśācaḥ śokapīḍitaḥ |
plakṣaprasravaṇāraṇyaṃ praviṣṭobhāvisat phalam ||25||
bibhītakatarucchāyāṃ samāśrityasuduḥkhitaḥ |
hāhato'smīticākraṃ dadghoramuccaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ ||26||
krṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ muhyamānasyasarva-bhūtadruhomama |
itthaṃ tasyapiśācasyarodanaṃ dīnacetasaḥ |
devadyutiradhīyānaḥ śuśrāvakaruṇāmayam ||29||
samāgamyatatas tatra taṃ piśācaṃ dadarśasaḥ |
vikarālamukhaṃ bhīmaṃ piśaṃ ganayanaṃ kṛśam ||30||
ūrdhva-mūrdha-ja-kṛṣṇāṅgaṃ yama-dūtam ivāparam |
lalaj-jihvaṃ ca lamboṣṭha-dīrgha-jaṅghaṃ śirākulam ||31||
dīrghāṅghriṃ śuṣka-tuṇḍaṃ ca gartākṣaṃ śuṣka-paṣjaram |
athāmuṃ kautukāviṣṭaḥ papraccha muni-puṅgavaḥ ||32||
ko'si tvaṃ bhīṣaṇākāraḥ kuto rodiṣi dāruṇam |
avastheyaṃ kuto brūhi kiṃ cāhaṃ karavāṇi te ||33||
mamāśrama-praviṣṭā hi duḥkha-bhājo na jantavaḥ |
kāla-kṣepaṃ na kurvanti prāpte'rthe hi manīṣiṇaḥ ||35||
śrutvaitad-vacanaṃ prītaḥ piśācas tyakta-rodanaḥ |
uvāca— dīnayā vācā praśrayāvanatas tadā ||36||
piśāca uvāca—
sarvāṃ gavyāpi santāpaṃ jahāra tvad-vaco mayi |
grīṣme dāvānalodbhūtaṃ varṣan meghaivācale ||37||
yan me'sti sukṛtaṃ kiṣcit tena dṛṣṭo'si me dvija |
nahyasaṣcitapuṇyānāṃ sadbhirekatrasaṃgamaḥ ||38||
ity uktvā kathayāmāsapūrvavṛttāṃ tamātmanaḥ |
viṣṇudveṣapradoṣeṇadaśāmetāmahaṃ gataḥ ||39||
yannāma prāṇānmuktohismṛtvāviṣṇupadaṃ vrajet |
yaḥpālayatibhūtānidharmaṃ yātijagattraye |
yoṃ 'tarātmācabhūtānāṃ tasmindveṣomamābhavat ||41||
brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarveyoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ |
ādaumadhye'vasāneyoviśvadhātāsanātanaḥ |
yanmayāsukṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ prāktanajanmani |
viṣṇudveṣāgninādagdhaṃ tat sarvaṃ bhasmasādabhūt ||46||
kathaṃ cidasyapāpasyasīmāṃ drakṣyāmicedaham |
muktvānārāyaṇaṃ nānyamarcayiṣyāmidevatām ||47||
viṣṇudveṣācciraṃ bhuktvāmayānarakayātanām |
nirayānnisṛtaḥ so'haṃ paiśācīṃ yonimāgataḥ ||48||
yatratvaddarśanārkānmenaṣṭaṃ duḥkhamayaṃ tamaḥ ||49||
prāpyate maraṇaṃ yatra bandhanaṃ śrīḥ sukhaṃ vadhūḥ |
idānīmucitaṃ karmabrūhipaiśācyanāśanam |
paropakārakāryehinadhanyāmaṃ dagāminaḥ ||51||
ahomuṣṇātimāyeyaṃ devāsuranṛṇāṃ smṛtim |
yayādeveṣvapidveṣojāyatedharmanāśanaḥ ||52||
sraṣṭāpālayitāhaṃ tājagatāṃ yomaheśvaraḥ |
ātmācasarva-bhūtānāṃ taṃ mūḍhodveṣṭikaḥkatham ||53||
sevitavyaṃ caturvarṇair bhajannārāyaṇaṃ sadā ||55||
anyathānirayaṃ yānti vināhyāgamasevanāt |
svabuddhiracitaiḥ śāstraiḥ pratāryehatubāliśān |
vighnaṃ tiśreyasomārgaṃ lokanāśāyakevalam ||57||
viṣṇuṃ niṃ daṃ tivedāṃś cataponiṃ daṃ tisaddvijān |
tenatenarakaṃ yānti hyasacchāstraniṣevaṇāt ||58||
ayamevayathārājādraviḍonirayaṃ gataḥ |
dviṣannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ deva-devaṃ jagatprabhum ||59||
tasmād dveṣaṃ hideveṣubrāhmaṇeṣuviśeṣataḥ |
saṃtyajetpuṇyakāmo'travedabāhyāṃ kriyātyajet ||60||
ity uktvā kathayāmāsapiśācāyahitaṃ muniḥ |
yatrateniścitāmuktiḥpaiśācyānnātra saṃśayaḥ |
tatrāplutādivaṃ yānti śrutireṣāsanātanī ||62||
prāyaścittaṃ taporūpaṃ dānarūpaṃ kriyātmakam |
yāgayogādhikaṃ viddhiprayāgaṃ pāpināma pi ||64||
svargāpavargayor dvāraṃ tatpṛthivyāmapāvṛtam |
sitāsitodaveṇīyātāṃ hitvābhuvināparā ||65||
kva viṣṇuḥ sūrya-tejo'gnir gaṅgā-yāmuna-saṅgamaḥ ||66||
kva varākī nṛṇāṃ tucchā pāpa-rāśi-tṛṇāhutiḥ |
malīmasaghanadhvaṃ seyathāśaradicandramāḥ ||67||
bhātipāpa-kṣayādūrdhvaṃ naroveṇījalāplutaḥ |
sitāsitasyamāhātmyamahaṃ vaktuṃ natekṣamaḥ ||68||
yattoyakaṇasaṃspṛṣṭomuktaḥkeralakodvijaḥ |
itivākyamṛṣeḥ śrutvāpiśācastuṣṭamānasaḥ ||69||
etaṃ kathayavṛttāṃ taṃ saṃśrityakaruṇāṃ mayi ||71||
piśācaśṛṇupuṇyāṃ mekathāṃ kathayataḥ śubhām |
keralevasunāmātrabrāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ ||72||
deśāddeśaṃ paribhrāmyakālenamahatāpunaḥ |
praviśyasamahāraṇyamīṣadvyādhiprapīḍitaḥ ||74||
gacchaṃ stīrthāṃ taraṃ śrāṃ taḥkṣutkṣāmoviṃ dhyaparvate |
pretībhūtaściraṃ kālamuvāsanirjanevane ||76||
śītātapapariiklaṣṭonirāhāronirūdakaḥ |
digaṃ barovyupānatkogirāhāhetiniḥ śvasan ||77||
itas tataḥ paribhrāmyavāyubhūtaḥ sakeralaḥ |
sarvadādattadānaṃ sabhuṅkte svaṃ karmaṇaḥphalam ||79||
suvarṇa-vastra-tāmbūlaṃ maṇim annaṃ phalaṃ jalam |
balenachadmanāvāpidhūrtāścaparavaṃ cakāḥ ||82||
dāmbhikaḥkuhakāścaurāyecapāvakavṛttayaḥ |
bālavṛddhāturastrīṣunirdayāḥ satyavarjitāḥ ||83||
agnidāgaradāyecayecānyekūṭasākṣiṇaḥ |
agamyāgāminaḥ sarveyecānyegrāmayājinaḥ ||84||
pitṛmātṛsnuṣāpatyasvadāratyāginaścaye |
yekadaryāścalubdhāścanāstikādharmadūṣakāḥ ||85||
tyajaṃ tisvāminaṃ yuddhetyajaṃ tiśaraṇāgatam |
gavāmbhūmeścahaṃ tāroyecānyeratnadūṣakāḥ ||86||
parāpavādinaḥpāpādevatāguruniṃ dakāḥ |
mahākṣetreṣusarveṣupratigraharatāścaye ||87||
paradroharatāyecayathācaprāṇihiṃ sakāḥ |
preta-rākṣasa-paiśāca-tiryag-vṛkṣa-kuyoniṣu |
tasmāt tyaktvā niṣiddhārthaṃ vihitaṃ karma cācaret |
yajṣaṃ dānaṃ tapas tīrthaṃ mantraṃ devaṃ guruṃ bhajet ||90||
vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā yoni-koṭiṣu dustaram |
iti preta-gatiṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpa-bījotthitāṃ hi saḥ |
vahantaṃ dvau karaṇḍau ca veṇī-jala-yutau tathā |
gāyantaṃ pramukhā devaṃ puṇya-ślokaṃ janārdanam ||94||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā preto mārga-rodhaṃ cakāra saḥ |
darśayāmāsa cātmānaṃ mā bhaiṣīr ity uvāca— saḥ ||95||
pānīyaṃ pātum icchāmi tvattaḥ kārpāṭikottama |
na pāsyasi jalaṃ cen māṃ prāṇāyāsyanti me dṛḍham ||96||
iti preta-vacaḥ śrutvā pānthaḥ pratyāha kautukāt |
kārpaṭīka uvāca—
kas tvaṃ duḥkhābhibhūtas tu kṛśo mlāno dig-ambaraḥ ||97||
jīva-śeṣo mumūrṣuś ca vikṛto bhaya-vardhanaḥ |
navadhūmamayākāraścaṇḍaścaṃ calalocanaḥ ||98||
padbhyāmaspṛṣṭabhūmis tvaṃ nirmāṃ sodarabāhukaḥ |
ititadvacanaṃ śrutvāpretovākyamathābravīt ||99||
śṛṇudharmiṣṭhatevacmiyenāhamīdṛśo'bhavam |
brāhmaṇo 'dattadāno'haṃ lobhīcamalinakriyaḥ ||100||
parānnaṃ casadābhuktamekākīmiṣṭabhojanaḥ |
mayādattānabhikṣāpihaṃ takāronapuṣkalaḥ ||101||
bhūtānāṃ tutṛṣārtānāṃ nahatāpayasācatṛṭ ||102||
nacaścāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ kvāpipūjitānaiva devatāḥ ||103||
varṣātapaparitrāṇaṃ nadattaṃ pādarakṣaṇam |
jalapātraṃ nadattaṃ catāmbūlaṃ nauṣadhaṃ mayā ||104||
aṃ dhavṛddhādhanānāthadīnāḥpānānnatoṣitāḥ ||105||
nadattānahutāviprapavitrāścatilāmayā ||106||
pṛthivyānti ladātāronabhavanti tumadvidhāḥ |
vyatīpātenadattaṃ hikīṃ citsvarṇaṃ mahāphalam ||107||
saṃkrāṃ tāvuparāgecanadattaṃ sūryacandrayoḥ |
parvāṇyanyānisarvāṇijagmuḥ śūnyānimedvija ||108||
tithayaḥkārttikemukhyājātāvaṃ dhyāḥ sadāmama |
pitṛbhyonaiva dattaṃ vā aṣṭakāsumaghāsuca ||109||
dvijānāṃ nakṛtāprītirmanvādiṣuyugādiṣu |
nasnātomāghamāse'haṃ rūpasaubhāgyakāmade |
nasnāto'haṃ kṛṣṇaveṇyāṃ tathākanyāgategurau ||112||
agniṃ prajvālyakāṣṭhaughaiḥ snātānāṃ pauṣamāghayoḥ |
śītārtānāṃ caviprāṇāṃ nakṛtojāḍyanigrahaḥ ||113||
mādhavādiṣumāseṣunadattaṃ śītalaṃ jalam |
baṃ dīgṛhānmayāmuktirnakṛtāprāṇināṃ kvacit |
naprāṇibhayasaṃtrastorakṣitaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ||115||
nopoṣyātratrirātrāṇitoṣitomadhusūdanaḥ |

vratānyetānipuṇyānijuṣṭānīṃ drādibhiḥ suraiḥ ||117||
caritvānamayātānidehaḥ saṃśoṣitaḥpurā |
gatiṃ dūraprabodhāṃ tumamapūrvasyakarmaṇaḥ ||119||
saṃtimāṃ sānimārgeṣuvṛkavyāghrahatānivai |
puṇyāni casugaṃ dhīniphalānirasavaṃ tica |
mūlānitusubhakṣyāṇimṛdūnimadhurāṇi ca ||121||
nānāvidhānitiṣṭhanti madhūnisubahūnyapi |
srotasāṃ nirjharāṇāṃ casaṃtivārīṇi sarvaśaḥ | ||122||
nekṣehamaśanaṃ kvāpidaivenāpihataṃ sadā ||123||
vātāhāreṇajīvāmiyathājīvaṃ tipannagāḥ |
lābhālābhesukheduḥkhevivāhemṛtyujīvane |
kurūpāḥkukulāmūrkhāḥkutsitācāraniṃ ditāḥ |
śauryavikramahīnāścadaivādrājyānibhuṃ jate ||127||
kāṇāḥkhaṃ jā abhavyāścanītihīnāścadurguṇāḥ |
napuṃsakāścadṛśyante daivādrājyepratiṣṭhitāḥ ||128||
yair dattāścatilāgāvohiraṇyaṃ vasanāni ca |
śayyāsanānitāmbūlaṃ mandirāṇidhanāni ca |
bhakṣyabhojyānidattāni candanānyagarūṇica ||130||
aṭavyāṃ parvatāgre ca grāme vā nagare'pi vā |
puraḥ puraś ca tiṣṭhanti teṣāmbhogāḥ prayatnataḥ ||131||
saṃtyatraparvate'nye'pirākṣasābalavattarāḥ |
rākṣasāścapiśācāścapiśācyaścātidāruṇāḥ ||132||
śuciṃ govindabhaktaṃ tvāṃ natedraṣṭumapikṣamāḥ||134||

ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ mṛdā kāryaṃ kastūryās tilakaṃ tathā |
paṭṭākāraṃ tu gandhena bhasmanaiva tripuṇḍrakam ||16||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu sarveṣāṃ na niṣiddhaṃ kadācana |
viprāṇāṃ naiva kāryaṃ syāt tiryak-paṭṭādi-dhāraṇam |
nārāyaṇāt pareśānād anyeṣām arcanaṃ na tu ||18||
varjayet tādṛśaṃ devi madyocchiṣṭaṃ ghaṭaṃ yathā ||19||
tri-puṇḍraṃ śūdra-kalpānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhis tathā |
tri-puṇḍra-dhāraṇād vipraḥ patitaḥ syān na saṃśayaḥ ||20||
ekāntino mahā-bhāgāḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ |
sāntarālaṃ prakurvīran puṇḍraṃ hari-padākṛtim ||21||
hareḥ pādākṛtiṃ kuryād ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ vidhānataḥ |
ūrdhva-puṇḍram ṛjuṃ saumyaṃ supārśvaṃ sumanoharam |
daṇḍākāraṃ suśobhāḍhyaṃ madhye cchidraṃ prakalpayet ||23||
tasmāc chidrānvitaṃ puṇḍraṃ daṇḍākāraṃ suśobhanam |
viprāṇāṃ satataṃ kāryaṃ strīṇāṃ ca śubha-darśane |24||
sāntarāle samāsīno harir asti śriyā saha ||25||
nirantarālaṃ yaḥ kuryād ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ dvijādhamaḥ |
acchidram ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu ye kurvanti dvijādhamāḥ |
teṣāṃ lalāṭe satataṃ śunaḥ pādo na saṃśayaḥ ||27||
tasmāc chidrānvitaṃ puṇḍraṃ sa-haridraṃ śubhānvitam |
ādāya parayā bhaktyā veṅkaṭādrau hṛde mṛdam |
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrāṇi hari-sāyujya-siddhaye ||29||
śrī-kṛṣṇa-tulasī-mūle mṛdam ādāya bhaktimān |
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrāṇi haris tatra prasīdati ||30||
dvāravatyāṃ śubhe ramye vāsudeva-hrade tathā |
tatrodbhavāṃ mṛdaṃ ramyām ādāya dvija-sattamaḥ ||31||
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrāṇi sarva-kāma-phalāptaye |
ādāya parayā bhaktyā gaṅgā-tīrodbhavāṃ mṛdam ||32||
tathā dhṛtordhva-puṇḍrāṇi sarva-yajṣa-phalaṃ labhet |
sarva-vaśya-karaṃ proktam ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya dhāraṇāt |
parvatāgre nadī-tīre bilva-mūle jalāśaye |
sindhu-tīre ca valmīke hari-kṣetre viśeṣataḥ ||35||
viṣṇoḥ snānodakaṃ yatra pravāhayati nityaśaḥ |
puṇḍrāṇāṃ dhāraṇārthāya gṛhṇīyāt tatra mṛttikām ||36||
śrī-raṅge veṅkaṭādrau ca śrī-kūrme dvārake śubhe |
prayāge nārasiṃhādrau vārāhe tu lasī-vane ||37||
gṛhītvā mṛttikāṃ bhaktyā viṣṇu-pāda-jalaiḥ saha |
dhṛtvā puṇḍrāṇi cāṅgeṣu viṣṇu-sāyujyam āpnuyāt ||38||
yasmin kasmin mahā-bhāgā vaiṣṇavā dhārayanti vai |
tasmin vai mṛttikā grāhyā ūrdhva-puṇḍrasya dhāraṇe ||39||
śyāmaṃ śānti-karaṃ proktaṃ raktaṃ vaśya-karaṃ tathā |
śrī-karaṃ pītam ity āhuḥ śvetaṃ mokṣa-karaṃ śubham ||40||
vakraṃ virūpaṃ baddhāgraṃ chinna-mūlaṃ pada-cyutam ||41||
aśubhaṃ rūkṣam āsaktaṃ tathā nāṅguli-kalpitam |
ārabhya nāsikā-mūlaṃ lalāṭāntaṃ likhen mṛdā |
antarālaṃ dvy-aṅgulaṃ syāt pārśvāv aṅguli-mātrakau |
mṛdā śubhreṇa vilikheta puṇḍram ṛjutaraṃ śubham ||44||
lalāṭe keśavaṃ dhyāyen nārāyaṇam athodare |
vakṣaḥ-sthale mādhavaṃ ca govindaṃ kaṇṭha-kūpake ||45||
viṣṇuṃ ca dakṣiṇe kukṣau bāhau ca madhusūdanam |
trivikramaṃ kandhare tu vāmanaṃ vāma-pārśvake ||46||
śrīdharaṃ bāhuke vāme hṛṣīkeśaṃ tu kandhare |
pṛṣṭhe vai padmanābhaṃ ca kaṭyāṃ dāmodaraṃ nyaset ||47||
lalāṭe bhuja-yugme tu pṛṣṭhayoḥ kaṇṭha-kūpake ||48||
dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ tu catur-aṅgula-mātrataḥ |
kukṣau tat-pārśvayoḥ proktam āyataṃ tu daśāṅgulam ||49||
bāhvor vakṣaḥ-sthale puṇḍraṃ maṣṭāṅgulam udāhṛtam |
evaṃ dvādaśa-puṇḍrāṇi brāhmaṇaḥ satataṃ dharet ||50||
tat-tat-puṇḍrāṇi tan-mūrtīr dhyātvā mantreṇa dhārayet |
antarāleṣu sarveṣu haridrāṃ dhārayec chriyām ||51||
catvāri bhū-bhṛtām āhuḥ puṇḍrāṇi dve viśāṃ smṛte |
eka-puṇḍraṃ tu nārīṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhīyate ||52||
lalāṭe hṛdi bāhvoś ca catuḥ-puṇḍrāṇi dhārayet |
lalāṭe hṛdaye dve tu phāle tv ekaṃ vidhīyate ||53||
ūrdhva-puṇḍraṃ lalāṭe tu sarveṣāṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam |
lalāṭādi-krameṇaiva dhāraṇaṃ tu vidhīyate ||54||
mūrtīs tu vāsudevādyāś catuḥ-puṇḍreṣu dhārayet |
dvayor govinda-kṛṣṇau tu ekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dharet ||55||
evaṃ puṇḍra-vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarveṣāṃ girije mayā |
aśvattha-patra-saṅkāśo veṇu-patrākṛtis tathā ||56||
padma-kuḍmala-saṅkāśo mohanaṃ tritayaṃ smṛtam |
mahā-bhāgavataḥ śuddhaḥ puṇḍraṃ hari-padākṛtim ||57||
daṇḍākāraṃ tu vā devi dhārayed ūrdhva-puṇḍrakam ||58||
sudarśanenāṅkita-bāhu-mūlās
tathordhva-puṇḍrāṅkita-sarva-gātrāḥ |
mālāravindākṣa-dharā viśuddhā
śaṅkara uvāca—
avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭena mantreṇa na parā gatiḥ ||1||
avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭaṃ cet pūrva-mantra-varaṃ dvayam |
punaś ca vidhinā samyak vaiṣṇavād grāhayed guroḥ ||2||
sahasra-śākhādhyāyī vā sarva-yajṣeṣu dīkṣitaḥ |
kule mahati jāto'pi na guruḥ syād avaiṣṇavaḥ ||3||
ācāryaṃ saṃśrayitvātha vatsaraṃ sevayed dvijaḥ |
kṛtvā tāpādi-saṃskārān paścān mantram udīrayet |
tāpaṃ puṇḍraṃ tathā nāma kṛtvā vai vidhinā guruḥ ||6||
paścād adhyāpayen mantraṃ śiṣyaṃ nirmala-cetasam |
puṇḍram ūrdhvaṃ tathā proktaṃ nāma vaiṣṇavam ucyate |
nyāsam aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantram anyaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ manum |
nyāsam evātra paramaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhānane ||9||
nyāsa-vidyā-paro yas tu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭha ucyate ||10||
nyāsāt parataraṃ nāsti mantraṃ satyaṃ bravīmi te ||
nyāsaṃ dvayaṃ prapattiḥ syāt paryāyeṇa nibodha me ||11||
śrīmad-aṣṭākṣaraṃ samyag abhyased dvija-sattamaḥ ||13||
mantram aṣṭākṣaraṃ proktaṃ praṇavasyaiva saṅgrahāt |
pūrvaṃ tu sarva-mantrāṇāṃ yojayet praṇavaṃ śubham ||15||
oṅkāraḥ praṇavaṃ brahma sarva-mantreṣu nāyakaḥ |
ādau sarvatra yuṣjīta mantrāṇāṃ tu śubhānane ||16||
om ity ekākṣaraṃ pūrvaṃ dvyakṣaraṃ nama ity atha ||17||
tato nārāyaṇāyeti paṣcārṇāni yathā kramam |
evam aṣṭākṣaro mantro jṣeyaḥ sarvārtha-sādhakaḥ ||18||
sarva-duḥkha-haraḥ śrīmān sarva-mantrātmakaḥ śubhaḥ |
ṛṣir nārāyaṇas tasya devatā śrīśa eva ca ||19||
nityānapāyinī devī śaktiḥ śrīr ucyate manoḥ ||20||
tṛtīyaṃ nārāyaṇāyeti pada-trayam udāhṛtam ||21||
akāraś cāpy u-kāraś ca ma-kāraś ca tataḥ param |
veda-trayātmakaṃ proktaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ||22||
a-kāreṇocyate viṣṇuḥ śrīr ukāreṇa cocyate |
ma-kāras tv anayor dāsaḥ paṣcaviṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||23||
vāsudevasvarūpaṃ tadakāreṇocyataibudhaiḥ |
ukāreṇaśriyodevyārūpaṃ munibhir ucyate ||24||
ma-kāreṇocyate jīvaḥ paṣcaviṃ śoditaḥ pumān |
bhūtāni ca ka-vargeṇa ca-vargeṇendriyāṇi ca ||25||
ṭa-vargeṇa ta-vargeṇa jñānaṃ dhādayas tathā |
manaḥ pa-kāreṇaivoktaṃ pha-kāreṇa tv ahaṅkṛtiḥ ||26||
ba-kāreṇa bha-kāreṇa mahān prakṛtir ucyate |
ātmā tu sa ma-kāraḥ syāt paṣcaviṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||27||
avadhāraṇa-vācy evam u-kāraḥ kaiścid ucyate |
śrīś ca tat-pakṣa-pātitvād a-kāreṇaiva cocyate ||29||
ā-kāreṇocyate viṣṇuḥ kalyāṇa-guṇa-sāgaraḥ ||30||
śrīśaḥ sarvātmanāṃ śeṣo jagad-bījaṃ paraḥ pumān |
jagat-kartā jagad-bhartā īśvaro loka-bāndhavaḥ ||31||
jagatām īśvarī nityā viṣṇor anapagāminī |
mātā sarvasya jagataḥ patnī-viṣṇor manoramā ||32||
jagad-ādhāra-bhūtā śrīr u-kāreṇātra cocyate |
ma-kāreṇa tayor dāsaḥ kṣetrajṣaḥ procyate budhaiḥ ||33||
jṣānāśramo jñāna-guṇaś cetanaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ |
na jaḍo nirvikāraś ca eka-rūpa-svarūpa-bhāk ||34||
aṇur nityo vyāpti-śīlaś cid-ānandātmakas tathā |
aham artho'vyayaḥ kṣetrī bhinna-rūpaṃ sanātanaḥ ||35||
evam ādi-guṇopetaḥ śeṣa-bhūtaḥ parasya vai ||36||
ma-kāreṇocyate jīvaḥ kṣetrajṣaḥ paravān sadā |
vivṛtiḥ praṇavasyārtha-mantra-śeṣeṇa vai śubhe |
ahaṅkṛtir ma-kāraḥ syān na-kāras tan-niṣedhakaḥ |
namasā sarva-siddhiḥ syād anyathā nāśam āpnuyāt |
ahaṅkāra-vimūḍhātmā andhe tamasi majjati ||43||
paramātmāhariḥ svāmīsvamahaṃ tasya sarvadā ||47||
athanārāyaṇapadaṃ vakṣyāmigirajeśubhe |
nārāityātmanāṃ saṅghāsteṣāṃ gatirasaupumān ||50||
taevacāyanaṃ tasya tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
yo’sau vyāpyasthito nityaṃ savainārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nārāścetisarvapuṃ sāṃ samūhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||52||
gatirālaṃ banaṃ teṣāntasmānnārayaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
narājjātānitatvāninārāṇītividurbudhāḥ ||53||
tānyevacāyanaṃ tasya tenanārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
punaḥ saṃ sṛjyateyenasavainārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
carācaraṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ nāraity abhi dhīyate ||55||
 tasya vāsaṅgatiryenatenanārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
nāronarāṇāṃ saṅghātastasyāsāvayanaṃ gatiḥ ||56||
tenāsaumunibhirnityaṃ nārāyaṇaitīritaḥ |
punaryasmātpralīyantetasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
īśaḥ sarvasyajagataḥ savainārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahmatatvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ param ||59||
yaccakiṃ cijjagat yasmin dṛśyateśrūyate'pivā |
antar- baṃ hiścatatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ||60||
apahatapāpmāpuruṣaḥ sarva-bhūtāntarasthitaḥ |
divyaekaḥ sadānityoharirnārāyaṇo'cyutaḥ ||61||
yastudraṣṭācadraṣṭavyaṃ śrotāśrotavyam eva ca |
sapraṣṭācasparśitavyaścadhyātādhyātavyam eva ca ||62||
vaktācavācyaṃ jṣātācajṣātavyaṃ cidacijjagat |
taccasarvaṃ hariḥ śrīśonārāyaṇaudāhṛtaḥ ||63||
sahasraśīrṣāpuruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
salokānsarvatovyāpyaatyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam ||64||
yadbhūtaṃ yaccabhavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ nārāyaṇohariḥ |
utāmṛtatvasyeśānoyadannenavirāṭpumān ||65||
hiraṇmayo'thabhagavānso'mṛtaḥ śāśvataḥ śivaḥ ||66||
hiraṇyagarbhāḥ savitāananto 'saumaheśvaraḥ ||67||
īśvarobhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramātmājagatsuhṛt |
śāstācarācarasyaikoyatīnāṃ paramāgatiḥ ||69||
yovedādausvaraḥ proktovedāṃ tecapratiṣṭhitaḥ |
 tasya prakṛtilīnasyayaḥ paraḥ samaheśvaraḥ ||70||
yosāvakārovaiviṣṇuryo’sau nārāyaṇohariḥ |
sa eva puruṣonityaḥ paramātmāmaheśvaraḥ ||71||
nirupādhīśvaratvaṃ hivāsuṃ devepratiṣṭhitam ||72||
ātmeśvaraiti proktovedavādaiḥ sanātanaiḥ |
asautripādvibhūtestulīlayāapiceśvaraḥ |
śrībhūnīlāpatiryosāvīśvaraḥ saudāhṛtaḥ |
asauyajṣeśvaroyajṣoyajṣabhukyajṣakṛdvibhuḥ |
yajṣabhugyajṣa-puruṣaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||76||
tatsaṃ nidhānādapayānti sadyorakṣāṃ syaśeṣāṇyasurāścasarve ||77||
yo’sau virāṭtvamāpannoharirbhūtojanārdanaḥ |
yenapūrṇenahaviṣādevāyajṣamatanvata |
tasmādyajṣātsamutpannāyekecobhayādataḥ ||79||
tasmādyajṣātsarvahutaṛcaḥ sāmānijajṣire |
tasmādaśvāajāyaṃ tagāvaścapuruṣādayaḥ ||80||
mukhādagniḥ sahasrākṣovāyuḥ prāṇātsadāgatiḥ ||83||
yasmātsarvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ jagadviṣṇoḥ sanātanāt ||84||
tasmātsarvamayoviṣṇurnārāyaṇaitīritaḥ |
evaṃ sṛṣṭvājagatsarvaṃ punaḥ saṅgrasatehariḥ ||85||
nijalīlāsamudbhūtaṃ tāntavaṃ corṇanābhivat |
brahmāṇamindraṃ rudraṃ cayamaṃ varuṇam eva ca ||86||
asāvekārṇavībhūtemāyāvaṭatalepumān ||87||
jagatsvajaṭharekṛtvāśete tasmin sanātanaḥ |
āsīdekohibaicātraviṣṇurnārāyaṇo'cyutaḥ ||88||
nanakṣatrāṇilokāścanacāṇḍaṃ mahadāvṛtam |
yasmājjagadvṛtaṃ tenasakalaṃ hariṇāśubhe ||90||
sṛṣṭaṃ punas tathā sargetasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
uttara-khaṇḍe umā-maheśvara-saṃvāde mantrārthopadeśo nāma
pārvaty uvāca—
īśvarasya svarūpaṣ ca tad-vibhūti-guṇāṃs tathā ||1||
tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ dhāma vyūha-bhedāṃs tathā hareḥ |
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
vibhūti-guṇa-saṅghātaṃ tad-avasthātmakaṃ hareḥ ||3||
yaḥ paraḥ puruṣo viṣṇur nārāyaṇa udāhṛtaḥ |
sa īśvaraś ca jagatāṃ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ||4||
viśvataḥ pāṇi-pādaś ca cakṣuṣmān viśvataḥ prabhuḥ |
viśvāni bhuvanān yasmin dhāmāni paramāṇi vai ||5||
dhārayan so'py atyatiṣṭhen manāṃsi ca manīṣiṇām |
evaṃ bahu-svarūpaḥ saṣ chrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
īśvararyā saha bhogārthaṃ divya-maṅgala-rūpavān ||6||
bṛhac-charīro'gni-samāna-rūpo
reme śriyāsau jagatāṃ jananyā
sva-jyotsnayā candra ivāmṛtāṃśuḥ ||7||
ayaṃ ca jagadīśvaryyā kumāro nitya-yauvanaḥ |
bhogena krīḍayā viṣṇor vibhūti-dvaya-saṃsthitiḥ ||9||
tripād-vyāptiḥ pare dhāmni pādo’syehābhavat punaḥ |
tripād-vibhūtir nityā syād anityaṃ pādam aiśvaram ||11||
nityaṃ tad-rūpam īśasya pare dhāmni sthitaṃ śubham |
acyutaṃ śāśvataṃ divyaṃ sadā yauvanam āśritam ||12||
nityaṃ sambhogam īśvaryā śriyā bhūmyā ca saṃvṛtam |
nityaiveṣā jagan-mātā viṣṇoḥ śrīr anapāyinī ||13||
yathā sarva-gato viṣṇus tathā lakṣmīḥ śubhānane |
īśānā sarva-jagato viṣṇu-patnī sadā śivā ||14||
sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādāntā sarvato'kṣi-śiro-mukhī |
nārāyaṇī jagan-mātā samasta-jagad-āśrayā ||15||
yad-apāṅgāśritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat-sthāvara-jaṅgamam |
sarvasyādyā mahā-lakṣmīs triguṇā parameśvarī |
lakṣyālakṣya-svarūpā sā vyāpya kṛtsnaṃ vyavasthitā ||17||
śūnyaṃ tad akhilaṃ viśvaṃ vilokya-parameśvarī |
śūnyaṃ tad akhilaṃ svena pūrayāmāsa tejasā ||18||
sā lakṣmīr dharaṇī caiva nīlā devīti viśrutā |
ādhāra-bhūtā jagataḥ pṛthivī-rūpam āśritā ||19||
lakṣmī-rūpatvam āpannā dhana-vāg-rūpiṇī hi sā ||20||
evaṃ devī-svarūpā sā jagataḥ śrīḥ śrītā harim |
samasta-vidyā-bhedāḥ syur lakṣmī-rūpā varānane ||21||
śrī-rūpam akhilaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā hi vapur ucyate |
saundaryaṃ śīla-vṛttaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ strīṣu saṃsthitam |
tasyā rūpaṃ ca girije sarvāsāṃ mūrdhni yoṣitām ||22||
yasyāḥ kaṭākṣāyatamogra-dṛṣṭyā
lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ kamalā vidyā mātā viṣṇu-priyā satī |
padmālayā padma-hastā padmākṣī loka-sundarī ||24||
bhutānām īśvarī nityā sahyā sarva-gatā śubhā |
viṣṇu-patnī mahā-devī kṣīroda-tanayā ramā ||25||
anantāloka-mātā bhūr nīlā sarva-sukha-pradā |
rukmiṇī ca tathā sītā sarva-vedavatī śubhā ||26||
satī sarasvatī gaurī śāntiḥ svāhā svadhā ratiḥ |
nārāyaṇī varārohā viṣṇor nityānapāyinī ||27||

dhātā vidhātā jagato vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
hiraṇmaya-vapur nityaḥ puṇḍarīka-nibhekṣaṇaḥ |
śrī-bhū-līlā-patiḥ saumyo nirmalaḥ śubha-vigrahaḥ ||38||
tasyaivājṣāṃ puraskṛtya vartete brahma-śaṅkarau ||39||
bhīṣāsmād vāti pavano bhīṣodeti divākaraḥ |
bhīṣāsmād agniś candro'tha mṛtyur dhāvati paṣcamaḥ ||40||
āsīd eko harir divyo devo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
na vādyā vāpṛthivyau ca nakṣatrāṇi divaukasaḥ |
tasya viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhāma sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ ||42||
evaṃ sarvopaniṣadām arthaṃ hitvā dvijottamāḥ |
rāgāl lobhād bhayād vāpi kiṃ bravītha mamāgrataḥ ||43||
taṃ sarva-rakṣakaṃ devaṃ tyaktvā sarveśvaraṃ harim |
kathaṃ pāṣaṇḍam āśritya pūjayāmi ca śaṅkaram ||44||
indīvara-dala-śyāmaṃ padma-patrāyatekṣaṇam ||45|
śrīvatsa-lakṣitoraskaṃ sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitam |
sadā kumāraṃ sarveśaṃ nityānanda-sukha-pradam ||46||
kṛṣṇaṃ dadhyur mahātmāno yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ |
yam arcayanti brahmeśa-śakrādyā devatā-gaṇāḥ ||47||
yasya patnyāḥ kaṭākṣārdha-dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭā divaukasaḥ |
muktir bhavati jantūnāṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabhā ||49||
sa evaṃ rakṣakaḥ śrīśo devānām api sarvadā |
tam eva pūjayiṣyāmi lakṣmyā saṃyutam acyutam ||50||
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā hiraṇyakaśipus tataḥ ||51||
krodhena mahatā viṣṭo jajvālāgnir ivāparaḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
bhīṣaṇaiḥ śastra-saṅghātaiḥ prahlādaṃ pāpa-kāriṇam |
mamājṣayā ghātayadhvaṃ śatru-pūjana-tat-param ||53||
parivārya mahātmānaṃ tasthur daityeśvarājṣayā ||55||
prahlādo'pi tathā viṣṇuṃ dhyātvā hṛdaya-paṅkaje |
japann aṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ tasthau girir ivāparaḥ ||56||
taṃ jaghnuḥ parito vīrāḥ śūlatomara-śaktibhiḥ |
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvād durdharṣād vajra-bhūtam abhūd bhṛśam |
tataḥ samprāpya tad-gātraṃ mahāstrāṇi sura-dviṣām ||58||
nīlotpala-dalānīva petuś chinnāḥ kṣitau śubhe |
alpam apy asya tad-gātraṃ bhettuṃ daityā na ca kṣamāḥ ||59||
ādideśa tataḥ sarvān dandaśūkān mahā-viṣān ||61||
vāsuki-prabhṛtīn bhīmān khādayadhvam iti krudhā |
ādiṣṭās tena rājṣātha tenāgāḥsu mahā-balāḥ ||62||
jvalitāsyā mahā-bhīmās taṃ cakhādur mahā-balam |
garuḍa-dhvaja-bhaktaṃ taṃ vidaśya garalāyudhāḥ ||63||
nirviṣāś chinna-daśanā babhūvur anilāśanāḥ |
vainateya-sahasreṇa chinna-gātrāḥ suvihvalāḥ ||64||
tādṛg-vidhān mahā-sarpān dṛṣṭvā daitya-patis tadā ||65||
ādideśa tataḥ kruddho dig-gajān sumadānvitān |
nirdiṣṭās tena rājṣātha dig-gajāś ca madoddhatāḥ ||66||
parivāryātha taṃ jaghnur dantaiḥ pṛthutarair bhṛśam |
dantair vinākṛtā nāgā bhayārtā vai pradudruvuḥ |
tān dṛṣṭvātha mahānāgān daityendraḥ kupito balī ||68||
prajvālya ca mahā-vahniṃ cikṣepa sutam ātmanaḥ |
jala-śāyi-priyaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahlādaṃ havya-vāhanaḥ ||69||
na dadāha ca taṃ dhīraṃ suśītaḥ samabhūc chikhī |
adahyamānaṃ taṃ bālaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā suvismitaḥ ||70||
prādāt tasmai viṣaṃ ghoraṃ sarva-bhūta-hitaṃ tadā |
tasya viṣṇoḥ prabhāvāc ca viṣamasyāmṛtaṃ bhavet ||71||
arpaṇāt tasya devasya viṣaṃ cāmṛtam aśnute |
evam ādyair vadhopāyair ghora-rūpaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ||72||
mohayitvātmajaṃ rājā tasyāvadhyatvam īkṣya ca |
tataḥ sāmnā sutaṃ prāha daitya-rāḍ vismayākulaḥ ||73||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
tvayā viṣṇoḥ paratvaṃ ca samyag uktaṃ mamāgrataḥ |
vyāpitvāt sarva-bhūtānāṃ viṣṇur ity abhidhīyate ||74||
aiśvarya-śakti-tejāṃsi jñāna-vīrya-balāni ca |
parasya tasya paramaṃ rūpaṃ guṇa-vibhūtayaḥ ||76||
samyag dṛṣṭvā prayatnena viṣṇuṃ manye divaukasām |
īśāna-vara-dānena sarva-bhūteṣv avadhyatām |
prāptavān sarva-bhūtānāṃ durjayatvaṃ ca mānada |
īśvaratvaṃ labhed viṣṇur māṃ jitvā bala-vīryataḥ ||78||
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahlādaḥ prāha vismitaḥ |
prahlāda uvāca—
yo’sau nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān paramātmā sanātanaḥ |
sarvasyāpi jagad-dhātā viṣṇur ity abhidhīyate |
tripād-vyāptiḥ paraṃ vyomni pāda-vyāpti-kalādbhutā ||82||
yo’sau cakra-gadā-pāṇiḥ pīta-vāsā janārdanaḥ |
yogibhir dṛśyate bhaktyā nābhaktyā dṛśyate kvacit ||83||
draṣṭuṃ na śakyo roṣāc ca matsarād vā janārdanaḥ |
deva-tiryaṅ-manuṣyeṣu sthāvareṣv api jantuṣu ||
uvāca roṣa-tāmrākṣo bhartsayaṃś ca sutaṃ muhuḥ ||85||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
pratyayaṃ darśayasvādya bahubhiḥ kiṃ ca lāpitaiḥ ||86||
ity uktvā sahasā daityaḥ prāsāda-stambham ātmanaḥ |
tāḍayāmāsa hastena prahlādam idam abravīt ||87||
hiraṇyakaśipur uvāca—
anyathā tvāṃ vadhiṣyāmi mithyā-vākya-pralāpinam ||88||
ity uktvā sahasā khaḍgam ākṛṣya ditijeśvaraḥ |
prahlādorasi cikṣepa hantuṃ khaḍgena taṃ ruṣā ||89||
tasmin kṣaṇe mahā-śabdaḥ stambhe saṃśrūyate bhṛśam |
saṃvartā-śani-saṃrāvaiḥ kham iva sphuṭitāntaram ||90||
sarve nipātitā bhūmau chinna-mūlā iva drumāḥ ||91||
tataḥ stambhe mahā-tejā niṣkrānto vai mahā-hariḥ ||92||
tena nādena mahatā tārakāḥ patitā bhuvi ||93||
nṛsiṃha-vapur āsthāya tatra ivāvirabhūd dhariḥ |
aneka-koṭi-sūryāgni-tejasā sa samāvṛtaḥ ||94||
mukhe paṣcānana-prakhyaḥ śarīre mānuṣākṛtiḥ |
daṃṣṭrā-karāla-vadanaḥ sphuraj-jihvāmbaroddhataḥ ||95||
jvālāvalita-keśāntas taptālātekṣaṇo vibhuḥ |
vṛto merur ivābhāti bahu-śākhānagānvitaḥ |
divya-mālyāṃ vara-dharo divyābharaṇa-bhūṣitaḥ ||97||
tasthau nṛkesarī-rūpaḥ saṃhartuṃ sarva-dānavān |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghora-saṃkāśaṃ narasiṃhaṃ mahā-balam ||98||
dagdhākṣi-pakṣmo daityendro vihvalāṅgaḥ papāta ha |
prahlādo'tha tadā dṛṣṭvā nārasiṃhopamaṃ harim ||99||
dadarśa tasya gātreṣu nṛisiṃhasya mahātmanaḥ ||100||
lokān samudrān sa-dvīpān sura-gandharva-mānuṣān |
ajāṇḍānāṃ sahasraṃ tu saṭāgre tasya dṛśyate ||101||
dṛśyante tasya netreṣu soma-sūryādayas tathā |
karṇayor aśvinau devau diśaś ca vidiśas tathā ||102||
indrāgnī tasya vaktrāṃ te jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ||103||
daṃṣṭrāsu siṃha-śārdūlāḥ śarabhāś ca mahoragāḥ |
kaṇṭhe ca dṛśyate meruḥ skandheṣv api mahādrayaḥ ||104||
deva-tiryaṅ manuṣyāś ca bāhuṣv api mahātmanaḥ |
nābhau cāsyāntarikṣaṃ ca pādayoḥ pṛthivī tathā ||105||
romasvoṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ pāda-pānakha-paṅktiṣu |
niḥśvāseṣu ca vedāś ca sāṅgopāṅga-samanvitāḥ ||106||
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśve-devā marud-gaṇāḥ |
sarvāṅgeṣu pradṛśyanta te gandharvāpsarasaś ca ye ||107||
itthaṃ vibhūtayas tasya dṛśyaṃ te paramātmanaḥ |
śrīvatsa-kaustubhoraskaṃ vanamālā-vibhūṣitam ||108||
śaṅkha-cakra-gadā-khaḍga-śārṅgādyair hetibhir yutam |
sarvopaniṣadām arthaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityeśvarātmajaḥ ||109||
harṣāśru-jala-siktāṅgaḥ praṇanāma muhur muhuḥ |
daityendras tu hariṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhān mṛtyu-vaśe sthitaḥ ||110||
atha daitya-gaṇāḥ sarve labdha-saṃjṣā mahā-balāḥ ||111||
svāny āyudhāni cādāya hariṃ jaghnus tvarānvitāḥ |
palālakāṇḍāni yathā vahnau kṣiptāny anekaśaḥ ||112||
tāny anīkāni daityānāṃ dṛṣṭvā nara-haris tadā ||113||
saṭair dadāha ca jvālā-mālā viracita sphuṭaiḥ |
nṛkesari-saṭodbhūta-vahninā dānavā bhṛśam ||114||
nirbhasmitā gaṇāḥ sarve niḥśeṣaṃ tad abhūd balam |
prahlādaṃ sānugaṃ hitvā bhasmite vīkṣya tad-bale ||115||
krodhād daitya-patiḥ khaḍgam ākṛṣyābhiprapadyata |
pātayāmāsa deveśo yathā śākhāṃ mahānilaḥ |
gṛhītvā patitaṃ bhūmau mahā-kāyaṃ nṛ-kesarī ||117||
svotsaṅge sthāpayāmāsa dadarśāsau mukhaṃ hareḥ |
viṣṇu-nindā-kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tathā vaiṣṇava-doṣajam ||118||
nṛsiṃha-sparśanād eva nirbhasmitam abhūt tadā |
atha daityeśvarasyātha mahad gātraṃ nṛ-kesarī ||119||
nakher vidārayāmāsa tīkṣṇair vajra-nibhair ghanaiḥ |
sanirmmalātmā daityendraḥ paśyan sākṣān mukhaṃ hareḥ ||120||
nakha-nirbhinna-hṛdayaḥ kṛtārtho vijahāv asūn |
tad-gātraṃ śatadhā bhittvā nakhais tīkṣṇair mahā-hariḥ ||121||
ākṛṣyāntrāṇi dīrghāṇi kaṇṭhe saṃsaktavān priyān |
atha deva-gaṇāḥ sarve munayaś ca tapo-dhanāḥ ||122||
mātaraṃ jagatāṃ dhātrīṃ cintayāmāsur īśvarīm |
hiraṇya-varṇāṃ hariṇīṃ sarvopadrava-nāśinīm ||124||
viṣṇor nityānavadyāṅgīṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇīṃ śubhām |
devī-sūkta-japair bhaktyā namaścakruḥ sanātanīm ||125||
taiś cintyamānā sā devī tatraivāvirabhūt tadā |
catur-bhujā viśālākṣī sarvābharaṇa-bhūṣitā ||126||
dukūla-vastra-sahitāṃ divya-mālānulepanām |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā deva-devasya priyāṃ sarve divaukasaḥ ||127||
ūcuḥ prāṣjalayo devīṃ prasannaṃ kurute priyam |
trailokyasyābhayaṃ svāmī yathā dadyāt tathā kuru ||128||
ity uktāsahasādevīpriyaṃ prāpyajanārdanam |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvāmahiṣīṃ svasyapriyāṃ sarveśvarohariḥ |
rakṣaḥ śarīrajaṃ krodhaṃ tatyājaprītavatkṣaṇāt ||130||
aṃ kamādāyatāṃ devīṃ samāśliṣyadayānidhiḥ |
kṛpāsudhārdradṛṣṭyāvainiraikṣata surānhariḥ ||131||
taddayādṛṣṭidṛṣṭānāṃ sānandaḥ sambhramo'bhavat ||132||
 ūcuḥ prāṣjalayodevaṃ namaskṛtyajagat-patim ||133||
deva-gaṇā ūcuḥ—
atyadbhutamidaṃ rūpaṃ bahuvāhupadāṃ kitam ||134||

draṣṭuṃ sthātuṃ naśaktāḥ smaḥ sarvaevadivaukasaḥ ||135||
upasaṃ hṛtyadeveśobabhūvasukhadarśanaḥ ||136||
śaratkoṭīṃ dusaṃ kāśaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ |
sudhāmayasaṭāpuṃ javidyutkoṭinibhaḥ śubhaḥ ||137||

ānandāśrujalaiḥ siktāharṣanirbharacetasaḥ ||143||

prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ cakrerājānamavyayam |
āśvāsyabhaktaṃ prahlādamabhiṣicyasurottamaiḥ ||148||
dadautasmaivarāniṣṭānbhaktiṃ cāvyabhicāriṇīm |

ahaṃ kāravihīnaśca tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
brūtemadarthaṃ yaḥ śāntaṃ tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |
miṣṭaṃ vastusamāsādyadatvāmeyaścamānavaḥ ||89||

gobrāhmaṇahitaiṣīyas tasya tuṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |

asatyabhāṣīkrūraścaparaniṃ dāparastuyaḥ ||96||

adṛṣṭadoṣaupitaraustrībhrātṛbhaginī tathā ||97||

gurvavajṣākaroviprasamāṃ nayatiśatrutām |
ārāmacchedinoye cajalāśayavilāyinaḥ ||99||

rajasvalāstriyāṃ caiva teṣāṃ ruṣṭo'smy ahaṃ sadā |

āmiṣaṃ maithunaṃ tailamamāvāsyādinedvijāḥ ||109||

nindanti vaiṣṇavānye cateṣāṃ ruṣṭo’smy ahaṃ sadā |
ityuktvābhagavānviṣṇuradṛśyaḥ sahasā'bhavat ||111||

idānīṃ vacmi dānāni niśāmaya samāhitaḥ ||1||

kalayākalayācandrakalāṃ saṃ vardhate tathā |
dānasyasāgatiḥ proktātapasaścamanīṣibhiḥ ||5||

ante tyaktvā ca tat sarvaṃ nirāśā yānti jaimine ||10||

tasmād datvā ca toyaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ proktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ |
jīvanaṃ jīvanaṃ nṝṇāṃ jīvanaṃ na ca jīvanam ||17||
ato jīvana-rakṣārthaṃ jīvanaṃ prājṣa utsṛjet |

adyāpipātakedṛṣṭirmahatīvartatemama |

asatpātreṣudattānitānisarvāṇinityaśaḥ |

 tyaktvā nijāśramācāraṃ nijayauvanagarvitā |##
